zh.html:
有两个节省计划 - 用于计算的节省计划和数据库的节省计划。 计算储蓄计划作为 1 年或 3 年的承诺提供，而数据库储蓄计划作为 1 年承诺提供。 节省计算计划适用于一组广泛的 Azure 计算服务的基础结构成本，包括：

  • Azure 虚拟机
  • Azure App 服务
  • Azure Functions 高级计划
  • Azure 容器实例
  • Azure 专用主机
  • Azure 容器应用
  • 适用于企业的 Azure Spring Apps

注意： 虚拟机不包括 Av1 系列。 Azure 计算节省计划只能应用于应用服务升级的高级 v3 计划和升级的独立 v2 计划。 计算节省计划不包括软件、网络或存储费用。

为数据库节省计划适用于数据库服务的基础结构，其中包括：

  • Azure SQL 数据库
  • Azure SQL 托管实例
  • 超大规模 Azure SQL 数据库
  • Azure SQL 数据库无服务器
  • Azure Database for PostgreSQL
  • Azure Database for MySQL
  • Azure Cosmos DB
  • Azure DocumentDB
  • Azure 数据库迁移服务
  • Azure 虚拟机上的 SQL Server 每小时许可证
  • Azure Arc 每小时许可证启用的 SQL Server

请参考链接：什么是储蓄计划？ - Microsoft Cost Management

en.html:
There are two savings plans - Savings plan for compute and Savings plan for databases. The compute savings plan is available as a 1-year or 3-year commitment, while the database savings plan is available as a 1-year commitment. Savings plan for compute applies to infrastructure costs from a broad set of Azure compute services, including:

  • Azure Virtual Machines
  • Azure App Service
  • Azure Functions premium plan
  • Azure Container Instances
  • Azure Dedicated Host
  • Azure Container Apps
  • Azure Spring Apps for Enterprise

Note： Virtual machines don't include Av1 series. The Azure savings plan for Azure App Service can only be applied to the App Service upgraded Premium v3 plan and the upgraded Isolated v2 plan. Savings plan for compute doesn't cover software, networking, or storage charges.

Savings plan for databases applies to infrastructure and software IP costs for database services which include:

  • Azure SQL Database
  • Azure SQL Managed Instance
  • Azure SQL Database Hyperscale
  • Azure SQL Database serverless
  • Azure Database for PostgreSQL
  • Azure Database for MySQL
  • Azure Cosmos DB
  • Azure DocumentDB
  • Azure Database Migration Service
  • SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines hourly licenses
  • SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc hourly licenses

en.html:
Who can purchase a Savings Plan?

  1. Customers with a billing profile contributor or higher role can experience purchasing a savings plan from "Cost Management + Billing">"Savings Plan". No subscription-specific permissions are needed.
  2. Users who have the role of subscription owner or savings plan purchaser roles in at least one subscription in the billing account can purchase savings plans from “Home > Savings plan.”

For more information on how to purchase a savings plan, please refer to: Purchasing Azure Savings Plan

en.html:
Please note:

  • For the 21VCA-E enrollment, partners must publish prices and costs to end customers, which is a key step to ensure the accuracy of customer bills. If no price increase is needed, set the Markup to 0%. If the partner does not publish the price to the end customer, it may lead to inaccurate billing for the customer.
  • Markup enables you to publish prices and costs to end customers that are inclusive of any uplift you may wish to charge for any value-added services offered. The markup feature in Microsoft Cost Management enables you to configure markup that reflected in your end customers' pricing and cost management experiences for all applicable Microsoft first party products and services. Markup doesn't apply to third party marketplace products and seat-based products.
  • If you're a billing account or billing profile admin, you can create and manage markup rules for the customers linked to your billing profile. Only one markup rule can be set up per customer billing profile for a defined time period. The markup rule applies to the customer billing profile only for first party Azure prices and charges.

For more information about markup, please refer to: markup - Microsoft Azure operated by 21Vianet

以下角色可以下载账单：

  • Billing Account: 所有者、参与者、读者
  • Billing Profile：所有者、参与者、读者
  • Invoice Manager

下载账单的步骤：

  1. 使用管理员账户登录 Azure Portal
  2. 搜索“成本管理 + 计费”
  3. 选择计费对象信息，点击 Billing profile名称
  4. 在左侧菜单中，选择“发票”
  5. 在账单列表中，找到与要下载的使用情况文件对应的账单行，点击Azure使用情况文件列的准备。

当文件下载完成后，请选择“下载”。

如果错过了通知，可以从 Azure 门户右上角的“通知”区域（钟形符号）查看。

zh.html:
一、实际成本

实际成本 - 实际成本是指企业在购买Azure服务时实际支付的金额，它通常与购买行为直接相关，并体现在购买当月的账单上。

提供要与每月帐单对帐的数据。 此数据包括预留项购买成本和预留项应用详细信息。 使用此数据可以知道哪个订阅、资源组或资源在特定的日期收到了预留折扣。 收到预留折扣的用途的 EffectivePrice 为零。

显示帐单上的购买费用。 例如，如果在 2022 年 1 月以 1200 美元的价格购买了一年期预留，并且提前支付了全部购买成本，那么成本分析将在 1 月显示 1200 美元的预留成本。 它不显示当年其他月份的预留成本。 但是，如果要按月支付预留成本，则会在每月固定日期显示此定期成本。 如果按 VM 将实际成本分组，则在给定月份享受预留权益的 VM 在该月的成本为零。

特点：

  • 直接反映当月的支出，
  • 包括RI和saving plan购买的费用
  • 包括RI退款的费用，不含充值的MC的费用。

 

二、摊销成本

摊销成本 - 此数据集与“实际成本”数据集类似，差别在于：获取预留折扣的用途的 EffectivePrice 是预留项的按比例分配成本（而不是零）。 这可以帮助你了解订阅、资源组或资源消耗的预留项的货币价值，并可帮助你在内部分摊预留项的使用费。 该数据集还包括预留项的未使用小时数。 该数据集不包括预留项购买记录。

显示在预留期持续时间内，拆分为摊销成本的预留购买费用。 对于前面的相同示例，成本分析将为每个月显示不同的金额，这具体取决于当月的天数。 如果在此示例中按 VM 将成本分组，将会看到划归到每个享受预留权益的 VM 的成本。 但是，“未使用的预留”成本不会计入用于购买预留的订阅，因为未使用的部分不会计入任何特定资源或订阅。 同样，未使用的节省计划成本也不会计入用于购买节省计划的订阅。

注意：摊销成本仅适用于预留和节省计划。 它们不可用于 Azure 市场购买项。

特点：

  • 将RI和saving plan分解为定期成本
  • 会显示未使用的预留或节省计划的成本
  • 不会显示RI退款的金额

 

三、常见问题

1. 实际账单与摊销账单金额有哪些差异?

实际账单 摊销账单
RI购买记录 显示 不显示
用量超出RI优惠用量 未超：显示使用量，不显示金额 超出：按照on-demand计费 未超：显示使用量和金额 超出：按照on-demand计费
目的 了解当月实际产生的费用 了解RI和saving plan在公司内部组织中的消费情况
举例 1月15日购买31元的RI，1月份账单实际显示31元 1月15日购买的RI，摊销账单只会摊销15日到31日期间，即1月份摊销账单为17元

2. 实际账单与摊销账单差异的影响因素有哪些？

  • RI的支付方式为一次性支付

在“实际账单“中，在购买月份会出现一条RI一次性支付的费用，

而“摊销账单“中，会每月按天统计按照RI价格计算的费用；

  • RI在月中购买

购买的当月差距较大，之后月份不受此因素的影响。

例如RI是在15号购买的，实际账单“中RI是一个月的费用，而效期是当月15号至次月14号；而“摊销账单“只统计当月15号到30/31号的金额，因此会导致较大的差异。

RI的每小时单价：RI年付费用 ➗（365天/366天）➗24小时，得出一个每小时单价。

RI的已使用小时数：每一条RI在当月已使用的小时数，这个受当月天数的影响

如果RI购买日是1号，29/30/31天对于实际账单与摊销账单是有差别的

示例：

在1/31日（UTC 0点）购买的一个RI，一年期（1/31-明年1/30），费用是￥365。

实际账单： 实际账单中的purchase cost是￥365/12≈￥30.416。

1月 2月 …… 12月 明年1月
实际账单 ￥30.416 ￥30.416 …… ￥30.416 ￥0
摊销账单 ￥1 ￥28 …… ￥31 ￥30

en.html:
Actual cost

Actual cost - Actual cost refers to the amount actually paid by a company when purchasing Azure services, which is usually directly related to the purchasing behavior and reflected in the bill for the month of purchase.

Provides data to reconcile with your monthly bill. This data has reservation purchase costs and reservation application details. With this data, you can know which subscription or resource group or resource received the reservation discount in a particular day. The EffectivePrice for the usage that receives the reservation discount is zero.

Shows the purchase as it appears on your bill. For example, if you bought a one-year reservation for $1200 in January 2022 and you paid for the entire purchase cost upfront, then cost analysis shows a $1200 cost in the month of January for the reservation. It doesn't show a reservation cost for other months of the year. However, if you're paying the reservation on a monthly basis, then you see this recurring cost on the monthly anniversary date. If you group your actual costs by VM, then a VM that received the reservation benefit for a given month would have zero cost for the month.

Features：

  • Directly reflect cost consumed per month
  • Contains cost of purchasing RI and saving plan
  • Contains refund of RI and doesn’t contain MC

 

Amortized cost

Amortized Cost - This dataset is similar to the Actual Cost dataset except that - the EffectivePrice for the usage that gets reservation discount is the prorated cost of the reservation (instead of being zero). This helps you know the monetary value of reservation consumption by a subscription, resource group or a resource, and can help you charge back for the reservation utilization internally. The dataset also has unused reservation hours. The dataset does not have reservation purchase records.

Shows a reservation purchase split as an amortized cost over the duration of the reservation term. With the same previous example, cost analysis shows a different amount for each month depending on the number of days in the month. If you group costs by VM in this example, you'd see cost attributed to each VM that received the reservation benefit. However, unused reservation costs aren't attributed to the subscription used to buy the reservation because the unused portion isn't attributable to any specific resource or subscription. Similarly, unused saving plan costs aren't attributed to the subscription used to buy the saving plan.

Note：Amortized costs are available only for reservations and savings plans. They aren't available for Azure Marketplace purchases.

Features：

  • Split RI and saving plan as periodic cost
  • Indicate unused cost of RI and saving plan
  • Do not display refund amounts of RI

 

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. The difference between Actual cost and Amortized cost

Actual cost Amortized cost
RI purchasing records Display Do not display
Consumed quantity exceed RI included usage Unexceed：display consumed quantity, don’t display cost amount. Exceed：billed by on-demand model. Unexceed：display consumed quantity and cost amount Exceed：billed by on-demand model.
Purpose Understand actual cost of per month Understand consumed ratio of RI and saving plan
Instance Placed a RI order and consumed 31￥ on Jan 15th. The actual cost of January will display 31￥ Placed a RI order and consumed 31￥ on Jan 15th. The amortized cost of January will display 17￥. (15th to 31st ,17days * 1￥)

2. Factors lead to the differences between the actual cost and the amortized cost?

  • The payment for RI is a one-time payment.

In actual cost, there will be a one-time payment item for RI in the month of purchasing.

In amortized cost, will count used cost of RI day by day, in every month.

  • Placing RI orders in mid-month

The difference will be large in the purchasing month, but it will not exist anymore in following months.

For example, a RI order is placed in 15th. In actual cost, the RI order cost is counted as the cost of whole month. But in amortized cost, it will only count every-day’s cost of RI, from 15th to 31st. Which leads to the distance of actual cost and amortized cost in a certain month.

  • Days of each month

In actual cost, the RI orders cost is calculated as average cost of a whole year (12 months).

In amortized cost: Counted RI cost=RI’s unit price per hours * used hours

RI’s unit price per hours: Total cost of 1 year (12months)/365days or 366days/24 hours

Used hours: The consumed hours of each RI orders given, also up to the days of each month.

If the RI order purchasing date is 1st, actual cost will certainly differ from amortized cost in the month which has 29/30/31 days.

Example：

In Jan 31st (UTC+0:00)，we placed a RI order with the term of 1 year, and purchase 365￥. (Effect from Jan 31st to the 30th of next year.)

Actual cost: Purchase cost is￥365/12≈￥30.416 /month。

Amortized cost：Cost of per day is ￥365/365=￥1/day

RI effected from Jan 31st, and the cost will begin amortize and display RI cost.

In January, the amortized cost is 1￥，February is 28￥, March is 31￥, April is 30￥… until to the next January is 30￥.

Jan Feb …… Dec Jan
Actual cost ￥30.416 ￥30.416 …… ￥30.416 ￥0
Amortized cost ￥1 ￥28 …… ￥31 ￥30

 

For more information about amortized cost, please refer to：View amortized benefit costs

The EffectivePrice for the usage that receives the reservation discount is zero. Shows the purchase as it appears on your bill. For example, if you bought a one-year reservation for \$1200 in January 2022 and you paid for the entire purchase cost upfront, then cost analysis shows a \$1200 cost in the month of January for the reservation. It doesn't show a reservation cost for other months of the year. However, if you're paying the reservation on a monthly basis, then you see this recurring cost on the monthly anniversary date. If you group your actual costs by VM, then a VM that received the reservation benefit for a given month would have zero cost for the month. **Features：** * Directly reflect cost consumed per month * Contains cost of purchasing RI and saving plan * Contains refund of RI and doesn’t contain MC   #### Amortized cost **Amortized Cost** - This dataset is similar to the Actual Cost dataset except that - the EffectivePrice for the usage that gets reservation discount is the prorated cost of the reservation (instead of being zero). This helps you know the monetary value of reservation consumption by a subscription, resource group or a resource, and can help you charge back for the reservation utilization internally. The dataset also has unused reservation hours. The dataset does not have reservation purchase records. Shows a reservation purchase split as an amortized cost over the duration of the reservation term. With the same previous example, cost analysis shows a different amount for each month depending on the number of days in the month. If you group costs by VM in this example, you'd see cost attributed to each VM that received the reservation benefit. However, _unused reservation_ costs aren't attributed to the subscription used to buy the reservation because the unused portion isn't attributable to any specific resource or subscription. Similarly, unused saving plan costs aren't attributed to the subscription used to buy the saving plan. **Note：Amortized costs are available only for reservations and savings plans. They aren't available for Azure Marketplace purchases.** **Features：** * Split RI and saving plan as periodic cost * Indicate unused cost of RI and saving plan * Do not display refund amounts of RI   #### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **1. The difference between Actual cost and Amortized cost**
Actual cost Amortized cost
RI purchasing records Display Do not display
Consumed quantity exceed RI included usage Unexceed：display consumed quantity, don’t display cost amount. Exceed：billed by on-demand model. Unexceed：display consumed quantity and cost amount Exceed：billed by on-demand model.
Purpose Understand actual cost of per month Understand consumed ratio of RI and saving plan
Instance Placed a RI order and consumed 31￥ on Jan 15th. The actual cost of January will display 31￥ Placed a RI order and consumed 31￥ on Jan 15th. The amortized cost of January will display 17￥. (15th to 31st ,17days * 1￥)
**2. Factors lead to the differences between the actual cost and the amortized cost?** * **The payment for RI is a one-time payment.** In actual cost, there will be a one-time payment item for RI in the month of purchasing. In amortized cost, will count used cost of RI day by day, in every month. * **Placing RI orders in mid-month** The difference will be large in the purchasing month, but it will not exist anymore in following months. For example, a RI order is placed in 15th. In actual cost, the RI order cost is counted as the cost of whole month. But in amortized cost, it will only count every-day’s cost of RI, from 15th to 31st. Which leads to the distance of actual cost and amortized cost in a certain month. * **Days of each month** In actual cost, the RI orders cost is calculated as average cost of a whole year (12 months). In amortized cost: **Counted RI cost=RI’s unit price per hours \* used hours** **RI’s unit price per hours:** Total cost of 1 year (12months)/365days or 366days/24 hours **Used hours**: The consumed hours of each RI orders given, also up to the days of each month. If the RI order purchasing date is 1st, actual cost will certainly differ from amortized cost in the month which has 29/30/31 days. **Example：** In Jan 31st (UTC+0:00)，we placed a RI order with the term of 1 year, and purchase 365￥. (Effect from Jan 31st to the 30th of next year.) **Actual cost**: Purchase cost is￥365/12≈￥30.416 /month。 **Amortized cost**：Cost of per day is ￥365/365=￥1/day RI effected from Jan 31st, and the cost will begin amortize and display RI cost. In January, the amortized cost is 1￥，February is 28￥, March is 31￥, April is 30￥… until to the next January is 30￥.
Jan Feb …… Dec Jan
Actual cost ￥30.416 ￥30.416 …… ￥30.416 ￥0
Amortized cost ￥1 ￥28 …… ￥31 ￥30
  For more information about amortized cost, please refer to：[View amortized benefit costs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cost-management-billing/reservations/view-amortized-costs)

在 Azure 门户订阅区域中，订阅可能会是以下几种状态。

  • 活动：Azure 订阅处于活动状态。 可以使用订阅来部署新资源及管理现有资源。
  • 已禁用：Azure 订阅已禁用，不再可用于创建或管理 Azure 资源。 在此状态下，将会解除分配虚拟机，释放临时 IP 地址，存储将变为只读，并禁用其他服务。 订阅可能会保持禁用状态90 天，具体取决于订阅类型。 之后，它将被永久删除。
  • 已删除：已删除 Azure 订阅及所有资源/数据。

In the Azure Portal subscription area, subscriptions may have the following states.

  1. Active: when Azure subscription is active. Subscription can be used to deploy new resources and manage existing resources.
  2. Disabled: If Azure subscription has been disabled then this subscription is no longer available for creating or managing Azure resources. In this state, the virtual machine will be unassigned, temporary IP addresses will be released, storage will become read-only, and other services will be disabled. The subscription may remain disabled for 90 days, depending on the subscription type. Afterwards, it will be permanently deleted.
  3. Deleted: It means all resources/data have been deleted in Azure subscription.

en.raw:
In the Azure Portal subscription area, subscriptions may have the following states.

1.   **Active**: when Azure subscription is active. Subscription can be used to deploy new resources and manage existing resources.
2.   **Disabled**: If Azure subscription has been disabled then this subscription is no longer available for creating or managing Azure resources. In this state, the virtual machine will be unassigned, temporary IP addresses will be released, storage will become read-only, and other services will be disabled. The subscription may remain disabled for 90 days, depending on the subscription type. Afterwards, it will be permanently deleted.
3.   **Deleted**: It means all resources/data have been deleted in Azure subscription.

Tips:

  • Please make a data backup before cancelling the subscription.
  • The subscription owner can do the cancellation.

Steps to cancel subscription:

  1. In the Azure portal, navigate to "Cost Management+Billing"
  2. In the left menu, select "Subscription" or "Azure Subscription"
  3. Select the subscription to cancel.
  4. At the top of the page, select 'Cancel'.
  5. If there are any resources associated with the subscription, they will be displayed on the page. At the top of the page, select 'cancel subscription'

zh.html:
了解使用量报告中名称的含义，可以帮助您更好的了解和分析您的使用情况。以下以每月使用量报告为例为您展示关键名称的定义。  

产品名称字段

meterCategory: 计量器的分类类别的名称，表示资源的分类。 例如，“Virtual Machines”。

meterSubCategory: 计量器子分类类别的名称。RI购买显示为空。例如，“Virtual Machines BS Series”。

meterName：计量器的名称。表示Azure服务的具体资源。例如， B1ls 。

productName：产品的名称，表示Azure服务的具体产品。例如，Virtual Machines BS Series - B1ls - CN North 3。

一级：meterCategory

二级：meterSubCategory

三级：meterName

四级：product

示例：

Storage——Standard SSD Managed Disks——E10 LRS Disk——Standard SSD Managed Disks - E10 LRS - CN North 2

meterRegion：计量器区域，表示服务的使用量是在哪个区域计量的。例如，CN North 3。

resourceLocation：位置，表示资源实际部署和运行的地理位置。例如，CN North 3。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5CPB_V4_CN_001.png

 

价格字段

effectivePrice: 计费周期的混合单价。 混合价格以求平均值的方式消除了单价中出现的任何波动，例如，使用阶梯计价，某段时间的价格会随数量的增加而降低。相当于OSPA的资源费率。

PAYGPrice：这是给定产品或服务的标价或按需价格。即官网的价格。

UnitPrice：这是给定产品或服务的价格，包括基于即用即付价格的任何协商折扣。也就是收费的实际价格。

 

用量字段

Quantity：给定产品或服务每天使用的单位数。 它与实际资源使用中所使用的度量单位 (UOM) 相关。

unitOfMeasure：用于服务计费的度量单位。 例如，计算服务按小时计费。

 

费用字段

costInBillingCurrency：这个可以理解成按照合约给的单价计算出的合约的价格即unit price*quantity，查看账单主要关注这一列即可。

costInPricingCurrency： 这个可以理解成除开RI或者saving plan这种优惠政策外的合约的价格，如果加上RI和saving plan则等于“costInBillingCurrency”

costInUsd：这是“costInBillingCurrency”按照汇率折合成美元的价格

paygCostInBillingCurrency：这个可以理解为零售价，是按照官网的单价进行计算的，官网单价可以查看“payGPrice”

paygCostInUsd：这是“paygCostInBillingCurrency”按照汇率折合成美元的价格

 

字段和说明列表

列名 说明
invoiceId 在发票 PDF 上列出的唯一单据 ID。已出invoice月的账单此列有值，未出invoice的月的账单此列为空
billingAccountId 根计费帐户的唯一标识符。
billingAccountName 计费帐户的名称。
previousInvoiceId 如果行项为退款，则指原始发票。
billingProfileId 计费对象信息标识符
billingProfileName 计费对象信息名称
invoiceSectionId 发票科目的唯一标识符
invoiceSectionName 发票科目的名称
partnerTenantId 合作伙伴的 Microsoft Entra 租户标识符。为空
partnerName 合作伙伴的 Microsoft Entra 租户名称。为空
resellerName 与订阅关联的经销商的名称。为空
resellerMpnId 与订阅关联的经销商的 ID。为空
customerTenantId 客户的订阅的 Microsoft Entra 租户标识符。为空
customerName 客户的订阅的 Microsoft Entra 租户名称。
costCenter 为订阅定义的用于跟踪成本的成本中心（仅在启用计费周期适用于 MCA 帐户）。
billingPeriodStartDate 计费周期的开始日期。
billingPeriodEndDate 计费周期的结束日期。
servicePeriodStartDate 定价周期的开始日期，该周期定义和锁定了所使用的或购买的服务的价格。
servicePeriodEndDate 定价周期的结束日期，该周期定义和锁定了所使用的或购买的服务的价格。
date 费用项目的使用或购买日期。
serviceFamily 服务所属的服务系列。
productOrderId 产品订单的唯一标识符。
productOrderName 产品订单的唯一名称。为空
consumedService 与费用相关联的服务的名称。
meterId 计量的唯一标识符。
meterName 计量的名称。 购买可能显示为空白或 unassigned。RI购买显示为空。
meterCategory 计量的分类类别的名称。 例如，“Virtual Machines”和“Storage”。
meterSubCategory 计量子分类类别的名称。 购买可能显示为空白或 unassigned。RI购买显示为空。例如，“Files”和“Tables”
meterRegion 按位置定价的服务的数据中心位置的名称。
productId 产品的唯一标识符。
product 产品的名称。
subscriptionId Azure 订阅的唯一标识符。
subscriptionName Azure 订阅的名称。
publisherType 值为 Microsoft
publisherId 发布服务器 ID。值为空
publisherName 市场服务的发布者。值为 Microsoft
resourceGroupName 资源所在的资源组的名称。 并非所有费用都来自部署到资源组的资源。 没有资源组的费用将显示为 null 或空、“其他”或“不适用”。比如CDN
resourceId Azure 资源管理器资源的唯一标识符。比如虚拟机会显示虚拟机名称
resourceLocation 资源运行时所在的数据中心位置。
location 资源的规范化位置。
effectivePrice 计费周期的混合单价。 混合价格以求平均值的方式消除了单价中出现的任何波动，例如，使用渐变分层时，某段时间的价格会随数量的增加而降低。相当于OSPA的资源费率
quantity 购买或消耗的单位数。
unitOfMeasure 用于服务计费的度量单位。 例如，计算服务按小时计费。
chargeType 指示费用表示使用情况 (Usage)、购买 (Purchase) 还是退款 (Refund)。
billingCurrency 与计费帐户关联的货币。
pricingCurrency 基于协商价格进行定价时所使用的货币。
costInBillingCurrency 在应用额度或税款之前按计费货币计算的费用成本。
costInPricingCurrency 在应用额度或税款之前按定价货币计算的费用成本。
costInUsd 在应用额度或税款之前按美元计算的费用成本。
paygCostInBillingCurrency 按零售价格计费的费用成本

Understanding Usage Report

Understanding the meanings of the names in the usage report can help you better understand and analyze your usage. Below provides definitions of key names using the monthly usage report as an example.  

Product field

meterCategory：The Category name each product belongs to, such as Virtual Machines.

meterSubCategory：The Sub-Category name each product belongs to, such as Virtual Machines BS Series.

meterName：Name of detail resource, such as B1ls.

productName：Name of detail product, such as Virtual Machines BS Series - B1ls - CN North 3.

First level：meterCategory

Second level：meterSubCategory

Third level：meterName

Forth level：product

Example：

Storage——Standard SSD Managed Disks——E10 LRS Disk——Standard SSD Managed Disks - E10 LRS - CN North 2

meterRegion：The name of the Azure region associated with the meter. It represents the region of the metered consumed quantity. Such as CN North 3.

resourceLocation： Location, represent the actual geographical location of the running resource. Such as CN North 3.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5CPB_V4_EN_001.png

 

Price field

effectivePrice：Blended unit price for the period. Blended prices average out any fluctuations in the unit price, like graduated tiering, which lowers the price as quantity increases over time. It can be understood as Resource Rate in OSPA usage report.

PAYGPrice：The market price, also referred to as retail or list price, for a given product or service.

UnitPrice：The price for a given product or service inclusive of any negotiated discount that you might have on top of the market price (PayG price column) for your contract. This is the actual price applied on your usage report.

 

Usage field

Quantity：The usage of a given product or service consumed every day. It is connected with the unit of measure (UOM).

unitOfMeasure：Unit of product usage counting. For instance, compute resource is counted by hours.

 

Cost field

costInBillingCurrency：Calculated by unitprice and quantity: unit price*quantity. Checking the cost data, only have to focus on this line.

costInPricingCurrency：RI and saving plan excluded cost calculated by unitprice and quantity. Added RI and saving plan cost, it equals“costInBillingCurrency”.

costInUsd：“costInBillingCurrency”in USD currency.

paygCostInBillingCurrency：Calculated by payGprice and quantity. No any discount applied.

paygCostInUsd：“paygCostInBillingCurrency”in USD currency.

 

List of fields and descriptions

Column Description
invoiceId The unique document ID listed on the invoice PDF. Shown as ID in Invoice sent month, and shown as blank in Invoice un-sent month.
billingAccountId Unique identifier for the root billing account.
billingAccountName Name of the billing account.
previousInvoiceId Reference to an original invoice if the line item is a refund.
billingProfileId Unique identifier of billing profile.
billingProfileName Name of billing profile.
invoiceSectionId Unique identifier for the invoice section.
invoiceSectionName Name of invoice section.
partnerTenantId Identifier for the partner's Microsoft Entra tenant. Shown as blank.
partnerName Name of the partner Microsoft Entra directory tenant. Shown as blank.
resellerName The name of the reseller associated with the subscription. Shown as blank.
resellerMpnId ID for the reseller associated with the subscription. Shown as blank.
customerTenantId Identifier of the Microsoft Entra directory tenant of the customer's subscription. Shown as blank.
customerName Name of the Microsoft Entra directory tenant for the customer's subscription.

provider Identifier for product category or Line of Business.
benefitId Unique identifier for the purchased Reserved Instance or savings plan instance.
benefitName Unique identifier for the purchased Reserved Instance or savings plan instance.

zh.html:
1. 导出功能简介

 

通过导出功能，你可以创建一个定期任务，该任务每天或每月自动将成本管理数据导出到 Azure 存储。 导出旨在通过自动导出其他影响成本的数据集来简化 FinOps 实践。 可以将导出的数据与外部系统结合使用，并将其与你自己的自定义数据组合在一起。

 

2. 前提条件

 

使用导出功能，需要对订阅和存储具有相应的权限。

对于订阅：

  • 订阅的所有者--可以为订阅创建、修改或删除计划导出。
  • 订阅的参与者--可以创建、修改或删除自己的计划导出。
  • 订阅的成本管理参与者--可以查看成本并管理成本配置(例如，预算、导出)。

对于 Azure 存储帐户：

  • 无论导出权限如何，更改配置的存储帐户都需要写入权限。

  • 必须为 Blob 或文件存储配置 Azure 存储帐户。

  • 如果存储容器在对象复制规则中被配置为目标，请勿将导出配置到该存储容器。

  • 若要使用防火墙规则导出到存储帐户，需要对存储帐户拥有其他权限。 只有在创建或修改导出期间才需要这些权限。   自定义角色，包括：

    • Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write
    • Microsoft.Authorization/permissions/read

▧

权限问题导致的常见报错：

如果您的账号仅是订阅的读者和参与者的角色，在访问存储账号的容器时会遇到以下报错，如果遇到这类情况，就可以让该存储账户的所有者（也是存储账户所属订阅的所有者）给您的账号分配存储blob读取器、存储blob数据参与者或者存储blob数据所有者等角色，这样您的账号就可以下载容器里的账单了。

  • 订阅的读者

3. 创建步骤

 

3.1. 进入导出界面

 

通过以下方式都可进入导出界面。

  • 成本管理+计费左侧点击导出。

4）应用文件分区的原因和时间

为了提高可靠性和可伸缩性，成本管理会自动将大型文件分区为较小的区块。 分区有助于解决下载或打开大型单文件的挑战，尤其是在不可靠的网络或文件大小或行计数限制的工具（如Microsoft Excel）中。

在导出体验中，始终启用分区。 文件根据大小（而不是行计数）进行拆分，每个未压缩的文件都保持在 1 GB 以下。 对于 Gzip 等压缩格式，实际文件大小可能因压缩效率而异。

即使对于小型导出，也一致地应用分区。 这可确保与下游系统的兼容性，支持企业级自动化，并避免报告工作流中的不一致或故障

**每月导出上月成本（Monthly）**。在第二月的5号导出上月账单。7月10号创建的导出，也就是8月5号会出7月账单。到期时间默认是2050/2/1，需要停止点击“禁用”即可。

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_image_23.png)

**上一个计费月每月导出成本(Monthly)**。比如我们在3月10号创建了该导出作业，那么就会出2月份的完整账单。下次运行时间为下个月的5号。

*   导出说明。可自行添加备注信息。

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_image_24.png)

#### 3.4. 定义导出目标
 

*   选择“存储类型”。 默认存储类型为 Azure Blob 存储。
*   订阅：需指定 Azure 存储账户所属的订阅
*    存储账户：选择已有的存储账户或新建一个。
*    容器和目录：指定要将导出文件放置到其中的存储容器和目录路径，容器和目录名称自行填写即可。
*   格式：选择 CSV 或 Parquet 作为“格式”。
*   对于“压缩类型”，请选择“None”、“Gzip”（适用于 CSV 文件格式）或“Snappy”（适用于 parquet 文件格式）
*   文件分区：文件分区是默认开启的。它将大文件拆分为较小的文件，并且无法禁用。
*   覆盖数据，默认情况下“覆盖数据”已启用。 对于每日导出，它将前一天的文件替换为更新的文件。

#### 3.5查看并创建导出
 

查看导出配置并进行任何必要的更改。 完成后，选择“查看 + 创建”来完成此过程。

新导出将出现在导出列表中。 默认情况下，新导出为启用状态。 如果要禁用或删除计划的导出，请选择列表中的任何项，然后选择“禁用”或“删除”。

在数据准备就绪之前，导出过程最多可能需要 24 小时才能完成。

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_image_30.png)

### 4. 管理导出
 

可以通过导航到‘导出’页面查看可用导出的列表，并通过选择这些导出来管理单个导出。

您可以对单个导出执行以下操作。

*   立即运行 - 将计划外导出排入队列，以在下一个可用时刻运行，无论计划的运行时间如何。
*   导出选定日期 - 再次运行历史日期范围的导出，而不是创建新的一次性导出。 最多可以在一个月区块中提取 13 个月的历史数据。 此选项不适用于价目表。
*   禁用 - 暂时暂停导出作业。
*   删除 - 永久删除导出。
*   刷新 - 更新运行历史记录。

### 5. 下载账单

在如下页面点击“下载”

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_image_36.png)

 

### 6. FAQ
 

下面是有关导出的一些常见问题和解答。

1） 数据集版本以及字段解释：[成本管理数据集架构索引 - Microsoft Cost Management ](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/cost-management-billing/dataset-schema/schema-index)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_image_37.png)
 

2） 目前支持的导出范围有：billing account层级、billing profile层级，发票科目层级，单个订阅层级。 管理组范围暂不支持该导出功能。创建管理组范围的导出作业会出现报错：

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_image_38.png)
 

3） 如果要导出到配置了防火墙规则的存储账户，您的账户还需要一些附加权限。

[教程 - 改进的导出体验 - 预览 - Microsoft Cost Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/cost-management-billing/costs/tutorial-improved-exports)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_image_39.png)

报错显示：

{

	"error":{

	"code":"Unauthorized",

	"message":"The user does not have authorization to perform 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write' action on specified storage account, please use a storage account with sufficient permissions. If the permissions have changed recently then retry after some time."

	}

}

 

4）应用文件分区的原因和时间

为了提高可靠性和可伸缩性，成本管理会自动将大型文件分区为较小的区块。 分区有助于解决下载或打开大型单文件的挑战，尤其是在不可靠的网络或文件大小或行计数限制的工具（如Microsoft Excel）中。

在导出体验中，始终启用分区。 文件根据大小（而不是行计数）进行拆分，每个未压缩的文件都保持在 1 GB 以下。 对于 Gzip 等压缩格式，实际文件大小可能因压缩效率而异。

即使对于小型导出，也一致地应用分区。 这可确保与下游系统的兼容性，支持企业级自动化，并避免报告工作流中的不一致或故障

 

5）使用导出，可能会涉及到什么费用？

将多种类型的成本管理数据集导出到 Azure 存储，你将产生存储和网络费用。

**更多内容，请参考文档**：[教程 - 创建和管理成本管理导出 - Microsoft Cost Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/cost-management-billing/costs/tutorial-improved-exports)

1. Export Feature Overview

 

You can create a recurring task that automatically exports your Cost Management data to Azure storage on a daily, or monthly basis. Exports is designed to streamline your FinOps practice by automating the export of other cost-impacting datasets. You can use the exported data with external systems and combine it with your own custom data.

 

2. Prerequisites

 

To utilize the export functionality, appropriate permissions for both the subscription and storage are required.

For subscription:

  • Owner - Can create, modify, or delete scheduled exports for a subscription.
  • Contributor - Can create, modify, or delete their own scheduled exports.
  • Cost Management Contributor - Can view costs and manage cost configurations (e.g., budgets, exports).

For Azure Storage accounts:

  • Write permissions are required to change the configured storage account, independent of permissions on the export.
  • Your Azure storage account must be configured for blob or file storage.
  • Don't configure exports to a storage container that is configured as a destination in an object replication rule.
  • To export to storage accounts with firewall rules, you need other privileges on the storage account. These privileges are only required during export creation or modification:
  • Owner role on the storage account or A custom role that includes:
    • Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write
    • Microsoft.Authorization/permissions/read

3.4 Define the export destination

 

  • On the Destination tab, select the Storage type. The default is Azure blob storage.
  • Specify your Azure storage account subscription. Choose an existing resource group or create a new one.

  • Container and Directory: Specify the storage container and directory path for the export file. You may enter the container and directory names directly.
  • Format: Choose the Format as CSV or Parquet.
  • Choose the Compression type as None, Gzip for CSV file format, or Snappy for the parquet file format.

  1. CSV: Suitable for rapid data exchange, small dataset, or collaboration among non-technical users.
  2. Parquet: Preferred for big data analytics and scenarios with frequent reads and infrequent writes.
  3. Delta: Ideal for applications requiring transaction support, frequent updates, or building Data Lake, often integrated with the Spark ecosystem.

If further optimization of cloud storage costs (combined with FinOps) is needed, the high compression rates of Parquet and Delta are advantageous, while Delta’s version control feature helps reduce cost waste caused by data errors.

3.5 Review and create

 

Review your export configuration and make any necessary changes. When done, select Review + create to complete the process.

Your new export appears in the list of exports. By default, new exports are enabled. If you want to disable or delete a scheduled export, select any item in the list, and then select either Disable or Delete.

The export process can take up to 24 hours to complete before the data is ready.

4. Manage exports

 

You can view the list of available exports by navigating to the Exports page and manage individual exports by selecting them.

You can perform the following actions on individual exports.

  • Run now - Queues an unplanned export to run at the next available moment, regardless of the scheduled run time.
  • Export selected dates - Reruns an export for a historical date range instead of creating a new one-time export. You can extract up to 13 months of historical data in one-month chunks. This option isn't available for price sheets.
  • Disable - Temporarily suspends the export job.
  • Delete - Permanently removes the export.
  • Refresh - Updates the Run history.

en.raw:
### 1. Export Feature Overview
 

You can create a recurring task that automatically exports your Cost Management data to Azure storage on a daily, or monthly basis. Exports is designed to streamline your FinOps practice by automating the export of other cost-impacting datasets. You can use the exported data with external systems and combine it with your own custom data.

 

### 2. Prerequisites
 

To utilize the export functionality, appropriate permissions for both the subscription and storage are required.

**For subscription:**

*   Owner - Can create, modify, or delete scheduled exports for a subscription.
*   Contributor - Can create, modify, or delete their own scheduled exports. 
*   Cost Management Contributor - Can view costs and manage cost configurations (e.g., budgets, exports).

**For Azure Storage accounts:**

*   Write permissions are required to change the configured storage account, independent of permissions on the export.
*   Your Azure storage account must be configured for blob or file storage.
*   Don't configure exports to a storage container that is configured as a destination in an object replication rule.
*   To export to storage accounts with firewall rules, you need other privileges on the storage account. These privileges are only required during export creation or modification:
*   Owner role on the storage account or A custom role that includes:
     *   Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write
     *   Microsoft.Authorization/permissions/read  

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_1.png)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_2.png)
 

**Common Errors Caused by Permission Issues:**

If your account only has the Reader or Contributor role for the subscription, you may encounter the following error when accessing a container in the storage account. If this occurs, you can request the owner of the storage account (who is also the owner of the subscription to which the storage account belongs) to assign your account roles such as Storage Blob Data Reader, Storage Blob Data Contributor, or Storage Blob Data Owner. This will allow your account to download the usage report from the container.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_3.png)
 


**Roles that may cause errors when creating an export:**

*   Reader for subscription

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_4.png)

*   Cost Management Reader for subscription

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_5.png)

### 3. Create exports
 

#### 3.1. Accessing the Export Interface
 

 The export interface can be accessed through the following methods.

*    Click Export under Cost Management + Billing on the left sidebar.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_6.png)
 

*    In Cost Management + Billing, click Cost Analysis on the left sidebar, then select Configure.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_7.png)
 

*    In Cost Management, click Export or Configure on the left sidebar.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_8.png)
 

#### 3.2. Select the Billing Scope
 

You can create export jobs at the Billing Account, Billing Profile, Invoice Section, or Subscription level.

 ![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_9.png)
  

 Supported templates at the Billing Account level:

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_10.png)
 

Supported templates at the Billing Profile level:

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_11.png)
 

Supported templates at the Invoice Section level:

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_12.png)
 

Supported templates at the Subscription level:

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_13.png)

 

#### 3.3. Edit Export Information
 

After selecting the desired export template and providing the relevant information—using Cost and Usage details (Actual) as an example—configure the following:

*   Export Prefix: The name of the export job.
*   The default export job is set to Daily type, which exports data from the beginning of the month to the current date on a daily basis. Click the Edit button to modify these settings.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_14.png)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_15.png)
 

**Type of data and the Dataset version**

If Cost and usage details (actual) and Cost and usage details (amortized) template is selected, the following four dataset versions will be displayed:

2021-10-01, 2021-01-01, 2019-11-01, and 2019-10-01, with 2021-10-01 set as the default.

For detailed explanations of these dataset versions, please refer to the documentation:

[https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cost-management-billing/dataset-schema/cost-usage-details-mca-partner-subscription\#version-2021-10-01](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cost-management-billing/dataset-schema/cost-usage-details-mca-partner-subscription#version-2021-10-01)

The billing usage report manually downloaded from the Portal is an actual cost bill, which uses the 2021-10-01 dataset—the most detailed dataset version.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_16.png)
 

If the Cost and usage details (FOCUS)** **export template is selected (note that the table contains a large number of header entries — 96 in total — therefore, it is recommended to download the Cost and usage details (actual) ), only three frequency options are available, along with three dataset versions: v1.0, v1.0r2, and v1.0-preview(V1).

For detailed information on these dataset versions, please refer to:

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cost-management-billing/dataset-schema/cost-usage-details-focus

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_17.png)

 ![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_18.png)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_19.png)

Export Frequency, Categorized into the following four types:

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_20.png)
 

**One-time export (Custom):** Custom Date Range.

The selected time span must be one month and within the same calendar month. Cross-month selection is not allowed.

For example:  
If you choose an end date of **July 2**, but select a start date of **June 30**, the system will prompt:  
“Period must be within the same month.”

In this case, you may only select any date range within July.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_21.png)
 

**Daily export of month-to-date costs** (**Daily**)

The export function will generate bills usage report from the 1st of the current month up to the current date at the time of setup. Subsequent exports will occur automatically on a daily basis.

For example:  
If you configure this export on March 10, the system will produce a bill usage report covering the period from March 1 to March 10.

The default expiration date is set to February 1, 2050. To stop the automated export, simply click "Disable".

**Monthly export of last month's costs**

The export process will generate the previous month's billing usage report on the 5th of the following month.

For example:  
If an export task is created on July 10, the system will produce the July billing usage report on August 5.

The default expiration date is set to February 1, 2050. To stop the automated export, click "Disable".

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_22.png)
 

**Monthly export of last billing month's costs**

If you create this export job on March 10, it will generate the complete billing usage report for February. The next automated run will occur on the 5th of the following month.

**Export Description.** Custom notes or remarks can be added as needed.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_23.png)

 

#### 3.4 Define the export destination
 

*   On the Destination tab, select the **Storage type**. The default is Azure blob storage.
*   Specify your Azure storage account subscription. Choose an existing resource group or create a new one.
*   Select the Storage account name or create a new one.
*   Container and Directory: Specify the storage container and directory path for the export file. You may enter the container and directory names directly.
*    Format: Choose the Format as CSV or Parquet.
*   Choose the Compression type as None, Gzip for CSV file format, or Snappy for the parquet file format.
*   File partitioning is enabled by default. It splits large files into smaller ones and can't be disabled.
*   Overwrite data is enabled by default. For daily exports, it replaces the previous day's file with an updated file.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_24.png)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_25.png)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_26.png)
 

1.   **CSV**: Suitable for rapid data exchange, small dataset, or collaboration among non-technical users.
2.   **Parquet**: Preferred for big data analytics and scenarios with frequent reads and infrequent writes.
3.   **Delta:** Ideal for applications requiring transaction support, frequent updates, or building Data Lake, often integrated with the Spark ecosystem.

If further optimization of cloud storage costs (combined with FinOps) is needed, the high compression rates of Parquet and Delta are advantageous, while Delta’s version control feature helps reduce cost waste caused by data errors.

#### 3.5 Review and create
 

Review your export configuration and make any necessary changes. When done, select Review + create to complete the process.

Your new export appears in the list of exports. By default, new exports are enabled. If you want to disable or delete a scheduled export, select any item in the list, and then select either Disable or Delete.

The export process can take up to 24 hours to complete before the data is ready.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_27.png)

### 4. Manage exports
 

You can view the list of available exports by navigating to the Exports page and manage individual exports by selecting them.

You can perform the following actions on individual exports.

*   Run now - Queues an unplanned export to run at the next available moment, regardless of the scheduled run time.
*   Export selected dates - Reruns an export for a historical date range instead of creating a new one-time export. You can extract up to 13 months of historical data in one-month chunks. This option isn't available for price sheets.
*   Disable - Temporarily suspends the export job.
*   Delete - Permanently removes the export.
*   Refresh - Updates the Run history.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_28.png)

 

### 5. Download usage report
 

In the export list, select the storage account name.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_29.png)
 

Navigate to the container you wish to access and select the folder corresponding to the current month.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_30.png)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_31.png)

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_32.png)

Click "Download" on the following page.

![](images\使用导出功能导出账单_En_image_33.png)

一、 核心购买逻辑与应用规则

在开始选择具体产品前，理解RI的核心应用逻辑至关重要，这决定了您的预留是否能被充分利用。

"不用则失"（Use-it-or-lose-it）原则：对于绝大多数产品（除Azure Databricks外），RI折扣是按小时应用和计算的。在任意一个小时内，如果您没有运行符合条件的资源来匹配您所购买的RI，那么该小时的预留折扣额度将自动作废，且无法累积或转移到其他时间。因此，RI最适合为需要24小时持续稳定运行的工作负载购买。例如，您购买了一台特定型号虚拟机的RI，只有当该型号的虚拟机在某一小时处于运行状态时，该小时的费用才会享受RI折扣。如果该小时虚拟机被关闭，则折扣失效。

非容量预留：购买预留容量不会为您预分配或保留特定的虚拟机或集群资源，它仅提供计费折扣。

参考文档：确定要购买哪种 Azure 预留项 - Microsoft Cost Management

 

二、 各产品RI购买方式与要点

在最终购买前，强烈建议您通过核对您的账单详情以确认资源使用情况。账单的数据是按天出具数据，最重要的数据即为账单中的**“quantity”**列。结合账单中的单位（unit of measure），对于稳定运行的可以购买RI的产品，一般操作为将“quantity”的数据除以24小时得出实际部署的单位数量以此推断出我们购买的RI数量。

购买RI需要在订阅上拥有订阅所有者或预留购买者角色（如预留的应用范围选择“管理组”，还必须至少具有对管理组的“读取”权限）。

购买时可选择预留的适用范围，包括“管理组”、"单个订阅"、"共享"（整个合约中的所有订阅）或"单个资源组"。购买后也可在RI订单中的“配置”选项中更改此范围。

以下是根据中国区（21V运营）Azure常见产品整理的RI购买关键信息。

1. 虚拟机

购买依据：按照虚拟机的具体机型SKU和所在区域购买。购买时，机型可以参考账单中的metername列。如果从此列无法确定具体机型，请根据 additionalInfo 列的信息来确定准确的资源系列和规格。目前，对于以下VM机型，由于共享meterID，所以必须检查账单中的“additionalinfo”列，以确定您实际部署的机型。“产品（product）”名称可能无法准确反映您实际部署的配置。

虚拟机Dv2/DSv2系列

虚拟机Dav4/DaSv4系列

虚拟机Dv3/DSv3系列

虚拟机Ev3/ESv3系列

虚拟机Eav4/Easv4系列

虚拟机F/FS系列

操作系统：RI购买不区分操作系统（Windows或Linux）。对于Windows虚拟机，RI折扣仅应用于计算部分，Windows许可证费用会在账单中单独计费。您可以结合Azure混合权益进一步节省许可成本。

实例大小灵活性：这是RI的一项关键功能。如果启用，购买一个RI可以应用于同一虚拟机系列"灵活性组"内的多种规格。例如，为Dsv3系列购买的RI，可以自动应用于Dsv3系列内不同大小的VM（如Standard_D2s_v3, Standard_D4s_v3等），使用更灵活，能更好地应对业务变化。

参考链接：

了解 Azure 虚拟机预留实例折扣 - Microsoft Cost Management

虚拟机大小灵活性 - Azure 虚拟机预留实例 - Azure Virtual Machines

2. Azure Blob 存储

购买依据：根据访问层（热、冷、存档）、冗余类型（如LRS, ZRS, GRS）以及容量大小购买。

应用范围：应用于存储在Azure Blob（GPv2）和Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2(GPv2)和Blob存储账户（旧Blob存储账户）上的数据。

最小购买量与单位：最小购买单位为 100 TB。购买后，折扣适用于选定范围内所有存储账户的累计数据量，而非特定账户或容器。

应用方式：按小时应用。例如，购买100TB RI，在某一小时存储了110TB数据，则其中100TB享受RI折扣，超出的10TB按即用即付价格计费。

不适用范围：不适用于高级存储帐户、常规用途v1（GPv1）存储帐户、页Blob、Azure队列存储或Azure表存储。

借助预留容量优化 Blob 存储的成本 - Azure Storage

3. SQL Database 与 SQL Managed Instance

购买依据：按照性能层（常规用途、业务关键）及vCore数量购买。仅适用于基于vCore的预配计算层购买模型，基于DTU的模型不支持。

计费方式：账单按单个vCore每小时计费。例如，一个4 vCore的数据库运行一天，消耗的quantity为： 24小时 * 4 = 96 vCore小时。则RI购买量为4

区域冗余：如果启用了区域冗余（目前仅CN3区域支持），需要同时购买对应vCore的RI和vCoreZR的RI。可结合账单的产品名称和数量推算具体购买的vcore数。

重要例外：Azure混合权益（AHB）和RI折扣不适用于无服务器计算层。无服务器层数据库无法通过购买RI节省计算成本。

4. Azure Databricks 预购计划

核心区别： 与大多数RI"按小时过期"不同，Databricks预购是购买一个Databricks承诺单位池。在1年或3年期内，您随时使用的Databricks用量都会从这个池中按比例扣除，额度不会按小时失效。

DBU与DBCU：购买的是DBCU，而账单计费的是DBU。不同工作负载和层级（标准/高级）消耗DBCU的比率不同（例如，通用计算-高级层的比率为0.583）。这意味着1个DBU的用量可能只消耗0.583个DBCU。

购买计算：需要根据账单历史数据预测未来1-3年各工作负载的DBU总用量，再乘以对应的应用比率，汇总得到需要购买的DBCU总量。可以分批购买，先用完再增购。假设环境中使用了**All-purpose Compute -高级层，**一年的DBU用量是10000，那么需要的DBCU量为：10000*0.583=5830 DBCU；Jobs Compute -高级层，一年的DBU用量是10000，那么需要的DBCU量为：10000*0.318=3180 DBCU。那么共计9010 DBCU，您可根据此量购买DBCU

不支持的操作：不支持退订及交换。

注意： 此RI仅节省DBU费用，底层虚拟机、存储、网络等费用需单独购买相应的RI（如虚拟机RI）来节省。

高可用性(HA)：如果开启了此功能， Azure会在另一个可用性区域自动部署一个备用副本（Standby Replica）。这个备用副本是热备状态，始终在运行以保障故障切换，因此同样会产生计算费用。您需要为主副本 + 备用副本的总vCore数购买预留。例如，如果您运行一个常规用途、16 vCore的数据库并启用了高可用性，那么实际消耗的计算资源是 16 vCore (主) + 16 vCore (备) = 32 vCore。您需要购买32个vCore的预留容量。即购买预留实例（RI）的核心逻辑不变，但需要计算的vCore总数会翻倍。

计费方式： 账单按单个vCore每小时计费，由于存在HA的配置影响，直接看账单中的quantity列会获得更为准确的信息。例如，一个MySQL 机型D4dsv4运行一天，消耗的quantity为： 24小时 * 4 = 96 vCore小时。则RI购买量为4。如果开启HA，那么消耗的quantity则为192小时，RI的购买量则为8。

2. 利用工具获取建议：在Azure门户购买RI时，对于有些产品来说，系统会分析过去 7 天、30 天和 60 天的每小时用量数据提供“购买建议”。同时，Azure顾问也会在订阅层面提供RI购买建议。但请勿严格依赖，仅供参考。

3. 结合Azure混合权益：对于Windows Server、SQL Server等自带许可证的工作负载，在购买RI时启用Azure混合权益，可以免除RI中的软件许可费，实现双重节省。Azure 混合权益 - Azure云计算

一、 核心购买逻辑与应用规则 在开始选择具体产品前，理解RI的核心应用逻辑至关重要，这决定了您的预留是否能被充分利用。 "不用则失"（Use-it-or-lose-it）原则 ：对于绝大多数产品（ 除Azure Databricks外），RI折扣是按小时应用和计算的。在任意一个小时内，如果您没有运行符合条件的资源来匹配您所购买的RI，那么该小时的预留折扣额度将自动作废，且无法累积或转移到其他时间。因此，RI最适合为需要24小时持续稳定运行的工作负载购买。例如，您购买了一台特定型号虚拟机的RI，只有当该型号的虚拟机在某一小时处于运行状态时，该小时的费用才会享受RI折扣。如果该小时虚拟机被关闭，则折扣失效。 非容量预留 ：购买预留容量不会为您预分配或保留特定的虚拟机或集群资源，它仅提供计费折扣。 参考文档： 确定要购买哪种 Azure 预留项 - Microsoft Cost Management 二、 各产品RI购买方式与要点 在最终购买前，强烈建议您通过核对您的账单详情以确认资源使用情况。 账单的数据是 按天出具 数据，最重要的数据即为账单中的 **“quantity”**列。结合账单中的单位（unit of measure），对于稳定运行的可以购买RI的产品，一般操作为将“quantity”的数据除以24小时得出实际部署的单位数量以此推断出我们购买的RI数量。 购买RI需要在订阅上拥有 订阅所有者或预留购买者角色 （ 如预留的应用范围选择“管理组”，还必须至少具有对管理组的“读取”权限）。 购买时可选择预留的适用范围，包括“管理组”、"单个订阅"、"共享"（整个合约中的所有订阅）或"单个资源组"。购买后也可在RI订单中的“配置”选项中更改此范围。 以下是根据中国区（21V运营）Azure常见产品整理的RI购买关键信息。 1. 虚拟机 购买依据 ：按照虚拟机的具体机型SKU和所在区域购买。购买时，机型可以参考账单中的metername列。如果从此列无法确定具体机型，请根据 additionalInfo 列的信息来确定准确的资源系列和规格。目前，对于以下VM机型，由于共享meterID，所以必须检查账单中的“additionalinfo”列，以确定您实际部署的机型。“产品（product）”名称可能无法准确反映您实际部署的配置。 虚拟机Dv2/DSv2系列 虚拟机Dav4/DaSv4系列 虚拟机Dv3/DSv3系列 虚拟机Ev3/ESv3系列 虚拟机Eav4/Easv4系列 虚拟机F/FS系列 操作系统 ：RI购买不区分操作系统（Windows或Linux）。对于Windows虚拟机，RI折扣仅应用于计算部分，Windows许可证费用会在账单中单独计费。您可以结合Azure混合权益进一步节省许可成本。 实例大小灵活性 ：这是RI的一项关键功能。如果启用，购买一个RI可以应用于同一虚拟机系列"灵活性组"内的多种规格。例如，为Dsv3系列购买的RI，可以自动应用于Dsv3系列内不同大小的VM（如Standard_D2s_v3, Standard_D4s_v3等），使用更灵活，能更好地应对业务变化。 参考链接： 了解 Azure 虚拟机预留实例折扣 - Microsoft Cost Management 虚拟机大小灵活性 - Azure 虚拟机预留实例 - Azure Virtual Machines 购买页面截图： 2. Azure Blob 存储 购买依据 ：根据访问层（热、冷、存档）、冗余类型（如LRS, ZRS, GRS）以及容量大小购买。 应用范围 ：应用于存储在Azure Blob（GPv2）和Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2(GPv2)和Blob存储账户（旧Blob存储账户）上的数据。 最小购买量与单位 ：最小购买单位为 100 TB。购买后，折扣适用于选定范围内所有存储账户的累计数据量，而非特定账户或容器。 应用方式 ：按小时应用。例如，购买100TB RI，在某一小时存储了110TB数据，则其中100TB享受RI折扣，超出的10TB按即用即付价格计费。 不适用范围 ：不适用于高级存储帐户、常规用途v1（GPv1）存储帐户、页Blob、Azure队列存储或Azure表存储。 参考链接： 借助预留容量优化 Blob 存储的成本 - Azure Storage 了解如何将预留折扣应用到 Azure 存储服务- Microsoft Cost Management 购买页面截图： 3. Azure Databricks 预购计划 核心区别： 与大多数RI"按小时过期"不同，Databricks预购是购买一个Databricks承诺单位池。在1年或3年期内，您随时使用的Databricks用量都会从这个池中按比例扣除，额度不会按小时失效。 DBU与DBCU ：购买的是DBCU，而账单计费的是DBU。不同工作负载和层级（标准/高级）消耗DBCU的比率不同（例如，通用计算-高级层的比率为0.583）。这意味着1个DBU的用量可能只消耗0.583个DBCU。 购买计算 ：需要根据账单历史数据预测未来1-3年各工作负载的DBU总用量，再乘以对应的应用比率，汇总得到需要购买的DBCU总量。可以分批购买，先用完再增购。假设环境中使用了**All-purpose Compute -高级层，**一年的DBU用量是10000，那么需要的DBCU量为：10000*0.583=5830 DBCU； Jobs Compute -高级层 ，一年的DBU用量是10000，那么需要的DBCU量为：10000*0.318=3180 DBCU。那么共计9010 DBCU，您可根据此量购买DBCU 不支持的操作 ：不支持退订及交换。 注意： 此RI仅节省DBU费用，底层虚拟机、存储、网络等费用需单独购买相应的RI（如虚拟机RI）来节省。 参考链接： 通过预购优化 Azure Databricks 成本 - Microsoft Cost Management 购买页面截图： 5. Azure Synapse Analytics（仅限数据仓库） 购买单位 ：以100 DWU(数据仓库单位)为单位出售。 购买数量： 请购买与您使用的总DWU相匹配的份数。例如，使用200 DWU，则需要购买2份预留容量。 不支持的操作 ：不支持退订及交换。 参考链接 ： 预留折扣如何应用于 Azure Synapse Analytics（仅限数据仓库）- Microsoft Cost Management 购买页面截图： 6. Azure Database for MySQL / PostgreSQL 购买依据： 按照性能层级（常规用途、业务关键/内存优化）和vCore数量购买。不支持BS系列即可突发类型的购买。 购买SKU ： 对于MySQL， 常规用途系列，均 按照" Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server General Purpose Series Compute "条目购买； 业务关键系列，均按照" Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server Memory Optimized Series Compute "条目购买。 对于PostgreSQL，根据实际机型购买即可。 高可用性(HA) ：如果开启了此功能， Azure会在另一个可用性区域自动部署一个 备用副本 （Standby Replica）。这个备用副本是热备状态，始终在运行以保障故障切换，因此同样会产生计算费用。您需要为 主副本 + 备用副本 的总vCore数购买预留。例如，如果您运行一个 常规用途、16 vCore 的数据库并启用了高可用性，那么实际消耗的计算资源是 16 vCore (主) + 16 vCore (备) = 32 vCore 。您需要购买 32个vCore 的预留容量。即购买预留实例（RI）的核心逻辑不变，但 需要计算的vCore总数会翻倍 。 计费方式： 账单按单个vCore每小时计费，由于存在HA的配置影响，直接看账单中的quantity列会获得更为准确的信息。例如，一个MySQL 机型D4dsv4运行一天，消耗的quantity为： 24小时 * 4 = 96 vCore小时。则RI购买量为4。如果开启HA，那么消耗的quantity则为192小时，RI的购买量则为8。 参考链接： 计算预付费 - Azure Database for MySQL 为预留容量的计算资源预付费 - Azure Database for PostgreSQL High-Availability （HA） - 常见问题解答 - Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server 配置高可用性 购买页面截图： 7. Azure Cache for Redis 支持层级 ：仅高级层（premium）缓存支持购买RI。 购买单位： 以节点为单位出售。默认情况下，每个分片包含2个节点。因此，若要为一个分片购买预留，需要购买2份预留容量。 数量核对： 账单是按照单节点计费，您可以通过账单"quantity"列的小时数反向推算。例如，账单显示某日"quantity"为192小时，则购买的预留实例数量为 192 / 24 = 8个（即4个分片，或8个节点）。 参考链接： 预付计算资源的预留费用 - Azure Cache for Redis 购买页面截图： 8. Azure Cosmos DB 购买依据： 根据吞吐量类型购买。 购买单位： 以100 RU/s为单位出售。
例如，您的容器或数据库配置了10,000 RU/s。
-如果部署区域是中国北三或者中国东三，预留折扣比例是0.9411764706，实际预留应用量为10000*0.9411764706= 9411.764706 RU/s，则需要购买95个单位的预留容量；
-如果部署区域是中国北二或者中国东二，预留折扣比例是1，则需要购买100个单位的预留容量。 购买页面截图： 9. 应用服务 支持层级： 仅 Premium v3 和 Isolated v2 实例支持购买RI。 参考链接： Azure 应用服务的预留折扣 购买页面截图： 10. Azure 数据资源管理器 其成本主要分两部分，均可购买RI节省成本： ADX服务加价部分 ：在预留页面选择产品"Azure Data Explorer"，购买量与集群总vCore数一致。例如，如果您的集群正在使用一台 Standard_L8as_v3 虚拟机（该机型提供 8 个 vCore），则加价部分的预留数量应填写 8。 参考链接： 预付 Azure 数据资源管理器标记费用以节省资金 - Azure Data Explorer 购买页面截图： 底层虚拟机部分 ：购买方式与常规虚拟机RI相同，需在账单中识别类别为Microsoft.Kusto的虚拟机资源，并建议开启实例大小灵活性。例如，您可以直接为 Standard_L8as_v3 机型购买虚拟机预留实例。 11. 专用主机 购买信息： 购买方式与虚拟机RI相似，需要根据计划部署的VM系列来选择对应的专用主机SKU。但不是为计划在主机上运行的 虚拟机 购买RI，而是为承载这些虚拟机的 专用主机物理服务器本身 购买RI。可以查看您现有专用主机实例在账单中的MeterName。 成本构成 ：专用主机RI仅节省 计算（硬件） ​ 部分的费用。在其上运行的虚拟机的 软件许可 （如Windows Server、SQL Server）费用是单独计费的。您可以结合 Azure混合权益 来节省这部分软件许可成本 与虚拟机RI的关系 ：专用主机RI和虚拟机RI是 互斥 的。您不能为一台运行在专用主机上的虚拟机同时购买两种RI。专用主机RI的折扣直接应用于主机。 参考链接： 预付 Azure 专用主机以节省资金 - Azure Virtual Machines 购买页面截图： 12. 备份 适用范围 ：Azure备份存储预留容量仅适用于备份保管库标准层中存储的数据，例如虚拟机的备份。 购买选项： 通常以100 TiB或1 PiB为增量单位购买，1 PiB提供更高折扣。 不适用范围： 不适用于受保护的实例成本，也不适用于保管库的存档层。SQL数据库的备份存储不能通过此RI节省成本。 参考链接： 借助预留容量优化 Azure 备份存储的成本 - Azure Backup 购买页面截图： 13. Azure Data Factory -数据流 购买依据： 按照 Azure 区域、计算类型（如“常规用途”、“内存优化”）、内核数量以及期限（1年或3年）购买。 应用方式： 预留购买后，会自动应用于订阅范围内所有符合条件的、正在运行或新部署的Azure Data Factory数据流计算资源，无需手动分配到特定工厂或集成运行时。 购买大小： 汇总同一计算类型下，所有数据流每小时所需的总内核数，可以参考账单的“quantity”倒推。例如，如果您有一个管道使用“内存优化-32核”，另一个计划中的管道使用“常规用途-64核”，且您预计至少使用1年，那么您需要为“内存优化”购买32核，为“常规用途”购买64核的预留。 参考链接： 通过预留容量节省计算成本 - Azure Data Factory 购买页面截图： 三、 通用建议与步骤 1. 分析账单，识别目标 ：详细分析过去数月（特别是业务稳定期）的Azure账单，找出消耗稳定、持续运行且费用较高的服务，作为RI购买的首要目标。 2. 利用工具获取建议 ：在Azure门户购买RI时，对于有些产品来说，系统会分析过去 7 天、30 天和 60 天的每小时用量数据提供“购买建议”。同时，Azure顾问也会在订阅层面提供RI购买建议。 但请勿严格依赖，仅供参考 。 3. 结合Azure混合权益 ：对于Windows Server、SQL Server等自带许可证的工作负载，在购买RI时启用Azure混合权益，可以免除RI中的软件许可费，实现双重节省。 Azure 混合权益 - Azure云计算

zh.raw: ### 一、 核心购买逻辑与应用规则 在开始选择具体产品前，理解RI的核心应用逻辑至关重要，这决定了您的预留是否能被充分利用。 **"不用则失"（Use-it-or-lose-it）原则**：对于绝大多数产品（除Azure Databricks外），RI折扣是按小时应用和计算的。在任意一个小时内，如果您没有运行符合条件的资源来匹配您所购买的RI，那么该小时的预留折扣额度将自动作废，且无法累积或转移到其他时间。因此，RI最适合为需要24小时持续稳定运行的工作负载购买。例如，您购买了一台特定型号虚拟机的RI，只有当该型号的虚拟机在某一小时处于运行状态时，该小时的费用才会享受RI折扣。如果该小时虚拟机被关闭，则折扣失效。 **非容量预留**：购买预留容量不会为您预分配或保留特定的虚拟机或集群资源，它仅提供计费折扣。 参考文档：[确定要购买哪种 Azure 预留项 - Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/cost-management-billing/reservations/determine-reservation-purchase)   ### 二、 各产品RI购买方式与要点 在最终购买前，强烈建议您通过核对您的账单详情以确认资源使用情况。账单的数据是**按天出具**数据，最重要的数据即为账单中的**“quantity”**列。结合账单中的单位（unit of measure），对于稳定运行的可以购买RI的产品，一般操作为将“quantity”的数据除以24小时得出实际部署的单位数量以此推断出我们购买的RI数量。 购买RI需要在订阅上拥有**订阅所有者或预留购买者角色**（如预留的应用范围选择“管理组”，还必须至少具有对管理组的“读取”权限）。 购买时可选择预留的适用范围，包括“管理组”、"单个订阅"、"共享"（整个合约中的所有订阅）或"单个资源组"。购买后也可在RI订单中的“配置”选项中更改此范围。 以下是根据中国区（21V运营）Azure常见产品整理的RI购买关键信息。 #### 1. 虚拟机 **购买依据**：按照虚拟机的具体机型SKU和所在区域购买。购买时，机型可以参考账单中的metername列。如果从此列无法确定具体机型，请根据 **additionalInfo** 列的信息来确定准确的资源系列和规格。目前，对于以下VM机型，由于共享meterID，所以必须检查账单中的“additionalinfo”列，以确定您实际部署的机型。“产品（product）”名称可能无法准确反映您实际部署的配置。 虚拟机Dv2/DSv2系列 虚拟机Dav4/DaSv4系列 虚拟机Dv3/DSv3系列 虚拟机Ev3/ESv3系列 虚拟机Eav4/Easv4系列 虚拟机F/FS系列 **操作系统**：RI购买不区分操作系统（Windows或Linux）。对于Windows虚拟机，RI折扣仅应用于计算部分，Windows许可证费用会在账单中单独计费。您可以结合Azure混合权益进一步节省许可成本。 **实例大小灵活性**：这是RI的一项关键功能。如果启用，购买一个RI可以应用于同一虚拟机系列"灵活性组"内的多种规格。例如，为Dsv3系列购买的RI，可以自动应用于Dsv3系列内不同大小的VM（如Standard\_D2s\_v3, Standard\_D4s\_v3等），使用更灵活，能更好地应对业务变化。 **参考链接：** [了解 Azure 虚拟机预留实例折扣 - Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/cost-management-billing/manage/understand-vm-reservation-charges) [虚拟机大小灵活性 - Azure 虚拟机预留实例 - Azure Virtual Machines](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/virtual-machines/reserved-vm-instance-size-flexibility?toc=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.azure.cn%2Fzh-cn%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json&bc=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.azure.cn%2Fzh-cn%2Fbread%2Ftoc.json) **购买页面截图：** ![image013.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_1.png)   #### 2. Azure Blob 存储 **购买依据**：根据访问层（热、冷、存档）、冗余类型（如LRS, ZRS, GRS）以及容量大小购买。 **应用范围**：应用于存储在Azure Blob（GPv2）和Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2(GPv2)和Blob存储账户（旧Blob存储账户）上的数据。 **最小购买量与单位**：最小购买单位为 100 TB。购买后，折扣适用于选定范围内所有存储账户的累计数据量，而非特定账户或容器。 **应用方式**：按小时应用。例如，购买100TB RI，在某一小时存储了110TB数据，则其中100TB享受RI折扣，超出的10TB按即用即付价格计费。 **不适用范围**：不适用于高级存储帐户、常规用途v1（GPv1）存储帐户、页Blob、Azure队列存储或Azure表存储。 **参考链接：** [借助预留容量优化 Blob 存储的成本 - Azure Storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/storage/blobs/storage-blob-reserved-capacity?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) [了解如何将预留折扣应用到 Azure 存储服务- Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/cost-management-billing/reservations/understand-storage-charges) **购买页面截图：** ![image007.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_2.png)   #### 3. SQL Database 与 SQL Managed Instance **购买依据**：按照性能层（常规用途、业务关键）及vCore数量购买。仅适用于基于vCore的预配计算层购买模型，基于DTU的模型不支持。 **计费方式**：账单按单个vCore每小时计费。例如，一个4 vCore的数据库运行一天，消耗的quantity为： 24小时 \* 4 = 96 vCore小时。则RI购买量为4 **区域冗余**：如果启用了区域冗余（目前仅CN3区域支持），需要同时购买对应vCore的RI和vCoreZR的RI。可结合账单的产品名称和数量推算具体购买的vcore数。 **重要例外**：Azure混合权益（AHB）和RI折扣**不适用于无服务器计算层**。无服务器层数据库无法通过购买RI节省计算成本。 **参考官网链接：** [无服务器计算层 - Azure SQL Database](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/azure-sql/database/serverless-tier-overview?view=azuresql#billing) [使用 Azure 预留节省计算成本 - Azure SQL Database & SQL Managed Instance](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/azure-sql/database/reservations-discount-overview?view=azuresql) **购买页面截图：** ![image014.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_3.png) ![image015.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_4.png)   #### 4. Azure Databricks 预购计划 **核心区别：** 与大多数RI"按小时过期"不同，Databricks预购是购买一个Databricks承诺单位池。在1年或3年期内，您随时使用的Databricks用量都会从这个池中按比例扣除，额度不会按小时失效。 **DBU与DBCU**：购买的是DBCU，而账单计费的是DBU。不同工作负载和层级（标准/高级）消耗DBCU的比率不同（例如，通用计算-高级层的比率为0.583）。这意味着1个DBU的用量可能只消耗0.583个DBCU。 **购买计算**：需要根据账单历史数据预测未来1-3年各工作负载的DBU总用量，再乘以对应的应用比率，汇总得到需要购买的DBCU总量。可以分批购买，先用完再增购。假设环境中使用了**All-purpose Compute -高级层，**一年的DBU用量是10000，那么需要的DBCU量为：10000\*0.583=5830 DBCU；**Jobs Compute -高级层**，一年的DBU用量是10000，那么需要的DBCU量为：10000\*0.318=3180 DBCU。那么共计9010 DBCU，您可根据此量购买DBCU **不支持的操作**：不支持退订及交换。 **注意：** 此RI仅节省DBU费用，底层虚拟机、存储、网络等费用需单独购买相应的RI（如虚拟机RI）来节省。 **参考链接：** [通过预购优化 Azure Databricks 成本 - Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/cost-management-billing/reservations/prepay-databricks-reserved-capacity) **购买页面截图：** ![image016.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_5.png)   #### 5. Azure Synapse Analytics（仅限数据仓库） **购买单位**：以100 DWU(数据仓库单位)为单位出售。 **购买数量：** 请购买与您使用的总DWU相匹配的份数。例如，使用200 DWU，则需要购买2份预留容量。 **不支持的操作**：不支持退订及交换。 **参考链接**： [预留折扣如何应用于 Azure Synapse Analytics（仅限数据仓库）- Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/cost-management-billing/reservations/reservation-discount-azure-sql-dw) **购买页面截图：** ![image018.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_6.png)   #### 6. Azure Database for MySQL / PostgreSQL **购买依据：** 按照性能层级（常规用途、业务关键/内存优化）和vCore数量购买。不支持BS系列即可突发类型的购买。 **购买SKU**： 对于MySQL， 常规用途系列，均按照" **Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server General Purpose Series Compute**"条目购买； 业务关键系列，均按照" **Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server Memory Optimized Series Compute**"条目购买。 对于PostgreSQL，根据实际机型购买即可。 **高可用性(HA)**：如果开启了此功能， Azure会在另一个可用性区域自动部署一个**备用副本**（Standby Replica）。这个备用副本是热备状态，始终在运行以保障故障切换，因此同样会产生计算费用。您需要为**主副本 + 备用副本**的总vCore数购买预留。例如，如果您运行一个**常规用途、16 vCore**的数据库并启用了高可用性，那么实际消耗的计算资源是 **16 vCore (主) + 16 vCore (备) = 32 vCore**。您需要购买**32个vCore**的预留容量。即购买预留实例（RI）的核心逻辑不变，但**需要计算的vCore总数会翻倍**。 **计费方式：** 账单按单个vCore每小时计费，由于存在HA的配置影响，直接看账单中的quantity列会获得更为准确的信息。例如，一个MySQL 机型D4dsv4运行一天，消耗的quantity为： 24小时 \* 4 = 96 vCore小时。则RI购买量为4。如果开启HA，那么消耗的quantity则为192小时，RI的购买量则为8。 **参考链接：** [计算预付费 - Azure Database for MySQL](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/mysql/flexible-server/concept-reserved-pricing?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) [为预留容量的计算资源预付费 - Azure Database for PostgreSQL](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/postgresql/configure-maintain/concepts-reserved-pricing?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) [High-Availability （HA） - 常见问题解答 - Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/mysql/flexible-server/concepts-high-availability-faq) [配置高可用性](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/postgresql/high-availability/how-to-configure-high-availability?tabs=portal-enable-existing-server%2Cportal-disable-existing-server%2Cportal-enable-new-server%2Cportal-forced-failover%2Cportal-planned-failover) **购买页面截图：** ![](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_7.png) ![image021.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_8.png)   #### 7. Azure Cache for Redis **支持层级**：仅高级层（premium）缓存支持购买RI。 **购买单位：** 以节点为单位出售。默认情况下，每个分片包含2个节点。因此，若要为一个分片购买预留，需要购买2份预留容量。 **数量核对：** 账单是按照单节点计费，您可以通过账单"quantity"列的小时数反向推算。例如，账单显示某日"quantity"为192小时，则购买的预留实例数量为 192 / 24 = 8个（即4个分片，或8个节点）。 **参考链接：** [预付计算资源的预留费用 - Azure Cache for Redis](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/azure-cache-for-redis/cache-reserved-pricing?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **购买页面截图：** ![image020.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_9.png)   #### 8. Azure Cosmos DB **购买依据：** 根据吞吐量类型购买。 **购买单位：** 以100 RU/s为单位出售。 例如，您的容器或数据库配置了10,000 RU/s。 -如果部署区域是中国北三或者中国东三，预留折扣比例是0.9411764706，实际预留应用量为10000*0.9411764706= 9411.764706 RU/s，则需要购买95个单位的预留容量； -如果部署区域是中国北二或者中国东二，预留折扣比例是1，则需要购买100个单位的预留容量。 **购买页面截图：** ![image005.png](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_10.png)   #### 9. 应用服务 **支持层级：** 仅 Premium v3 和 Isolated v2 实例支持购买RI。 **参考链接：** [Azure 应用服务的预留折扣](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/cost-management-billing/reservations/reservation-discount-app-service) **购买页面截图：** ![](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_11.png)   #### 10. Azure 数据资源管理器 其成本主要分两部分，均可购买RI节省成本： **ADX服务加价部分**：在预留页面选择产品"Azure Data Explorer"，购买量与集群总vCore数一致。例如，如果您的集群正在使用一台 Standard\_L8as\_v3 虚拟机（该机型提供 8 个 vCore），则加价部分的预留数量应填写 8。 **参考链接：** [预付 Azure 数据资源管理器标记费用以节省资金 - Azure Data Explorer](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/data-explorer/pricing-reserved-capacity) **购买页面截图：** ![](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_12.png) **底层虚拟机部分**：购买方式与常规虚拟机RI相同，需在账单中识别类别为Microsoft.Kusto的虚拟机资源，并建议开启实例大小灵活性。例如，您可以直接为 Standard\_L8as\_v3 机型购买虚拟机预留实例。   #### 11. 专用主机 **购买信息：** 购买方式与虚拟机RI相似，需要根据计划部署的VM系列来选择对应的专用主机SKU。但不是为计划在主机上运行的**虚拟机**购买RI，而是为承载这些虚拟机的**专用主机物理服务器本身**购买RI。可以查看您现有专用主机实例在账单中的MeterName。 **成本构成**：专用主机RI仅节省**计算（硬件）**​ 部分的费用。在其上运行的虚拟机的**软件许可**（如Windows Server、SQL Server）费用是单独计费的。您可以结合**Azure混合权益**来节省这部分软件许可成本 **与虚拟机RI的关系**：专用主机RI和虚拟机RI是**互斥**的。您不能为一台运行在专用主机上的虚拟机同时购买两种RI。专用主机RI的折扣直接应用于主机。 **参考链接：** [预付 Azure 专用主机以节省资金 - Azure Virtual Machines](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/virtual-machines/prepay-dedicated-hosts-reserved-instances?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **购买页面截图：** ![](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_13.png)   #### 12. 备份 **适用范围**：Azure备份存储预留容量仅适用于备份保管库标准层中存储的数据，例如虚拟机的备份。 **购买选项：** 通常以100 TiB或1 PiB为增量单位购买，1 PiB提供更高折扣。 **不适用范围：** 不适用于受保护的实例成本，也不适用于保管库的存档层。SQL数据库的备份存储不能通过此RI节省成本。 **参考链接：** [借助预留容量优化 Azure 备份存储的成本 - Azure Backup](https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/backup/backup-azure-reserved-pricing-optimize-cost?toc=%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **购买页面截图：** ![](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_14.png)   #### 13. Azure Data Factory -数据流 **购买依据：** 按照 Azure 区域、计算类型（如“常规用途”、“内存优化”）、内核数量以及期限（1年或3年）购买。 **应用方式：** 预留购买后，会自动应用于订阅范围内所有符合条件的、正在运行或新部署的Azure Data Factory数据流计算资源，无需手动分配到特定工厂或集成运行时。 **购买大小：** 汇总同一计算类型下，所有数据流每小时所需的总内核数，可以参考账单的“quantity”倒推。例如，如果您有一个管道使用“内存优化-32核”，另一个计划中的管道使用“常规用途-64核”，且您预计至少使用1年，那么您需要为“内存优化”购买32核，为“常规用途”购买64核的预留。 **参考链接：** [通过预留容量节省计算成本 - Azure Data Factory](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/azure/data-factory/data-flow-reserved-capacity-overview?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **购买页面截图：** ![](images\确定要购买的预留项_image_15.png)   ### 三、 通用建议与步骤 **1. 分析账单，识别目标**：详细分析过去数月（特别是业务稳定期）的Azure账单，找出消耗稳定、持续运行且费用较高的服务，作为RI购买的首要目标。 **2. 利用工具获取建议**：在Azure门户购买RI时，对于有些产品来说，系统会分析过去 7 天、30 天和 60 天的每小时用量数据提供“购买建议”。同时，Azure顾问也会在订阅层面提供RI购买建议。**但请勿严格依赖，仅供参考**。 **3. 结合Azure混合权益**：对于Windows Server、SQL Server等自带许可证的工作负载，在购买RI时启用Azure混合权益，可以免除RI中的软件许可费，实现双重节省。[Azure 混合权益 - Azure云计算](https://www.azure.cn/pricing/hybrid-benefit/)

I. Core Purchase Logic and Application Rules

Before selecting specific products, understanding the core application logic of RI is crucial, as it determines whether your reservation can be fully utilized.

"Use-it-or-lose-it" Principle: For the vast majority of products (except Azure Databricks), the RI discount is applied and calculated hourly. In any given hour, if you do not have a running, eligible resource to match the RI you purchased, the reserved discount for that hour is automatically forfeited and cannot be accumulated or transferred to another time. Therefore, RI is most suitable for workloads that require stable, 24/7 operation. For example, if you purchase an RI for a specific VM SKU, the RI discount applies to the charges for that hour only when a VM of that SKU is in the running state. If the VM is stopped during that hour, the discount is lost.

Not a Capacity Reservation:​ Purchasing reserved capacity does not pre-allocate or reserve specific virtual machine or cluster resources for you; it only provides a billing discount.

Reference Documentation:​ Determine what Azure reservation you should purchase - Microsoft Cost Management

 

II. RI Purchase Methods and Key Points for Various Products

Before finalizing a purchase, it is strongly recommended that you verify your resource usage by checking your bill details. Bill data is issued daily, and the most important data is the "quantity" column in the bill. Combined with the bill's "unit of measure," for products with stable operation that are eligible for RI purchase, the general practice is to divide the "quantity" data by 24 hours to derive the actual number of deployed units, thereby inferring the number of RIs we should purchase.

Purchasing an RI requires having either the Subscription Owner or Reservation Purchaser role on the subscription(If the reserved scope is set to "Management Group", you must also have at least "Reader" permissions for the management group.).

At the time of purchase, you can select the scope of the reservation, including "Management Group," "Single Subscription," "Shared" (all subscriptions in the enrollment), or "Single Resource Group." This scope can also be changed later in the "Configuration" option within the RI order.

The following is key RI purchase information compiled for common Azure products in the China region (operated by 21V).

 

1. Virtual Machines

Purchase Basis:​ Purchase based on the specific VM SKU (model) and its region. The SKU can be referenced from the "meterName" column in the bill. If the specific model cannot be determined from this column, use the information in the "additionalInfo" column to identify the accurate resource series and size. Currently, for the following VM models, due to shared meterIDs, it is essential to check the "additionalinfo" column in the bill to identify the sku you actually deployed. The “product”name may not accurately reflect your deployed configuration.

Virtual Machines Dv2/DSv2 Series

Virtual Machines Dav4/DaSv4 Series

Virtual Machines Dv3/DSv3 Series

Virtual Machines Ev3/ESv3 Series

Virtual Machines Eav4/Easv4 Series

Virtual Machines F/FS Series

Operating System:​ RI purchase does not distinguish between operating systems (Windows or Linux). For Windows VMs, the RI discount applies only to the compute portion; Windows license fees are billed separately. You can combine this with Azure Hybrid Benefit for further licensing cost savings.

Instance Size Flexibility:​ This is a key feature of VM’s RI. If enabled, purchasing one RI can apply to multiple sizes within the same VM series "flexibility group." For example, an RI purchased for the Dsv3 series can automatically apply to different VM sizes within the Dsv3 series (e.g., Standard_D2s_v3, Standard_D4s_v3, etc.), offering greater flexibility to adapt to business changes.

Reference Links:

  • Understand Azure Reserved VM Instances discount - Microsoft Cost Management
  • Virtual machine size flexibility -Azure Reserved VM Instances - Azure Virtual Machines

2. Azure Blob Storage

Purchase Basis:​ Purchase based on access tier (Hot, Cool, Archive), redundancy type (e.g., LRS, ZRS, GRS), and capacity size.

Scope of Application:​ Applies to data stored on Azure Blob (GPv2) and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2(GPv2) and blob storage account( old blob storage account).

Minimum Purchase and Unit:​ The minimum purchase unit is 100 TB. After purchase, the discount applies to the cumulative data volume across all storage accounts within the selected scope, not to specific accounts or containers.

Application Method:​ Applied hourly. For example, if you purchase a 100 TB RI and store 110 TB of data in a given hour, then 100 TB enjoys the RI discount, and the excess 10 TB is billed at pay-as-you-go rates.

Exclusions:​ Does not apply to Premium storage accounts, General Purpose v1 (GPv1) storage accounts, Page Blobs, Azure Queue storage, or Azure Table storage.

Reference Links:

  • Optimize costs for Blob storage with reserved capacity - Azure Storage
  • Understand how reservation discounts are applied to Azure storage services - Microsoft Cost Management

3. SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance

Purchase Basis:​ Purchase based on performance tier (General Purpose, Business Critical) and the number of vCores. Only applicable to the vCore-based provisioned compute tier purchasing model. The DTU-based model is not supported.

Billing Method:​ The bill is charged per vCore per hour. For example, a 4 vCore database running for one day consumes a quantity of: 24 hours * 4 = 96 vCore hours. Therefore, the RI purchase quantity would be 4.

Zone Redundancy:​ If zone redundancy is enabled (currently supported only in CN3 region), you need to purchase RIs for both the corresponding vCore and vCoreZR. Refer to the product name and quantity on your bill to calculate the specific number of vCores to purchase.

Important Exception:​ Azure Hybrid Benefit (AHB) and RI discounts do not​ apply to the Serverless compute tier. Serverless tier databases cannot save on compute costs by purchasing RI.

Reference Links:

  • Serverless compute tier - Azure SQL Database
  • Save on compute costs with Azure Reservations - Azure SQL Database & SQL Managed Instance

4. Azure Databricks Pre-Purchase Plan

Core Difference:​ Unlike most RIs where discounts expire hourly, the Databricks Pre-Purchase plan involves buying a pool of Databricks Commitment Units (DBCUs). During the 1- or 3-year term, any Databricks usage you consume is deducted proportionally from this pool at any time; the credits do not expire hourly.

DBU vs. DBCU:​ You purchase DBCUs, but the bill is charged in DBUs. Different workloads and tiers (Standard/Premium) consume DBCUs at different rates (e.g., the ratio for All-Purpose Compute - Premium tier is 0.583). This means 1 DBU of usage may only consume 0.583 DBCUs.

Purchase Calculation:​ You need to forecast the total DBU usage for each workload over the next 1-3 years based on historical billing data, then multiply by the corresponding application ratio, and sum up to get the total DBCU amount to purchase. You can purchase in batches, buying more after the initial pool is used up.

Example: If the environment uses All-Purpose Compute - Premium tier with an annual DBU usage of 10,000, the required DBCU amount is: 10,000 * 0.583 = 5,830 DBCU. For Jobs Compute - Premium tier with an annual DBU usage of 10,000, the required DBCU amount is: 10,000 * 0.318 = 3,180 DBCU. The total would be 9,010 DBCU. You can purchase DBCUs based on this amount.

Unsupported Operations:​ Cancellation and exchange are not supported.

Note:​ This RI only saves on DBU costs. Underlying VM, storage, network, etc., costs require separate RIs (e.g., VM RI) for savings.

Reference Link:​ Optimize Azure Databricks costs with a prepurchase - Microsoft Cost Management

Purchase Quantity:​ Purchase a number of units that matches the total DWU you are using. For example, if you use 200 DWU, you need to purchase 2 units of reserved capacity.

6. Azure Database for MySQL / PostgreSQL

Purchase Basis:​ Purchase based on performance tier (General Purpose, Business Critical/Memory Optimized) and the number of vCores. The Burstable series (e.g., B-series) is not supported for RI purchase.

Purchase SKUs:

For MySQL,

the General Purpose series should always be purchased under the item "Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server General Purpose Series Compute";

the Business Critical series should always be purchased under the item "Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server Memory Optimized Series Compute".

For PostgreSQL, purchase based on the actual instance type.

High Availability (HA):​ If this feature is enabled, Azure automatically deploys a standby replica in another availability zone. This standby replica is in a hot-standby state, always running to ensure failover, and therefore also incurs compute charges. You need to purchase reservations for the total vCores of the primary + standby replicas.

Example: If you run a General Purpose, 16 vCore database with HA enabled, the actual compute resource consumption is 16 vCore (primary) + 16 vCore (standby) = 32 vCores. You need to purchase 32 vCores of reserved capacity. The core logic of purchasing RI remains the same, but the total vCores to calculate doubles.

Billing Method:​ The bill is charged per vCore per hour. Due to the impact of HA configuration, looking directly at the "quantity" column in the bill provides more accurate information.

Example: A MySQL D4dsv4 SKU running for one day consumes a quantity of: 24 hours * 4 = 96 vCore hours. The RI purchase quantity would be 4. If HA is enabled, the consumed quantity would be 192 hours, and the RI purchase quantity would be 8.

Quantity Verification:​ The bill is charged per node. You can calculate backwards from the "quantity" hour count on the bill.

10. Azure Data Explorer

Its costs are mainly divided into two parts, both of which can be saved by purchasing RI:

1. ADX Service Markup Portion:​ On the reservations page, select the product "Azure Data Explorer." The purchase quantity should match the total vCores of the cluster.Example: If your cluster is using one Standard_L8as_v3 VM (which provides 8 vCores), the reserved quantity for the markup portion should be 8.

Reference Link:​ Prepay for Azure Data Explorer markup to save money - Azure Data Explorer

Screenshot of the purchase page：

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5CDetermine_what_to_purchase_image_11.png

2. Underlying Virtual Machine Portion:​ The purchase method is the same as for regular VM RI. You need to identify VM resources with the category "Microsoft.Kusto" in your bill and enable instance size flexibility. Example: You can directly purchase a VM Reserved Instance for the Standard_L8as_v3 SKU.

 

11. Dedicated Host

Purchase Information:​ The purchase method is similar to VM RI. You need to select the corresponding Dedicated Host SKU based on the VM series you plan to deploy on it. However, you are not purchasing RI for the VMs planned to run on the host, but rather for the physical Dedicated Host server itself that will host those VMs. You can check the "MeterName" of your existing Dedicated Host instances in the bill.

Cost Composition:​ Dedicated Host RI only saves costs on the compute (hardware) portion. The software license fees (e.g., for Windows Server, SQL Server) for VMs running on it are billed separately. You can combine this with Azure Hybrid Benefit to save on these software licensing costs.

Relationship with VM RI:​ Dedicated Host RI and VM RI are mutually exclusive. You cannot purchase both types of RI for a VM running on a Dedicated Host. The Dedicated Host RI discount applies directly to the host.

Reference Link:​ Prepay for Azure Dedicated Hosts to save money - Azure Virtual Machines

12. Backup

Scope of Application:​ Azure Backup storage reserved capacity applies only to data stored in the Standard tier of a Backup vault, such as backups of virtual machines.

Purchase Options:​ Typically purchased in increments of 100 TiB or 1 PiB, with 1 PiB offering a higher discount.

Exclusions:​ Does not apply to Protected Instance costs, nor to the Archive tier of the vault. Backup storage for SQL databases cannot be saved through this RI.

Reference Link:​ Optimize costs for Azure Backup Storage with reserved capacity - Azure Backup

Screenshot of the purchase page：

13. Azure Data Factory - Data Flows

Purchase Basis:​ Purchase based on Azure region, compute type (e.g., "General Purpose," "Memory Optimized"), core count, and term (1 or 3 years).

Application Method:​ After the reservation is purchased, it is automatically applied to all eligible, running or newly deployed Azure Data Factory data flow compute resources within the subscription scope. No manual assignment to specific factories or integration runtimes is required.

Purchase Size:​ Aggregate the total core-hours required per hour for all data flows under the same compute type. You can reference the "quantity" on the bill for calculation.

Example: If you have one pipeline using "Memory Optimized - 32 cores" and another planned pipeline using "General Purpose - 64 cores," and you expect to use them for at least 1 year, then you need to purchase a 32-core reservation for "Memory Optimized" and a 64-core reservation for "General Purpose."

Reference Link:​ Save compute costs with reserved capacity - Azure Data Factory

Screenshot of the purchase page：

▧

III. General Recommendations and Steps

  1. Analyze Bills, Identify Targets:​ Conduct a detailed analysis of Azure bills from the past several months (especially during stable business periods) to identify services with stable consumption, continuous operation, and high costs as primary targets for RI purchase.
  2. Utilize Tools for Recommendations:​ When purchasing RI in the Azure portal, for some products, the system analyzes hourly usage data from the past 7, 30, and 60 days to provide "purchase recommendations." Additionally, Azure Advisor provides RI purchase recommendations at the subscription level. Use these as references, but do not rely on them strictly.
  3. Combine with Azure Hybrid Benefit:​ For workloads with bring-your-own licenses, such as Windows Server and SQL Server, enable Azure Hybrid Benefit when purchasing RI. This can waive the software license fees within the RI, achieving double savings.Reference:​ Azure Hybrid Benefit - Azure Cloud Computing
