Core Purchase Logic and Application Rules Before selecting specific products, understanding the core application logic of RI is crucial, as it determines whether your reservation can be fully utilized. "Use-it-or-lose-it" Principle : For the vast majority of products (except Azure Databricks), the RI discount is applied and calculated hourly. In any given hour, if you do not have a running, eligible resource to match the RI you purchased, the reserved discount for that hour is automatically forfeited and cannot be accumulated or transferred to another time. Therefore, RI is most suitable for workloads that require stable, 24/7 operation. For example, if you purchase an RI for a specific VM SKU, the RI discount applies to the charges for that hour only when a VM of that SKU is in the running state. If the VM is stopped during that hour, the discount is lost. Not a Capacity Reservation :​ Purchasing reserved capacity does not pre-allocate or reserve specific virtual machine or cluster resources for you; it only provides a billing discount. Reference Documentation :​ Determine what Azure reservation you should purchase - Microsoft Cost Management II. RI Purchase Methods and Key Points for Various Products Before finalizing a purchase, it is strongly recommended that you verify your resource usage by checking your bill details . Bill data is issued daily, and the most important data is the "quantity" column in the bill. Combined with the bill's "unit of measure," for products with stable operation that are eligible for RI purchase, the general practice is to divide the "quantity" data by 24 hours to derive the actual number of deployed units, thereby inferring the number of RIs we should purchase. Purchasing an RI requires having either the Subscription Owner or Reservation Purchaser role on the subscription(If the reserved scope is set to "Management Group", you must also have at least "Reader" permissions for the management group.). At the time of purchase, you can select the scope of the reservation, including "Management Group," "Single Subscription," "Shared" (all subscriptions in the enrollment), or "Single Resource Group." This scope can also be changed later in the "Configuration" option within the RI order. The following is key RI purchase information compiled for common Azure products in the China region (operated by 21V). 1. Virtual Machines Purchase Basis :​ Purchase based on the specific VM SKU (model) and its region. The SKU can be referenced from the "meterName" column in the bill. If the specific model cannot be determined from this column, use the information in the "additionalInfo" column to identify the accurate resource series and size. Currently, for the following VM models, due to shared meterIDs, it is essential to check the "additionalinfo" column in the bill to identify the sku you actually deployed. The “product”name may not accurately reflect your deployed configuration. Virtual Machines Dv2/DSv2 Series Virtual Machines Dav4/DaSv4 Series Virtual Machines Dv3/DSv3 Series Virtual Machines Ev3/ESv3 Series Virtual Machines Eav4/Easv4 Series Virtual Machines F/FS Series Operating System :​ RI purchase does not distinguish between operating systems (Windows or Linux). For Windows VMs, the RI discount applies only to the compute portion; Windows license fees are billed separately. You can combine this with Azure Hybrid Benefit for further licensing cost savings. Instance Size Flexibility :​ This is a key feature of VM’s RI. If enabled, purchasing one RI can apply to multiple sizes within the same VM series "flexibility group." For example, an RI purchased for the Dsv3 series can automatically apply to different VM sizes within the Dsv3 series (e.g., Standard_D2s_v3, Standard_D4s_v3, etc.), offering greater flexibility to adapt to business changes. Reference Links : Understand Azure Reserved VM Instances discount - Microsoft Cost Management Virtual machine size flexibility -Azure Reserved VM Instances - Azure Virtual Machines Screenshot of the purchase page： 2. Azure Blob Storage Purchase Basis :​ Purchase based on access tier (Hot, Cool, Archive), redundancy type (e.g., LRS, ZRS, GRS), and capacity size. Scope of Application :​ Applies to data stored on Azure Blob (GPv2) and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2(GPv2) and blob storage account( old blob storage account). Minimum Purchase and Unit :​ The minimum purchase unit is 100 TB. After purchase, the discount applies to the cumulative data volume across all storage accounts within the selected scope, not to specific accounts or containers. Application Method :​ Applied hourly. For example, if you purchase a 100 TB RI and store 110 TB of data in a given hour, then 100 TB enjoys the RI discount, and the excess 10 TB is billed at pay-as-you-go rates. Exclusions :​ Does not apply to Premium storage accounts, General Purpose v1 (GPv1) storage accounts, Page Blobs, Azure Queue storage, or Azure Table storage. Reference Links : Optimize costs for Blob storage with reserved capacity - Azure Storage Understand how reservation discounts are applied to Azure storage services - Microsoft Cost Management Screenshot of the purchase page： 3. SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance Purchase Basis :​ Purchase based on performance tier (General Purpose, Business Critical) and the number of vCores. Only applicable to the vCore-based provisioned compute tier purchasing model. The DTU-based model is not supported. Billing Method :​ The bill is charged per vCore per hour. For example, a 4 vCore database running for one day consumes a quantity of: 24 hours * 4 = 96 vCore hours. Therefore, the RI purchase quantity would be 4. Zone Redundancy :​ If zone redundancy is enabled (currently supported only in CN3 region), you need to purchase RIs for both the corresponding vCore and vCoreZR. Refer to the product name and quantity on your bill to calculate the specific number of vCores to purchase. Important Exception :​ Azure Hybrid Benefit (AHB) and RI discounts do not ​ apply to the Serverless compute tier. Serverless tier databases cannot save on compute costs by purchasing RI. Reference Links : Serverless compute tier - Azure SQL Database Save on compute costs with Azure Reservations - Azure SQL Database & SQL Managed Instance Screenshot of the purchase page： 4. Azure Databricks Pre-Purchase Plan Core Difference :​ Unlike most RIs where discounts expire hourly, the Databricks Pre-Purchase plan involves buying a pool of Databricks Commitment Units (DBCUs). During the 1- or 3-year term, any Databricks usage you consume is deducted proportionally from this pool at any time; the credits do not expire hourly. DBU vs. DBCU :​ You purchase DBCUs, but the bill is charged in DBUs. Different workloads and tiers (Standard/Premium) consume DBCUs at different rates (e.g., the ratio for All-Purpose Compute - Premium tier is 0.583). This means 1 DBU of usage may only consume 0.583 DBCUs. Purchase Calculation :​ You need to forecast the total DBU usage for each workload over the next 1-3 years based on historical billing data, then multiply by the corresponding application ratio, and sum up to get the total DBCU amount to purchase. You can purchase in batches, buying more after the initial pool is used up. Example: If the environment uses All-Purpose Compute - Premium tier with an annual DBU usage of 10,000, the required DBCU amount is: 10,000 * 0.583 = 5,830 DBCU. For Jobs Compute - Premium tier with an annual DBU usage of 10,000, the required DBCU amount is: 10,000 * 0.318 = 3,180 DBCU. The total would be 9,010 DBCU. You can purchase DBCUs based on this amount. Unsupported Operations :​ Cancellation and exchange are not supported. Note :​ This RI only saves on DBU costs. Underlying VM, storage, network, etc., costs require separate RIs (e.g., VM RI) for savings. Reference Link :​ Optimize Azure Databricks costs with a prepurchase - Microsoft Cost Management Screenshot of the purchase page： 5. Azure Synapse Analytics (Data Warehouse only) Purchase Unit :​ Sold in units of 100 DWU (Data Warehouse Units). Purchase Quantity :​ Purchase a number of units that matches the total DWU you are using. For example, if you use 200 DWU, you need to purchase 2 units of reserved capacity. Reference Link :​ How reservation discounts apply to Azure Synapse Analytics (data warehousing only) - Microsoft Cost Management Screenshot of the purchase page： 6. Azure Database for MySQL / PostgreSQL Purchase Basis :​ Purchase based on performance tier (General Purpose, Business Critical/Memory Optimized) and the number of vCores. The Burstable series (e.g., B-series) is not supported for RI purchase. Purchase SKUs : For MySQL, the General Purpose series should always be purchased under the item "Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server General Purpose Series Compute"; the Business Critical series should always be purchased under the item "Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server Memory Optimized Series Compute". For PostgreSQL, purchase based on the actual instance type. High Availability (HA) :​ If this feature is enabled, Azure automatically deploys a standby replica in another availability zone. This standby replica is in a hot-standby state, always running to ensure failover, and therefore also incurs compute charges. You need to purchase reservations for the total vCores of the primary + standby replicas. Example: If you run a General Purpose, 16 vCore database with HA enabled, the actual compute resource consumption is 16 vCore (primary) + 16 vCore (standby) = 32 vCores. You need to purchase 32 vCores of reserved capacity. The core logic of purchasing RI remains the same, but the total vCores to calculate doubles. Billing Method :​ The bill is charged per vCore per hour. Due to the impact of HA configuration, looking directly at the "quantity" column in the bill provides more accurate information. Example: A MySQL D4dsv4 SKU running for one day consumes a quantity of: 24 hours * 4 = 96 vCore hours. The RI purchase quantity would be 4. If HA is enabled, the consumed quantity would be 192 hours, and the RI purchase quantity would be 8. You can calculate backwards from the "quantity" hour count on the bill. Example: If the bill shows a "quantity" of 192 hours for a day, the number of reserved instances to purchase is 192 / 24 = 8 (i.e., 4 shards, or 8 nodes). Reference Link :​ Prepay for compute with reservations - Azure Cache for Redis Screenshot of the purchase page： 8. Azure Cosmos DB Purchase Basis :​ Purchase based on throughput type. Purchase Unit :  Sold in units of 100 RU/s.
For example, your container or database is configured for 10,000 RU/s.

If HA is enabled, the consumed quantity would be 192 hours, and the RI purchase quantity would be 8. **Reference Links**: * [Prepay for Compute - Azure Database for MySQL](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/mysql/flexible-server/concept-reserved-pricing?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) * [Prepay for compute resources with reserved capacity - Azure Database for PostgreSQL](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/postgresql/configure-maintain/concepts-reserved-pricing?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) * [High-Availability (HA) - FAQ - Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server](https://docs.azure.cn/en-us/mysql/flexible-server/concepts-high-availability-faq) * [Configure High Availability](https://docs.azure.cn/en-us/postgresql/high-availability/how-to-configure-high-availability?tabs=portal-enable-existing-server%2Cportal-disable-existing-server%2Cportal-enable-new-server%2Cportal-forced-failover%2Cportal-planned-failover) **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_6.png) ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_7.png)   #### 7. Azure Cache for Redis **Supported Tier**:​ Only Premium tier support purchasing RI. **Purchase Unit**:​ Sold per node. By default, each shard contains 2 nodes. Therefore, to purchase a reservation for one shard, you need to purchase 2 units of reserved capacity. **Quantity Verification**:​ The bill is charged per node. You can calculate backwards from the "quantity" hour count on the bill. Example: If the bill shows a "quantity" of 192 hours for a day, the number of reserved instances to purchase is 192 / 24 = 8 (i.e., 4 shards, or 8 nodes). **Reference Link**:​ [Prepay for compute with reservations - Azure Cache for Redis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-cache-for-redis/cache-reserved-pricing?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_8.png)   #### 8. Azure Cosmos DB **Purchase Basis**:​ Purchase based on throughput type. **Purchase Unit**: Sold in units of 100 RU/s. For example, your container or database is configured for 10,000 RU/s. -For China North 3 and China East 3 regions, the reservation discount ratio is 0.9411764706. The computation equals 9411.764706 RU/s of billable or normalized usage. This value is computed as: 10000 × 0.9411764706 = 9411.764706. You need to purchase 95 units of reserved capacity. -For China North 2 and China East 2 regions, the reservation discount ratio is 1.0, so you need to purchase 100 units of reserved capacity. **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_9.png)   #### 9. App Service **Supported Tiers**:​ Only Premium v3 and Isolated v2 instances support purchasing RI. **Reference Link**:​ [Reservation discounts for Azure App Service - Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/en-us/cost-management-billing/reservations/reservation-discount-app-service) **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_10.png)   #### 10. Azure Data Explorer Its costs are mainly divided into two parts, both of which can be saved by purchasing RI: **1. ADX Service Markup Portion**:​ On the reservations page, select the product "Azure Data Explorer." The purchase quantity should match the total vCores of the cluster.Example: If your cluster is using one Standard\_L8as\_v3 VM (which provides 8 vCores), the reserved quantity for the markup portion should be 8. **Reference Link**:​ [Prepay for Azure Data Explorer markup to save money - Azure Data Explorer](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/data-explorer/pricing-reserved-capacity) **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_11.png) **2. Underlying Virtual Machine Portion**:​ The purchase method is the same as for regular VM RI. You need to identify VM resources with the category "Microsoft.Kusto" in your bill and enable instance size flexibility. Example: You can directly purchase a VM Reserved Instance for the Standard\_L8as\_v3 SKU.   #### 11. Dedicated Host **Purchase Information**:​ The purchase method is similar to VM RI. You need to select the corresponding Dedicated Host SKU based on the VM series you plan to deploy on it. However, you are not purchasing RI for the VMs planned to run on the host, but rather for the physical Dedicated Host server itself that will host those VMs. You can check the "MeterName" of your existing Dedicated Host instances in the bill. **Cost Composition**:​ Dedicated Host RI only saves costs on the compute (hardware) portion. The software license fees (e.g., for Windows Server, SQL Server) for VMs running on it are billed separately. You can combine this with Azure Hybrid Benefit to save on these software licensing costs. **Relationship with VM RI**:​ Dedicated Host RI and VM RI are mutually exclusive. You cannot purchase both types of RI for a VM running on a Dedicated Host. The Dedicated Host RI discount applies directly to the host. **Reference Link**:​ [Prepay for Azure Dedicated Hosts to save money - Azure Virtual Machines](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/prepay-dedicated-hosts-reserved-instances?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_12.png)   #### 12. Backup **Scope of Application**:​ Azure Backup storage reserved capacity applies only to data stored in the Standard tier of a Backup vault, such as backups of virtual machines. **Purchase Options**:​ Typically purchased in increments of 100 TiB or 1 PiB, with 1 PiB offering a higher discount. **Exclusions**:​ Does not apply to Protected Instance costs, nor to the Archive tier of the vault. Backup storage for SQL databases cannot be saved through this RI. **Reference Link**:​ [Optimize costs for Azure Backup Storage with reserved capacity - Azure Backup](https://docs.azure.cn/en-us/backup/backup-azure-reserved-pricing-optimize-cost?toc=%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_13.png)   #### 13. Azure Data Factory - Data Flows **Purchase Basis**:​ Purchase based on Azure region, compute type (e.g., "General Purpose," "Memory Optimized"), core count, and term (1 or 3 years). **Application Method**:​ After the reservation is purchased, it is automatically applied to all eligible, running or newly deployed Azure Data Factory data flow compute resources within the subscription scope. No manual assignment to specific factories or integration runtimes is required. **Purchase Size**:​ Aggregate the total core-hours required per hour for all data flows under the same compute type. You can reference the "quantity" on the bill for calculation. Example: If you have one pipeline using "Memory Optimized - 32 cores" and another planned pipeline using "General Purpose - 64 cores," and you expect to use them for at least 1 year, then you need to purchase a 32-core reservation for "Memory Optimized" and a 64-core reservation for "General Purpose." **Reference Link**:​ [Save compute costs with reserved capacity - Azure Data Factory](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/data-factory/data-flow-reserved-capacity-overview?toc=%2Fazure%2Fcost-management-billing%2Freservations%2Ftoc.json) **Screenshot of the purchase page：** ![](images\Determine_what_to_purchase_image_14.png)   ### **III. General Recommendations and Steps** 1. **Analyze Bills, Identify Targets**:​ Conduct a detailed analysis of Azure bills from the past several months (especially during stable business periods) to identify services with stable consumption, continuous operation, and high costs as primary targets for RI purchase. 2. **Utilize Tools for Recommendations**:​ When purchasing RI in the Azure portal, for some products, the system analyzes hourly usage data from the past 7, 30, and 60 days to provide "purchase recommendations." Additionally, Azure Advisor provides RI purchase recommendations at the subscription level. **Use these as references, but do not rely on them strictly.** 3. **Combine with Azure Hybrid Benefit**:​ For workloads with bring-your-own licenses, such as Windows Server and SQL Server, enable Azure Hybrid Benefit when purchasing RI. This can waive the software license fees within the RI, achieving double savings.**Reference**:​ [Azure Hybrid Benefit - Azure Cloud Computing](https://www.azure.cn/en-us/pricing/hybrid-benefit/)

1. 购买预留需要什么权限？

购买RI需要在订阅上拥有订阅所有者或预留购买者角色。（如果客户在购买时，将预留的应用范围选择为 “管理组”，那么该用户还必须至少拥有对该管理组的“读取”权限。）

 

2. 预留范围是什么？应该如何选择？

预留范围决定了预留的应用范围。您可以根据管理需求在购买时或购买后随时调整。主要有四个选项：

单个资源组范围：预留仅应用到所选资源组中匹配的资源。

单个订阅范围：预留应用到所选订阅中匹配的资源。

共享范围：预留应用到计费对象信息中所有符合条件的订阅。这是最灵活、最能确保折扣被充分利用的范围。

管理组范围：折扣应用到属于该管理组内所有订阅的匹配资源。

 

3. 预留实例购买后能否调整应用范围？

可以。在Azure门户“预留”中选择目标预留，进入“配置”更改范围（如从单个订阅改为共享或管理组）。

 

4. RI应用范围，如设定为 “单个资源组” ，后面将此资源组删除了，RI是否会自动应用于其他资源组？

RI不会应用到其他资源组，如不修改应用范围会造成此RI的浪费，客户可以在RI的配置界面，手动修改RI的应用范围。

 

5. Azure预留购买期限何时开始？

Azure预留期限在购买后立即开始。目前，无法购买未来日期的Azure预留。Azure预留将立即应用于与所选属性匹配的任何现有资源，具体取决于你将预留实例的范围限定为特定的订阅、资源组或管理组或者限定在Billing Profile级别。

 

6. 什么是实例大小灵活性？

实例大小灵活性是与Azure虚拟机预留实例关联的一项功能。实例大小灵活性会自动将Azure虚拟机预留实例应用于在同一区域且同一预留实例VM组中使用的任意VM。 虚拟机大小灵活性 - Azure 虚拟机预留实例 - Azure Virtual Machines

 

7. 可以应用虚拟机RI的服务有哪些？

虚拟机、虚拟机规模集、容器服务、Azure Batch部署、Azure Kubernetes服务 (AKS)、Service Fabric。

打开实例大小灵活性设置后，当ConsumedService为以下任一项时，预留折扣将自动应用于匹配的VM使用量

Microsoft.Compute

Microsoft.ClassicCompute

Microsoft.Batch

Microsoft.MachineLearningServices（Machine Learning）

Microsoft.Kusto（Data Explorer）

 

8. RI下单界面节省百分比是否考虑了合约折扣？

是，建议基于实际按需使用情况和成本（包括任何议定的按需折扣）生成。

 

9. 购买RI大约可以打几折？

最多可节省72%（即28折），取决于产品类型和购买年限（1年或3年）。

 

10. 对于共用一个Meter ID的虚拟机，可以共享RI吗？

是否可以共享RI，取决于是否开启了实例大小灵活性，并且是否属于同一实例大小灵活组。例如Dv2和DSv2系列虽然Meter ID相同，但系列不同，需分别购买对应系列的RI。可通过账单附加信息确认具体机型。

 

11. 预留实例开启“自动续订”后，自动续订的新RI订单的自动续订状态默认是开启还是关闭？

自动续订的新RI订单的自动续订状态默认为关闭。如需自动续订，需在新预留生效后手动开启。

en.html:
1. What permissions are required to purchase a reservation?

Purchasing an RI requires the user to have the Subscription Owner or Reservation Purchaser role on the subscription. (If the customer selects "Management Group" as the reservation's scope during purchase, the user must also have at least "Read" permissions on that management group.)

 

2. What is a reservation scope? How should I choose one?

The reservation scope determines where the reservation benefit applies. You can adjust the scope at the time of purchase or any time after purchase based on your management needs. There are four main options:

Single Resource Group scope: The reservation applies only to matching resources within the selected resource group.

Single Subscription scope: The reservation applies only to matching resources within the selected subscription.

Shared scope: The reservation applies to all eligible subscriptions within the billing profile. This is the most flexible option and helps ensure maximum discount utilization.

Management Group scope: The discount applies to matching resources in all subscriptions that are part of the management group.

 

3. Can I change the scope of a reservation after purchase?

Yes. In the Azure portal, navigate to "Reservations", select the target reservation, go to "Configuration", and change the scope (e.g., from a single subscription to shared or management group).

 

4. If an RI's scope is set to "Single Resource Group" and that resource group is later deleted, will the RI automatically apply to other resource groups?

No, the RI will not automatically apply to other resource groups. If the scope is not modified, this will lead to wasted RI benefit. Customers can manually change the RI's scope in the reservation configuration settings.

 

5. When does the Azure reservation purchase term begin?

The Azure reservation term begins immediately after purchase. Currently, it is not possible to purchase an Azure reservation for a future date. Azure reservations are applied immediately to any existing resources that match the selected attributes, depending on whether you scope the reserved instance to a specific subscription, resource group, management group, or at the billing profile level.

 

6. What is instance size flexibility?

Instance size flexibility is a feature associated with Azure Reserved Virtual Machine Instances. It automatically applies to any VM used within the same region and belonging to the same instance size flexibility group.

Virtual machine size flexibility with Reserved VM Instances

 

7. Which services can apply VM RI benefits?

The instance size flexibility setting determines which services get the reserved instance discounts.

Whether the setting is on or off, reservation discounts automatically apply to any matching VM usage when the ConsumedService is Microsoft.Compute. So, check your usage data for the ConsumedService value. Some examples include:

Virtual machines

Virtual machine scale sets

Container service

Azure Batch deployments

Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Service Fabric

When the setting is on, reservation discounts automatically apply to matching VM usage when the ConsumedService is any of the following items:

Microsoft.Compute

Microsoft.ClassicCompute

Microsoft.Batch

Microsoft.MachineLearningServices

Microsoft.Kusto

 

8. Does the savings percentage shown on the RI purchase page account for negotiated discounts?

Yes, the savings are calculated in addition to your negotiated prices (or discounted prices, if applicable).

 

9. What is the approximate discount I would receive by purchasing an RI?

Savings can be up to 72% (equivalent to a 28% discount on pay-as-you-go rates), depending on the product type and the term commitment (1-year or 3-year).

 

10. Can VMs sharing the same Meter ID share a single RI?

Whether VMs can share an RI depends on whether instance size flexibility is enabled and if the VMs belong to the same instance size flexibility group. For example, Dv2 and DSv2 series might share the same Meter ID but belong to different size groups, requiring separate RIs for each series. You can verify the specific VM type by checking the additionalInfo field in your billing usage report.

 

11. When "Auto renewal" is enabled for a reservation, is the auto-renewal status for the new order (created by the auto-renewal) turned on or off by default?

### 1. What permissions are required to purchase a reservation?

  
Purchasing an RI requires the user to have the Subscription Owner or Reservation Purchaser role on the subscription. (If the customer selects "Management Group" as the reservation's scope during purchase, the user must also have at least "Read" permissions on that management group.)

 
### 2. What is a reservation scope? How should I choose one?

  
The reservation scope determines where the reservation benefit applies. You can adjust the scope at the time of purchase or any time after purchase based on your management needs. There are four main options:

**Single Resource Group scope:** The reservation applies only to matching resources within the selected resource group.

**Single Subscription scope:** The reservation applies only to matching resources within the selected subscription.

**Shared scope:** The reservation applies to all eligible subscriptions within the billing profile. This is the most flexible option and helps ensure maximum discount utilization.

**Management Group scope:** The discount applies to matching resources in all subscriptions that are part of the management group.

 
### 3. Can I change the scope of a reservation after purchase?

  
Yes. In the Azure portal, navigate to "Reservations", select the target reservation, go to "Configuration", and change the scope (e.g., from a single subscription to shared or management group).

 
### 4. If an RI's scope is set to "Single Resource Group" and that resource group is later deleted, will the RI automatically apply to other resource groups?

  
No, the RI will not automatically apply to other resource groups. If the scope is not modified, this will lead to wasted RI benefit. Customers can manually change the RI's scope in the reservation configuration settings.

 
### 5. When does the Azure reservation purchase term begin?

  
The Azure reservation term begins immediately after purchase. Currently, it is not possible to purchase an Azure reservation for a future date. Azure reservations are applied immediately to any existing resources that match the selected attributes, depending on whether you scope the reserved instance to a specific subscription, resource group, management group, or at the billing profile level.

 
### 6. What is instance size flexibility?

  
Instance size flexibility is a feature associated with Azure Reserved Virtual Machine Instances. It automatically applies to any VM used within the same region and belonging to the same instance size flexibility group.

[Virtual machine size flexibility with Reserved VM Instances](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/reserved-vm-instance-size-flexibility) 

 
### 7. Which services can apply VM RI benefits?

  
The instance size flexibility setting determines which services get the reserved instance discounts.

Whether the setting is on or off, reservation discounts automatically apply to any matching VM usage when the _ConsumedService_ is Microsoft.Compute. So, check your usage data for the _ConsumedService_ value. Some examples include:

Virtual machines

Virtual machine scale sets

Container service

Azure Batch deployments 

Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Service Fabric

When the setting is on, reservation discounts automatically apply to matching VM usage when the _ConsumedService_ is any of the following items:

Microsoft.Compute

Microsoft.ClassicCompute

Microsoft.Batch

Microsoft.MachineLearningServices

Microsoft.Kusto

 
### 8. Does the savings percentage shown on the RI purchase page account for negotiated discounts?

  
Yes, the savings are calculated in addition to your negotiated prices (or discounted prices, if applicable).

 
### 9. What is the approximate discount I would receive by purchasing an RI? 

Savings can be up to 72% (equivalent to a 28% discount on pay-as-you-go rates), depending on the product type and the term commitment (1-year or 3-year).

 
### 10. Can VMs sharing the same Meter ID share a single RI?

  
Whether VMs can share an RI depends on whether instance size flexibility is enabled and if the VMs belong to the same instance size flexibility group. For example, Dv2 and DSv2 series might share the same Meter ID but belong to different size groups, requiring separate RIs for each series. You can verify the specific VM type by checking the _additionalInfo_ field in your billing usage report.

 
### 11. When "Auto renewal" is enabled for a reservation, is the auto-renewal status for the new order (created by the auto-renewal) turned on or off by default?

  
The auto-renewal status for the new RI order is turned off by default. If you require auto-renewal, you need to manually enable it after the new reservation takes effect.

1. Azure节省计划与Azure虚拟机预留实例之间有什么区别？

使用预留实例，可以选择实例系列、大小和区域，仅当满足所有这些要求时，才会应用。使用适用于计算的Azure节省计划，只需承诺每小时金额。你可以同时使用预留实例和节省计划。在储蓄计划与预留之间决定 - Microsoft Cost Management

 

2. 购买后，节省计划期限从何时开始计算？

该期限从购买后立即开始计算。例如，如果在中午12点19分购买节省计划，该期限将涵盖从中午12点开始的使用情况。

 

3. Azure节省计划如何收费？

购买节省计划时，可以选择一次性支付（预付）或在节省计划期限内按月等额支付。预付和按月支付的总费用没有区别。

 

4. Savings Plan涵盖哪些计算产品

目前，Savings Plan涵盖以下产品的计算费用。它不涵盖软件、网络或存储等费用。

Azure虚拟机

Azure应用服务

Azure Functions高级计划

Azure容器实例

Azure专用主机

Azure容器应用

Azure Spring应用程序企业

用于AKS和AVD的虚拟机都符合节省计划的条件。

 

5. 节省计划的范围是什么？如何选择？

范围决定了折扣的应用广度，可以在购买时或购买后随时调整。主要范围包括：

单个资源组范围：节省计划仅应用到所选资源组中匹配的资源。

单个订阅范围：节省计划应用到所选订阅中匹配的资源。

共享范围：节省计划应用到计费对象信息中所有符合条件的订阅。这是最灵活、最能确保折扣被充分利用的范围。

管理组范围：折扣应用到属于该管理组内所有订阅的匹配资源。

 

6. 节省计划可以取消或退款吗？

不可以。这是节省计划与预留实例最大的区别之一。 所有节省计划购买均不可取消、不可退款、不可交换。一旦购买，客户即承诺了整个期限的每小时支出。因此，在购买前仔细评估建议和自身需求至关重要。

 

7. 是否可以取消计划或修改节省计划的每小时金额？

承诺支出后，无法修改或取消节省计划。如果你的用量需求超出当前的节省计划，则可以购买另一个节省计划。

 

8. 购买节省计划后如何配置操作系统（OS）？

节省计划与操作系统无关，同样适用于基础结构成本，而不考虑部署的操作系统。因此，节省计划不需要限定于特定操作系统，并且将自动覆盖混合环境。
如果在VM上部署了SQL Server或Windows Server，则可以使用Azure 混合权益 - Azure云计算 的许可或支付Windows Server许可费率。

1. What is the difference between Azure Savings Plan and Azure Reserved VM Instances?

With reserved instance, you select instance family, size, and region, and the savings will only apply if all these requirements are met. With Azure savings plan for compute, you’re only committing to an hourly amount.
Reserved Instances continue to be available for purchase. You may leverage both Reserved Instances and the savings plan the same time. Learn more.

 

2. When does the Savings Plan term start after purchase?

The term begins immediately after purchase. For example, if you purchase a savings plan at 12:19 PM, the term will cover usage starting from 12:00 PM that day.

 

3. How is Azure Savings Plan billed?

When purchasing a savings plan, you have the option to pay in a single payment (upfront) or in equal monthly payments over the term of the savings plan. There’s no difference in total cost when paying upfront or monthly.

 

4. Which products are covered by a Savings Plan?

Currently, Savings Plans cover compute costs for the following products. It does not cover costs for software, networking, or storage.

  • Azure Virtual Machines
  • Azure App Service
  • Azure Functions Premium plan
  • Azure Container Instances
  • Azure Dedicated Hosts
  • Azure Container Apps
  • Azure Spring Apps Enterprise
    VMs for AKS and AVD are also eligible for Savings Plan benefits.

 

5. What is the Savings Plan scope? How do I choose one?

The scope determines how broadly the discount applies. It can be adjusted at purchase or anytime afterward. The main scope options include:

  • Single Resource Group scope: The benefit applies only to matching resources within the selected resource group.
  • Single Subscription scope: The benefit applies only to matching resources within the selected subscription.
  • Shared scope: The benefit applies to all eligible subscriptions within the billing profile. This is the most flexible option to maximize utilization.
  • Management Group scope: The benefit applies to matching resources in all subscriptions under the management group.

 

6. Can I cancel or get a refund for a Savings Plan?

No. This is one of the biggest differences between Savings Plans and RIs. All Savings Plan purchases are final: they cannot be canceled, refunded, or exchanged. Once purchased, the customer is committed to the hourly spend for the entire term. Therefore, carefully evaluating recommendations and your own requirements before purchasing is critical.

 

7. Can I cancel the plan or modify the hourly commitment amount of my Savings Plan?

Once committed, you cannot modify or cancel a savings plan. If your usage requires more than your current savings plan commitment, you can purchase another savings plan.

 

8. How do I configure the operating system (OS) when purchasing a Savings Plan?

Savings plans are OS-agnostic and apply equally to the underlying infrastructure costs regardless of the operating system deployed. Thus, savings plans don’t need to be scoped for a particular OS and will automatically cover a mixed environment.

If SQL Server or Windows Server are deployed on the VM, you may use a license you already own with Azure Hybrid Benefit - Azure Cloud Computing  or pay the Windows Server licensing rate.

It does not cover costs for software, networking, or storage. * Azure Virtual Machines * Azure App Service * Azure Functions Premium plan * Azure Container Instances * Azure Dedicated Hosts * Azure Container Apps * Azure Spring Apps Enterprise VMs for AKS and AVD are also eligible for Savings Plan benefits.   ### 5. What is the Savings Plan scope? How do I choose one? The scope determines how broadly the discount applies. It can be adjusted at purchase or anytime afterward. The main scope options include: * **Single Resource Group scope:** The benefit applies only to matching resources within the selected resource group. * **Single Subscription scope:** The benefit applies only to matching resources within the selected subscription. * **Shared scope:** The benefit applies to all eligible subscriptions within the billing profile. This is the most flexible option to maximize utilization. * **Management Group scope:** The benefit applies to matching resources in all subscriptions under the management group.   ### 6. Can I cancel or get a refund for a Savings Plan? **No.** This is one of the biggest differences between Savings Plans and RIs. All Savings Plan purchases are final: they cannot be canceled, refunded, or exchanged. Once purchased, the customer is committed to the hourly spend for the entire term. Therefore, carefully evaluating recommendations and your own requirements before purchasing is critical.   ### 7. Can I cancel the plan or modify the hourly commitment amount of my Savings Plan? Once committed, you cannot modify or cancel a savings plan. If your usage requires more than your current savings plan commitment, you can purchase another savings plan.   ### 8. How do I configure the operating system (OS) when purchasing a Savings Plan? Savings plans are OS-agnostic and apply equally to the underlying infrastructure costs regardless of the operating system deployed. Thus, savings plans don’t need to be scoped for a particular OS and will automatically cover a mixed environment. If SQL Server or Windows Server are deployed on the VM, you may use a license you already own with [Azure Hybrid Benefit - Azure Cloud Computing](https://www.azure.cn/en-us/pricing/hybrid-benefit/)  or pay the Windows Server licensing rate.

付款通知书一般为PDF格式，载明有缴费清单、收款账户信息、账单到期日等信息。

请在账单到期前缴纳全部含税费用，避免服务受到影响。

 

术语 说明
付款方 在间接模式（Indirect Model）下，付款方为合作伙伴，即由世纪互联授权其向客户分销产品的公司；在直接模式（Direct Model）下，付款方为客户。
客户编码 由系统生成的唯一客户编号, 以“001”开头。
合约编号 以“V570”开头的数字，系统生成的唯一合约编号，和蓝云发票管理系统的纸质合同号一致，便于客户/合作伙伴对账以及跟踪后续的发票和付款情况。
账单编号 009”开头的数字，系统生成的唯一账单编号，和蓝云发票管理系统显示的账单编号一致，用于跟踪后续的发票和付款情况。
发票号码 系统自动生成的位于发票右上角的编号。
产品名称 通过签署OSPA订单使用的产品名称。
账单金额 客户/合作伙伴应支付的款项，为含税额。
账期 账期，通常为“30天”，指在账单日期后的30天内付款。
到期日 对应账单的付款截止日期。
客户名称 客户/最终用户。
付款信息 收款方(即世纪互联蓝云) 的收款银行账户相关信息。

zh.html:
注册于中国大陆地区且有效存续的客户实体，可通过签署世纪互联在线服务高级协议（OSPA）购买由世纪互联运营的 Azure、M365、D365 和 Power Platform 在线服务。

💡特别说明：

  • 对于计划订阅Microsoft Azure云服务的客户——无论是新签客户或OSPA即将到期的客户，请选择 “新商务模式”（21VCA-E）签约，具体操作指南请参照21VCA-E Playbook。

  • 对于已有OSPA Azure合约的客户，希望继续使用由世纪互联运营的Microsoft Azure云服务，需要在OSPA合约到期前，提前预留时间，完成从OSPA到21VCA的订阅手动迁移的操作。在OSPA合约到期后，服务终止，订阅将无法迁移，服务的终止将会对客户服务的使用造成影响，如需迁移支持，可以访问Azure 支持 获得帮助。

世纪互联在线服务高级协议（OSPA）支持两种签约交易结构：直签模式 (Direct Model )和间接模式（Indirect Model）。

 

直签模式 间接模式
协议 客户与世纪互联直接签署OSPA 客户与合作伙伴与世纪互联签署OSPA
产品 适用于由世纪互联运营的Azure、M365、D365 和 Power Platform 适用于由世纪互联运营的Azure、M365、D365 和 Power Platform
协议有效期 3 年，到期续签 3 年，到期续签
计费和付款 客户向世纪互联支付费用 客户向合作伙伴支付费用

en.html:
Customer entities registered and valid in Mainland China can purchase Azure, M365, D365, and Power Platform online services operated by 21Vianet by signing the 21Vianet Online Services Premium Agreement.

💡Special Notes:

  • Customers intending to purchase Microsoft Azure Products-whether new customers or existing customers whose OSPA is about to expire-should select the “New Commerce”(21VCA-E). For specific operation guidance, please refer to 21VCA-E Playbook

  • For Customers who already have an OSPA Azure contract and wish to continue using Microsoft Azure cloud services, they need to reserve time in advance to complete the manual subscription migration from OSPA to 21VCA before the expiration of OSPA. After the OSPA contracts expire and services are terminated, the subscription cannot be migrated. The termination of the service will have an impact on the use of customer service. For migration support, please visit Azure support get help.

OSPA supports two types of contracting transaction structures: Direct Model and Indirect Model.

 

Direct Model Indirect Model
Agreement Customers sign the OSPA directly with 21Vianet Customers and partners sign the OSPA with 21Vianet
Product Available for Azure, M365, D365, and Power Platform operated by 21Vianet Available for Azure, M365, D365, and Power Platform operated by 21Vianet
Agreement Validity 3 years, renewed when expired 3 years, renewed when expired
Billing and Payment The customer pays the fee to 21Vianet The customer pays the fee to partner

For specific operation guidance, please refer to [21VCA-E Playbook](/en-us/document/21VCA-E/introduction-to-new-commerce) * For Customers who already have an OSPA Azure contract and wish to continue using Microsoft Azure cloud services, they need to reserve time in advance to complete the manual subscription migration from OSPA to 21VCA before the expiration of OSPA. After the OSPA contracts expire and services are terminated, the subscription cannot be migrated. The termination of the service will have an impact on the use of customer service. For migration support, please visit [Azure support](https://support.azure.cn/zh-cn/support/contact) get help. OSPA supports two types of contracting transaction structures: Direct Model and Indirect Model.  
Direct Model Indirect Model
Agreement Customers sign the OSPA directly with 21Vianet Customers and partners sign the OSPA with 21Vianet
Product Available for Azure, M365, D365, and Power Platform operated by 21Vianet Available for Azure, M365, D365, and Power Platform operated by 21Vianet
Agreement Validity 3 years, renewed when expired 3 years, renewed when expired
Billing and Payment The customer pays the fee to 21Vianet The customer pays the fee to partner

对于由世纪互联运营的Azure、M365、D365 及 Power Platform在下单时，需要满足最低起购量，概述如下：

Microsoft Azure产品订购：

最低订单要求，初始和校正年度订单中年度金额承诺（MC）和预付费实例（CPP）总金额必须至少为每个合同年度总金额5万元人民币（未税）。

💡特别说明： 目前，Azure 产品签署模式已经由OSPA转换为全新商务模式（21VCA-E），详细请参考：21VCA-E 新商务模式介绍

 

Microsoft 365 产品订购：

  • 最低许可证数量为A部分企业在线服务+B部分其他在线服务总计每年度不少于250个订购许可。

  • 教育版本最低许可证数量为A部分在线服务教育订单（可用服务表，A列）每年度不少于1000个订购许可提供的服务。

💡注意： Microsoft Power Platform中的Power BI系列产品，应下单流程规则，需要通过Microsoft 365 采购下单。

 

Microsoft Dynamics 365 产品订购：

  • 新的OSPA客户，初始订单每年度至少为100个Customer Engagement订购许可，或每年至少75个Unified Operations订购许可。

  • 现有OSPA客户，初始订单每年度至少为50个Customer Engagement订购许可，或每年至少50个Unified Operations订购许可。  

Microsoft Power Platform产品订购：

Power Apps/Power Automate/Power Pages的单独订单订购：

  • 对于Power Apps/Power Automate/Power Pages产品，应下单流程规则，需要通过D365下单。

  • 对于只下单Power Apps、Power Automate及Power Pages的订单，客户需首先持有有效的Microsoft Azure或Microsoft M365 OSPA，或者有效的 21Vianet CA作为合格的协议，并且满足各产品的最低订单要求。且此协议仅可用于订购Power Apps/Power Automate/Power Pages，每年度至少为50个Power Apps，Power Automate，和/或 Power Pages，为期三年。在为期三年的世纪互联在线服务高级协议有效期内均不得降低该50个数量的最低订购要求。

en.html:
For Azure, M365, D365, and Power Platform operated by 21Vianet, the minimum purchase amount needs to be met when placing an order, which is outlined below:

Microsoft Azure Product Subscription:

Minimum Order Requirements: The total amount for the Annual Monetary Commitment (MC) and Compute Pre-Purchase (CPP) in the initial order and revised annual order must be at least RMB 50,000 (excluding tax) for each contractual year.

💡 Special Note: Currently, Azure product signing model has been transferred from OSPA to the New Commerce (21VCA-E), please refer to Introduction to 21VCA-E New Commerce for details.

 

Microsoft 365 Product Subscription:

  • The minimum number of licenses is not less than 250 Subscription Licenses per year for Section A Enterprise Online Services + Section B Additional Online Services.

  • The minimum number of licenses for the Educational Version is not less than 1,000 subscription licenses per year for Section A Online Services for Academic (Available Services Table, Column A).

💡Note: The Power BI family of products in Microsoft Power Platform should be ordered through Microsoft 365 Procurement under the ordering process rules.

 

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Product Subscription:

  • New OSPA customer: The initial order requirements must include Online Services for at least 100 Subscription Licenses every year for Customer Engagement, or at least 75 Subscription Licenses every year for Unified Operations.

  • Existing OSPA customer: The initial orders requirements must include Online Services for at least 50 Subscription Licenses every year for Customer Engagement, or at least 50 Subscription Licenses every year for Unified Operations.

 

Microsoft Power Platform Product Subscription:

Power Apps/Power Automate/Power Pages only order:

  • For Power Apps/Power Automate/Power Pages products, an order is required to be placed through D365 in accordance with the order flow rules.

  • For Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Pages only, Customer must have an active Microsoft Azure or Microsoft M365 OSPA, or 21Vianet CA as a qualifying Agreement, and meet the minimum order requirements for each product. This Agreement is a for Power Apps/Power Automate/Power Pages at least 50 Power Apps, Power Automate/ Power Pages per year, for 3 years. Any reductions to below 50 units are not allowed during the 3-year term of this OSPA.

初始订单：客户首次签署世纪互联在线服务高级协议的订单。

续约订单：原协议到期前的续约订单。

附加订单：即，追加订单，在协议期内如果客户需要充值、购买CPP或者增购坐席等，需要提交此类型订单（Azure云服务签约已经开始使用新商务模式，附加订单主要适用于M365和D365产品）。

校正年度订单：客户对年度订单的调整，需在该合约周年日之前生效。

Initial Order: The customer's first order to sign the 21Vianet Online Services Premium Agreement.

Renewal Order: A renewal order before the expiration of the original agreement.

Additional order: If a customer intends to prepay, purchase CPP, or increase the number of licenses during the agreement period, it needs to submit this type of order. (The Azure cloud service contract has started to use the New Business Model (21VCA-E), and additional orders are mainly applicable to M365 and D365 products.)

Revised Annual Order: Customer's adjustments to annual orders must be effective before the anniversary of the contract.

年度支付：标准账期为30天和非标准账期。

一次性支付：订单的总计金额需要一次性付清，账期分为标准账期30天和非标准账期，包含预付。

预付：即预付款订单（无账期），指世纪互联需要在提交订单录单前，收到全部订单预付款项，才可以提交后续录单流程。

💡特别注意：

  • 对于一次性支付订单，除了预付之外，需要提交信用审核申请。

  • 对于非标账期，需要提前获得微软对于特殊账期的批复。

Annual Invoicing: Standard payment term is 30 days and non-standard payment term.

Upfront Invoicing: The total amount of the order needs to be paid in full, with payment terms divided into standard payment terms of 30 days and non-standard payment terms, including prepayment.

Prepaid: Stands for prepaid order (without payment term), which means that 21Vianet needs to receive all prepaid payments for the order before submitting the subsequent order recording process.

💡Special Attention:

  • For upfront Invoicing order, a credit check application is needed, except the prepaid order.

  • For non-standard payment term, you need to get Microsoft's approval for special payment terms in advance.

签署方式：

签署方式 说明
纸质签章 打印合同签章，扫描上传并邮寄原件。
电子签章（E-Sign） 通过世纪互联蓝云电子签章系统完成签署，电子签文件不接受任何形式的物理扫描、复印、打印。

 

1. 纸质签章：

通过在世纪互联蓝云电子签章系统 完成电子签章，客户和合作伙伴须提前在世纪互联蓝云电子签章系统注册并完成认证。

zh.html:
在微软CE/合作伙伴生成合同文件之后，在Hermes 系统中，将经历如下几个阶段。

审核步骤

1）OE Review

合同初审阶段，Sales Support会联合21Vianet财务、法务等多个部门共同审核，审核通过后发出合同。对于选择E-Sign电子签的订单，Sales Support会同步在电子系统提交审核的合同。

2）Waiting For Customer Chop

  • 客户/合作伙伴:

    • 盖章（签字）

    • 扫描已盖章的合同

    • 邮寄纸质合同（E-Sign的订单无需邮寄）

  • 合作伙伴/微软销售:

    • 填写邮寄单号到Herme（E-Sign在世纪互联电子签章系统返原）；

    • 上传电子版签章合同到Hermes 附件；

    • 填写/核对客户的Org ID；

    • 提交 Hermes 流程到 OE Processing

3）OE Processing

Sales Support 进入合同的二次审核流程、提交世纪互联内部盖章流程同时提交微软ROC录单。

4）OE Finalizing

Sales Support 内部审核、提交CSS/Biz Ops开通服务。

5）Completed

系统流程结束。

zh.raw:
在微软CE/合作伙伴生成合同文件之后，在Hermes 系统中，将经历如下几个阶段。

**审核步骤**

**1）OE Review**

合同初审阶段，Sales Support会联合21Vianet财务、法务等多个部门共同审核，审核通过后发出合同。对于选择E-Sign电子签的订单，Sales Support会同步在电子系统提交审核的合同。 

**2）Waiting For Customer Chop**

*   客户/合作伙伴: 
    
    *   盖章（签字）

    *   扫描已盖章的合同

    *   邮寄纸质合同（E-Sign的订单无需邮寄）
            
*   合作伙伴/微软销售: 
    
    *   填写邮寄单号到Herme（E-Sign在世纪互联电子签章系统返原）；

    *   上传电子版签章合同到Hermes 附件；

    *   填写/核对客户的Org ID；

    *   提交 Hermes 流程到 OE Processing
  
**3）OE Processing**

Sales Support 进入合同的二次审核流程、提交世纪互联内部盖章流程同时提交微软ROC录单。

**4）OE Finalizing**

Sales Support 内部审核、提交CSS/Biz Ops开通服务。

**5）Completed**

系统流程结束。

en.html:
After the contract files are generated by Microsoft CE/Partner, which will go through the following stages in the Hermes system.

Overview

 

1）OE Review

During the initial review stage of the contract, Sales Support will collaborate with multiple teams such as 21Vianet's finance and legal teams to conduct the review. Once the review is completed, the contract will be released to partners. For orders that choose E-Sign, Sales Support team will simultaneously submit the reviewed contract to the E-Sign system.

 

2）Waiting For Customer Chop

  • Customer/Partner:

    • Stamp (Sign)

    • Scan the stamped contracts

    • Mail the physical contract to 21Vianet (E-Sign orders do not need to be mailed)

  • Partner/Microsoft AE:

    • Filling the Express Number to Hermes (for E-Sign, the stamped contract returns in 21Vianet E-Sign System)

    • Upload the softcopy of the stamped contract to Hermes as an attachment

    • Fill and verify the customer's Org ID

    • Submit the Hermes process to OE Processing

 

3）OE Processing

Sales Support second review the contract secondary, apply for 21Vianet seal, and submit the Hermes process to ROC processing.

 

4）OE Finalizing

Internal review, submit CSS/Biz Ops to activate services.

 

5）Completed

End.

For some organizations requiring 21Vianet to sign first before their own organization's execution, In such cases, the partner or Microsoft Account Manager can follow the process below to apply:

The process requires Partner or Microsoft Account Manager to complete the following email template and send it to 21Vianet's Sales Support team <salessupport@oe.21vianet.com>, for the sign first application which accepted by 21Vianet, the Sales Support team will deliver 4 copies of the contract with stamps to partner after 21Vianet's signing/stamping process has been completed. Hi 21Vianet Sales Support Team,

  1. Please provide detailed reasons for 21Vianet to sign first.

  2. Requests for 21Vianet to sign first will require an additional of 1 to 2 working days for processing.

  3. Please note that the stamped documents have legal effect. In case of any updates, the original stamped documents must be returned to 21Vianet for destruction.

* All the items above are mandatory. If any of the above conditions are not met, the application will be rejected.

A.不同合约需使用不同的版本

  • CICR direct 版本

  • CICR indirect 版本

CICR文档模版可以在Hermes首页下载：

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_13.png

 

B.变更流程

1. 文档填写说明

a. Direct合同

申请人按照文档要求，填写完成CICR文档，使用合同原主要联系人的预留邮箱，将填写完的CICR文档发出给Sales Support。邮件将作为Hermes上传附件之一。

如果合同的原主要联系人邮箱已不可用，需要将填写无误的CICR文档打印出来，加盖客户公章或者合同专用章，之后将盖章的扫描件作为附件发送给Sales Support <salessupport@oe.21vianet.com>。

b. Indirect合同

申请人按照文档要求，填写完成CICR文档，使用合同原主要联系人或者经销商联系人的预留邮箱，将填写完的CICR文档发出给salessupport@oe.21vianet.com。邮件将作为Hermes上传附件之一。

如由非主要联系人和经销商联系人邮箱发出，需加盖客户或合作伙伴公司公章/合同专用章，盖章原件扫描件后，作为附件提交。

 

2. 收到变更完成通知

流程完成后客户及相关成员会收到来自世纪互联的系统通知邮件。

CICR: Stands for "Contact Information Change Request". The customer/partner requests to change the contact information for the executed agreement.

💡Note: This is only applicable to changing contact information, not company name.

A. Different contracts require different versions

  • CICR direct version

  • CICR indirect version

💡Note: The CICR document template can be downloaded from the Hermes homepage.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_13.png

 

B. Change Process

1. Filling Guidance

a. Direct Contract

The applicant fills in the CICR document according to the document requirements. Send the completed CICR document to Sales Support using the reserved email address of the original primary contact person in the contract. This email will be one of the attachments in the Hermes system.

If the original primary contact email is no longer available, it is necessary to print out the accurately filled out CICR document, stamp it with the customer's official seal or contract specific seal, and then send the scanned copy with the seal as an attachment to Sales Support< salessupport@oe.21vianet.com >.

 

b. Indirect Contract

The applicant fills in the CICR document according to the document requirements. Use the reserved email address of the original primary contact person or partner contact person in the contract to send the completed CICR document to salessupport@oe.21vianet.com. The email will be one of the attachments in the Hermes system.

If it is sent by the non-primary contact or non partner contact email address, it needs to be stamped with the official seal/contract seal of the customer or partner company. After scanning and stamping the original CICR document, then send the scanned copy as an attachment to Sales Support< salessupport@oe.21vianet.com >.

2. Receive the Change Completion Notification

After the CICR process is completed, customers and other stakeholders will receive a system notification email from 21Vianet.

COEN:“公司实体名称变更（Change of Entity Name）”，仅限于客户实体名称在市场监督管理局完成公司实体名称变更登记的场景。若曾用名和变更后的公司实体名称同时使用，并且不能提供市场监督管理局实体变更说明函，则不属于本场景。

适用范围

本流程适用于：已有客户公司名称发生了工商变更

不适用于：客户希望合同主体由A公司变更为B公司

A. 提供所需材料

已有客户告知其公司名称发生了工商变更，请申请者提供以下材料：

  • 当地市场监督管理局（工商局）出具的“准予变更登记通知书”或者加盖工商局专用章的“名称变更登记信息查询结果”

  • 变更后其公司的营业执照、税务登记证、组织机构代码证扫描件（正副本均可）- 现在法规变更为三证合一，所以提供营业执照就可以

  • 公司名称变更说明需要客户填写并加盖变更后的公司公章（COEN文件）

  • 变更后的公司中英文名称

  • 变更后的公司开票信息

公司名称变更说明函(COEN) 文档模版可以在Hermes首页下载：

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_14.png

 

B. 收到变更完成通知

流程完成后客户及相关成员会收到来自世纪互联的系统通知邮件。

COEN: Stands for "Change of Entity Name", which is applicable only to the scenario where the customer has completed the official registration of its legal entity name change with the Administration for Market Regulation (AMR). If both the former name and the new entity name are used simultaneously without providing the AMR-issued Entity Name Change Verification Letter. it does not apply to this scenario.

Scope of Application:

This process is suitable for: The company name has been changed at the Administration for Industry and Commerce.

This process is not suitable for: The customer wants to change the contracting party from Company A to Company B.

A. Required supporting documents

Some Customers has informed that their company name has changed and requested the applicant to provide the following materials.

  • The "Notice of Approval of Change of Registration" issued by the local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR), or the Query Result of Name Change Registration Information with the special seal of Administration for Market Regulation (AMR).

  • The scanned copies of the Business License, tax registration certificate, and organization code certificate after the name change (both the original and duplicate copies are acceptable)- Now the regulations have been changed to three certificates in one, so it is enough to provide a business license.

  • A letter concerning the change of entity name (COEN document) needs to be provided with the new company seal affixed.

  • The new Chinese and English name of the company.

  • The new company invoicing information.

The Change of Entity Name Letter -COEN document template can be downloaded from the Hermes homepage:

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_14.png

 

B. Receive the Change Completion Notification

After the COEN process is completed, both customers and other stakeholders will receive a system notification email from 21Vianet.

COCP：指“将原经销商即付款方合作伙伴换为新的合作伙伴（Change of Contract Partner）”如果COCP的需求来自于客户，需要请新的合作伙伴到Hermes首页下载最新版的COCP文档，并填写相关信息

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_15.png

 

从COCP的生效日期当天开始，客户合约正式切换为新合作伙伴负责，COCP生效日期的前一天依旧由原合作伙伴负责。若有未来年度账单需要由新合作伙伴接手，则COCP文件中“更改经销商生效日期”需不晚于周年日。对于有未来账单的客户，如果新合作伙伴不是免信用审核，还需要在做校正年度或追加订单之前提交信审

关于生效日期的不同场景：

COCP文件盖章后需将盖章文件扫描并邮件发送、同时邮寄盖章原件到世纪互联

A. 指定COCP生效日期：

如下图中“更改经销商生效日期”处填写的具体日期，即，合作伙伴指定COCP生效日。对于指定生效日期的COCP，具体场景：

*指定生效日距COCP录单生效的时间间隔小于90天

如果指定生效日期与预计ROC操作COCP录单生效的时间，间隔小于90天，那么需要客户、新的合作伙伴、原合作伙伴都要在COCP文件对应位置盖章。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_16.png

 

B. 不指定COCP生效日期：

如果上图中“更改经销商生效日期”处未填写，即，合作伙伴未指定COCP的生效日期，默认新的合作伙伴接受COCP在ROC操作的90天后生效。

COCP最终的生效日期为后台录单完成的90天后生效，实际生效日期应以ROC完成后的邮件通知为准。

对于这种未指定COCP生效日期的场景，COCP文档只需要客户和新的合作伙伴在对应位置盖章，不需要原合作伙伴盖章。

* 文件中如下图内容对应位置为世纪互联蓝云填写：

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_17.png

 

💡特别注意：

  • 若未来年度账单需要由新合作伙伴付款，则COCP文件中“更改经销商生效日期”需不晚于周年日。

  • 所指定的“更改经销商生效日期”不能为backdate日期，且该日期在提交给世纪互联时需预留至少5个工作日给到世纪互联及ROC审核操作。

从COCP的生效日期当天开始，客户合约正式切换为新合作伙伴负责，COCP生效日期的前一天依旧由原合作伙伴负责。若有未来年度账单需要由新合作伙伴接手，则COCP文件中“更改经销商生效日期”需不晚于周年日。对于有未来账单的客户，如果新合作伙伴不是免信用审核，还需要在做校正年度或追加订单之前提交信审

**关于生效日期的不同场景：**

COCP文件盖章后需将盖章文件扫描并邮件发送、同时邮寄盖章原件到世纪互联

**A. 指定COCP生效日期：**

如下图中“更改经销商生效日期”处填写的具体日期，即，合作伙伴指定COCP生效日。对于指定生效日期的COCP，具体场景：

**\*指定生效日距COCP录单生效的时间间隔小于90天**

如果指定生效日期与预计ROC操作COCP录单生效的时间，间隔小于90天，那么需要客户、新的合作伙伴、原合作伙伴都要在COCP文件对应位置盖章。

![](images\OSPA-S-CN-02_image_16.png)

 

**B. 不指定COCP生效日期：**

如果上图中“更改经销商生效日期”处未填写，即，合作伙伴未指定COCP的生效日期，默认新的合作伙伴接受COCP在ROC操作的90天后生效。

COCP最终的生效日期为后台录单完成的90天后生效，实际生效日期应以ROC完成后的邮件通知为准。

对于这种未指定COCP生效日期的场景，COCP文档只需要客户和新的合作伙伴在对应位置盖章，不需要原合作伙伴盖章。

\* 文件中如下图内容对应位置为世纪互联蓝云填写：

![](images\OSPA-S-CN-02_image_17.png)

*   若未来年度账单需要由新合作伙伴付款，则COCP文件中“更改经销商生效日期”需不晚于周年日。

COCP stands for "Change of Contract Partner", which refers to replacement of the original distributor with a new partner. If the COCP request comes from the customer, the new partner needs to download the latest version of the COCP document from the Hermes homepage and fill in the relevant information.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_15.png

 

From the effective date of the COCP, the customer contract is officially switched to the new partner, and before the effective date of the COCP, the original partner shall remain the responsible party. If there is a future annual billing that needs to be taken over by a new partner, the "Effective Date of Partner Changing" in the COCP document must be no later than the anniversary date. For customers with future billing, if the new partner is not credit-free, they will also need to submit a credit check before making a Revised annual order or Additional order.

Different Scenarios Regarding Effective Dates:

After the COCP document is stamped, the stamped document must be scanned and sent by email, and the original document must be mailed to 21Vianet at the same time.

A. Specifying an effective date for the COCP:

The specific date specified in the " Effective Date of Partner Changing " in the picture below. That is the effective date of the COCP specified by the partner. For COCP with a specified effective date, the specific scenario:

*The time interval between specified effective date and the completion date of the COCP is less than 90 days

If the interval between the specified effective date and the completion date of the ROC processing COCP is less than 90 days, the customer, new partner, and original partner need to stamp their seals at the corresponding positions on the COCP document.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_16.png

 

B. Not specifying an effective date for the COCP:

If the "Effective Date of Partner Changing" field in the picture above is not filled in, that is the partner does not specify the effective date of the COCP, and the new partner accepts that the COCP will take effect 90 days after the ROC processing.

The final effective date of the COCP will take effect 90 days after the completion of ROC processing, and the actual effective date shall be subject to the email notification after the completion of the ROC processing.

For this scenario where the COCP effective date is not specified, the COCP document only needs to be stamped by the customer and the new partner in the corresponding location, and the original partner does not need to be stamped.

*The corresponding position in the document below is filled in by 21Vianet Blue Cloud:

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_17.png

 

💡Special Note:

  • If future annual billing needs to be paid by the new partner, the "Effective Date of Partner Changing" in the COCP document must be no later than the anniversary date.

  • The specified "Effective Date of Partner Changing" cannot be a backdate date. At least 5 working days need to be reserved for 21Vianet review and ROC processing when submitted to 21Vianet.

EST申请流程及注意事项：

  • 合同中“主要联系人”的邮箱发送邮件，通过邮件向微软销售/合作伙伴+ Sales Support Team<salessupport@oe.21vianet.com>提出延期申请。

Taking the Dec2021 modern OSPA version as an example, the clause regarding the extension of service term ("EST") in the OSPA is as follows:

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_18.png

 

According to the agreement, eligible customers who wish to extend their access to the service need to submit an EST application.

EST Application Process and Special Note:

  • The "Primary Contact" email address sends an extension request email to Microsoft AE/Partner & Sales Support Team<salessupport@oe.21vianet.com>.

  • For the application email template, Microsoft AE or Partners can download from Hermes homepage.

  • After receiving the customer's email request, MS CE (Direct) or Partner (Indirect) submits in the Hermes system according to Modern EST's process, and the customer's original email needs to be uploaded as an attachment.

The standard Extended Service Term is for 3 months. In principle, customers must apply for the service extension in a single application, rather than in multiple, monthly, or phased applications.

 

💡Note: If the primary contact email is not available, the customer needs to apply to complete the CICR first. For more information about CICR, please click on CICR-Contact Information Change Request.

超额（Overage）：指当客户OSPA Azure 账户中预充值的MC耗尽后，继续使用服务所产生的费用，我们对于这部分超出的费用称为超额，即，“Overage”。

客户可登录EA Portal URL: https://ea.azure.cn/。

在管理界面设置‘通知联系人’后，会定期收到系统发送的用量通知，该系统通知仅供参考。

客户自行设置每日/每周/每月/无 通知频率。

世纪互联每月中上旬发送上个月超额通知邮件给客户/合作伙伴。

超额按月出账单，每个月都是单独的账单，金额不叠加。超额账单需‘按月’支付，或‘按月’折抵，每月金额不得拆分。

en.html:
Overage: Refers to the charges incurred for continuing to use the Azure services after the MC (Monetary Commitment) pre-recharged in the customer's OSPA Azure account is exhausted.

Customers can log in EA Portal URL: https://ea.azure.cn/

After setting 'Notification Contact' in the management interface, you will receive usage notifications sent by the system on a regular basis, which is for reference only.

Customers set their own Daily/Weekly/Monthly/None notification frequency.

▧

Overage bills are issued monthly, and each month is a separate bill, and the amounts do not accumulate. Overage bills need to be paid 'monthly' or offset 'monthly', and the monthly amount cannot be split.

如果客户/合作伙伴回复邮件选择直接支付方式处理，我司会依据邮件确认直接出具超额账单。超额账单出具后客户/合作伙伴可以直接在客户发票系统中申请该超额的发票，并请于30日（日历日）内支付（需支付未税金额*1.06=含税金额）即可。

en.html:
The customer/partner confirms the email that they will proceed to pay incurred overage

If the customer/partner confirms the email that they will proceed to pay incurred overage, we will issue overage billing against your email. After the overage invoice is issued, the customer/partner can directly apply for the overage invoice in the 21Vianet Fapiao System and pay it within 30 days (calendar day) (excluding tax * 1.06 = tax included).

In addition, for the overages that have already been directly invoiced, they cannot be offset by subsequent additional orders or annual orders and other renewal methods.

💡Please note:

  1. The invoice system needs to be registered with the email address of the payment contact in the agreement, otherwise it will not pass the verification. For invoice system account registration and operation methods, please refer to the 21Vianet Fapiao System

  2. If billing contact person received the invoice system notice ([21Vianet Blue Cloud Invoice System Notice] Your bill has taken effect, please log in to the invoice system in time), it means that you can apply for an invoice. On the next working day after the bill is issued, your company can find the corresponding bill to be invoiced in the invoice system for invoice application.

zh.html:
与世纪互联客户协议新模式（21VCA-E）操作方式相同

URL： https://fapiao.cloud.21vianet.com/user/login

 

下载 蓝云客户发票系统操作手册

 

注册账号

如果世纪互联在线服务高级协议（OSPA）客户或合作伙伴账单联系人未曾注册过世纪互联蓝云客户发票系统，请按照以下步骤注册。

•点击 https://fapiao.cloud.21vianet.com/user/login 页面左侧的注册账户进行登录账号的注册，如下图：

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_23.png

 

勾选“企业客户”，输入客户/合作伙伴付款联系人的邮箱、密码，并确认密码，点击注册。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_24.png

 

注册完毕后，系统会发送激活邮件至客户/合作伙伴提供的注册邮箱，请点击邮件中的激活链接激活该账户。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_25.png

 

激活注册账户：

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_26.png

 

注册后，如果始终未收到激活邮件，可能是世纪互联客户发票系统的激活邮件被邮件服务器当作垃圾邮件处理，请前往垃圾邮件文件夹查询。

如果仍未收到，请前往世纪互联客户发票系统，点击重发激活邮件（如下图）尝试重新发送并接收。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_27.png

 

如果始终未能收到激活邮件，请前往世纪互联客户发票系统登录页右侧，获取支持途径联系产品客服或留言。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_28.png

 

用户登录

点击 https://fapiao.cloud.21vianet.com/ 登录世纪互联蓝云客户发票系统，使用客户/合作伙伴付款联系人注册邮箱进行登录。

如果合作伙伴同时有世纪互联在线服务高级协议（OSPA）和世纪互联蓝云客户协议（21Vianet CA）两种业务，并且世纪互联在线服务高级协议（OSPA）登录邮箱与世纪互联客户协议应收账款联系人一致，则无需重复注册，直接登录即可。

 

修改登录邮箱

由于登录邮箱为账单联系人，如果需要修改请联系Sales Support Team (salessupport@oe.21vianet.com)走CICR流程。关于CICR，可点击CICR-Contact Information Change Request 了解更多。

 

发票申请

用户登录成功后，点击右上角登录 email，在展开列表里点击“发票抬头管理”链接。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_29.png

 

发票抬头和地址管理填写完成后保存。选择发票类型、派送方式并确认发票信息后，进行提交。

 

企业OSPA客户

选择客户类型“企业OSPA客户”：填写合同编号或售达方（客户名称），可查询是否有待开发票：

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_30.png

 

• 多条账单合并申请（见下图）。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_31.png

 

发票查询

• 点击我的发票，所有已经提交至财务处理的发票信息显示至该页面。如果发票数量大，可以通过申请日期进行排序，或者通过申请时间进行查询。

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-CN-02_image_32.png

 

• 用户可以操作点击发票信息后的“详情”按钮，查看该发票的详细信息及邮寄信息。

It works the same as the New Commerce of the 21VCA-E.

URL： https://fapiao.cloud.21vianet.com/user/login

 

Download 蓝云客户发票系统操作手册

 

Register an Account:

If the OSPA customer or Partner billing contact has not registered for the 21Vianet Fapiao System, please follow the steps below to register.

• Click on the "Register Account" option on the left side of the https://fapiao.cloud.21vianet.com/user/ login page, as shown in the following picture.

 

▧
descript图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_23.png

 

Check "Enterprise Customer", enter the email address and password of the billing contact person of the customer/partner, confirm the password, and click "Register".

▧
descript图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_24.png

 

After registration is completed, the system will send an activation email to the registered email address provided by the customer/partner, please click the activation link in the email to activate the account.

▧
descript图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_25.png

 

Activate the registered account:

▧
descript图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_26.png

 

After registration, if you haven't received the activation email at all, it might be that the activation email of the 21Vianet Fapiao System was treated as spam by the mail server. Please check in the junk folder.

If you still haven't received it, please go to the 21Vianet Fapiao System, click "Resend Activation Email" (as shown in the following picture), and try to resend and receive it again.

▧
descript图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_27.png

 

If you still can't receive it, please go to the right side of the login page of the 21Vianet Fapiao System to obtain the support from system support team or leave a message.

▧
descript图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_28.png

 

User login

Click https://fapiao.cloud.21vianet.com/ , log in to 21Vianet Fapiao System, using the registered email address of the customer/partner's billing contact person.

If the partner has both OSPA and 21VCA-E, and the login email address of OSPA is the same as the account receivable contact person of the 21VCA-E, there is no need to register twice.

 

Modify Login Email

Since the login email is the customer/partner's billing contact person, if you need to modify it, please contact Sales Support Team(salessupport@oe.21vianet.com) to follow the CICR process. For more Information about CICR, click CICR-Contact Information Change Request.

 

Apply for Value-Added Tax (VAT) Invoice

After the user login successfully, click login email in the upper right corner and click the "Invoice Title Management" link in the expanded list:

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_29.png

 

To save the invoice title and address management information. Select the invoice type, delivery method, and confirm the invoice information, and then submit.

 

Enterprise OSPA Customer

Select the customer type "Enterprise OSPA Customer": Fill the agreement number or Sold-to party (customer name) to check whether there is a pending invoice:

▧
descript图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_30.png

 

• Multiple bill consolidation application (as shown in the following picture).

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_31.png

 

Invoice inquiry

• Click "My Invoice" to check all invoice information that has been submitted to Financial Processing. If the number of invoices is large, you can sort the application date. Or divide the date into segments: start date to end date.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-S-EN-02_image_32.png

 

• Click on the details under the operation to view the detailed information and mailing information of the invoice.

Q：OSPA商务模式如何下单？

A：OSPA商务合约流程分为Direct Model（直签模式）和Indirect Model（间接模式）。

Direct Model（直签模式）须联系微软大客户经理即微软销售，Indirect Model（间接模式）须联系合作伙伴。

 

Q：OSPA协议有效期是多久？

A：标准协议有效期三年。

 

Q：世纪互联与微软之间是什么关系？

A：上海蓝云网络科技有限公司 (北京世纪互联宽带数据中心有限公司的关联公司, 下称 “世纪互联”) 提供的Microsoft Azure、Microsoft 365、Microsoft Dynamics 365 和Microsoft Power Platform服务(“世纪互联服务”) 是基于微软(中国)有限公司及其关联机构(“微软”) 许可世纪互联使用的Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Dynamics 365 和Microsoft Power Platform 技术。

 

Q：国外注册公司是否可以购买世纪互联运营的微软云服务？

A：目前我们仅支持中国大陆地区注册且有效的实体购买由世纪互联运营的微软云服务。

 

Q：订单发票如何申请？

A：我们目前已经上线世纪互联客户发票系统（世纪互联客户发票系统），支持客户/经销商自助申请发票。详细信息请参考 世纪互联蓝云发票系统 。

 

Q： 世纪互联是否可以接受境外付款？

A：实际付款方需要与协议中列明的付款公司一致。

 

Q：OSPA Azure 协议到期后，客户如需继续使用服务或迁移订阅，如何处理？

A：OSPA到期后是不能做迁移订阅的操作的，请客户在协议到期前或EST到期前，完成续约及订阅迁移工作。了解迁移相关问题，您可以参考如下方式，开工单到世纪互联客服团队了解详细。

点击 https://support.azure.cn/zh-cn/support/contact →选择“在线提交工单”→使用Org ID登录后提交工单。

▧

A: The OSPA business contract process can be divided into Direct Model and Indirect Model.

The Direct Model requires contacting Microsoft Account Executive, i.e. Microsoft AE, the Indirect Model requires contacting Partners.

 

Q: How long is the OSPA agreement valid for?

A: The standard agreement is valid for three years.

 

Q: What is the relationship between 21Vianet and Microsoft?

A: The Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Power Platform services (the "21Vianet Services") provided by Shanghai Blue Cloud Technology Co., Ltd. ("21Vianet"), an affiliate of 21Vianet Beijing Broadband Data Center Co., Ltd., are based on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Power Platform technology that 21Vianet has licensed from Microsoft (China) Co., Ltd. and its affiliates ("Microsoft").

 

Q: Can foreign-registered companies purchase Microsoft cloud services operated by 21Vianet?

A: Currently, we only support purchases of Microsoft cloud services, operated by 21Vianet, by entities that are registered and valid in mainland China.

 

Q: How to apply for an order invoice?

A: We have launched the 21Vianet Fapiao System (21Vianet Fapiao System ) to support customers/partners to self-apply for invoices. For more information, please refer to 21Vianet Fapiao System.

 

Q: Can 21Vianet accept overseas payments?

A: The actual payer needs to be consistent with the paying company listed in the agreement.

 

Q: What should I do if I need to continue using the service or migrate my subscription after the OSPA Azure agreement expires?

A: You cannot migrate the subscription after the OSPA expires, please complete the renewal and subscription migration before the expiration of the agreement or the expiration of the EST. To understand migration-related issues, you can refer to the following methods to initiate a work order and contact the customer service team of 21Vianet for details.

Click https://support.azure.cn/h-cn/support/contact → select "Submit ticket online" → submit the ticket after logging in with your Org ID.

购买 Azure 企业协议的客户，需要根据公司内部组织架构设置不同的部门，帐户，订阅实现多级别的计费管理。我们提供了以下四个级别的不同管理角色，供您查看和汇总账单和计费。但需要注意的是以下各层级仅供计费查看和参考，实际账单仍需要按照协议统一支付。

本文章为您介绍了不同级别管理员所对应的门户，以及在不同的门户中的操作权限。

  • 企业管理员

  • 部门管理员

  • 帐户所有者

  • 通知联系人

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_1.jpeg

 

以下各级管理员均需要使用机构帐户（Org ID: 123@abc.partner.onmschina.cn）。创建新的机构帐户，可以点击这里。如您已有机构帐户，需要创建多个同一域名下的帐户，请点击这里。您可以将多个机构帐户都指定为企业管理员，但每个帐户中只能将一个机构帐户指定为帐户所有者，而相同的机构帐户不能在不同的帐户中使用。在某个协议中，可以将机构帐户同时指定为企业管理员和帐户所有者。

 

企业管理员

登陆门户：企业门户

企业管理员具有最高级别的访问权限。他们可以：

  • 管理帐户和帐户所有者

  • 管理企业管理员

  • 管理部门管理员

  • 管理通知联系人

  • 查看所有帐户中的使用量

  • 查看所有帐户中的未计费费用

  • 一个企业协议中可能会有多个企业管理员

  • 所有企业管理员都继承了部门管理员角色

 

部门管理员

登陆门户：企业门户

  • 创建和管理部门

  • 创建新的帐户所有者

  • 查看所管理的部门的使用量详细信息

  • 查看成本（如果被授予了必需的权限）

  • 一个企业协议中可能会有多个部门管理员

 

帐户所有者

登陆门户：企业门户，帐户门户

  • 创建和管理订阅

  • 查看订阅的使用量

  • 每个帐户都需要一个唯一的机构帐户

 

通知联系人

通知联系人由企业管理员添加，提供您日常可以接收邮件的邮箱地址即可,不需要使用机构帐户。

  • 接收与协议相关的使用量通知。

  • 接收 Azure 服务更新通知。

en.html:
Customers who purchase Azure Enterprise Agreement need to set up different departments, accounts, and subscriptions based on their internal organizational structure to achieve multi-level billing management. We provide the following four levels of different management roles for you to view and summarize bills and billing. However, it is important to note that the following levels are only for billing viewing and reference, and the actual bills still need to be paid uniformly according to the agreement.

This article introduces the portals corresponding to different levels of administrators, as well as the operational permissions in different portals.

  • Enterprise Administrator

  • Department Administrator

  • Account owner

  • Notification contact

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_1.png

 

All administrators at the following levels are required to use an organizational account (Org ID: 123@abc.partner.onmschina.cn). To create a new organizational account, please click here. If you already have an organizational account and need to create multiple accounts under the same domain name, please clickhere. You can designate multiple organizational accounts as enterprise administrators, but only one organizational account can be designated as the account owner in each account, and the same organizational account cannot be used in different accounts. In a certain agreement, an organizational account can be designated as both an enterprise administrator and an account owner.

 

Enterprise Administrator

Login portal: Enterprise Portal

Enterprise administrators have the highest level of access permissions. They can:

  • Managing accounts and account owners

  • Manage enterprise administrators

  • Manage department administrator

  • Manage notification contact

  • View usage across all accounts

  • View unbilled charges across all accounts

  • There may be multiple enterprise administrators in an enterprise agreement

  • All enterprise administrators inherit the role of department administrators

 

Department Administrator

Login portal: Enterprise Portal

  • Create and manage departments

  • Create a new account owner

  • View detailed usage information of the managed departments

  • View costs (if granted the necessary permissions)

  • There may be multiple department administrators in an enterprise agreement

 

Account owner

Login portal: Enterprise Portal, Account Portal

  • Create and manage subscriptions

  • Check the usage of subscriptions

  • Each account requires a unique organizational account

 

Notification contact

The notification contact is added by the enterprise administrator, and you only need to provide an email address that you can receive emails. There is no need to use an organizational account.

  • Receive usage notifications related to the agreement.

  • Receive notifications of Azure service updates.

Using the "Departments" feature, enterprise administrators and department administrators can organize and report on enterprise Azure services and usage by department and cost center. Enterprise administrators will be able to add/delete departments, associate accounts to departments, create department administrators, and specify whether department administrators can view prices and costs.

Department administrators can add new accounts to the departments they manage as administrators. They can also delete accounts from their own departments, rather than from contracts.

How to create a department

  • Click "Manage" in the left navigation

  • Click the "Departments" tab.

  • Click "+ Add Department" and enter the required information in the "Department" window

  • Note: "Department Name" is the only required field and must be at least 3 characters long

zh.html:
创建部门后，企业管理员可以添加部门管理员，并将每个部门管理员关联到部门。部门管理员可以执行以下操作：

  • 创建部门管理员

  • 查看/编辑部门属性，如名称或成本中心

  • 在他们所管理的部门中添加帐户

  • 从他们管理的部门中删除关联的帐户

  • 下载他们管理的部门的使用情况详细信息

  • 查看关联到其部门的每月使用情况及收费（如果企业管理员已授权执行此操作）

 

若要添加部门管理员，请执行以下操作

作为企业管理员：

  • 单击左侧导航中的“管理”

  • 单击“部门”选项卡

  • 单击所需的“部门”

  • 单击“+添加管理员”，然后添加所需的信息

  • 单击“添加”

** 💡 注意**

部门不是必填选项，根据您的需求，可以添加部门，也可以不添加。默认情况下，具有“企业管理员”角色的用户将获得部门管理员权限。

en.html:
After creating departments, enterprise administrators can add department administrators and associate each department administrator with a department. Department administrators can perform the following operations:

  • Create department administrator

  • View/edit department attributes, such as name or cost center

  • Add accounts in the department they manage

  • Remove the associated accounts from the departments they manage

  • Download detailed usage information of the departments they manage

  • View the monthly usage and charges associated with their department (if authorized by the enterprise administrator to perform this operation)

To add a department administrator, please follow the steps below

As an enterprise administrator:

  • Click "Manage" in the left navigation

  • Click on the "Departments" tab

  • Click on the desired "Department"

  • Click "+ Add Administrator", and then add the required information

  • Click "Add"

💡Attention

The department is not a mandatory field. Depending on your needs, you can choose to add or not add a department. By default, users with the "Enterprise Administrator" role will be granted department administrator permissions.

zh.html:
企业协议中可支持不同合约之间的帐户层面迁移。简单来说，可以实现合同 A 下的 C 帐户迁移至合同 B 下。实现此操作请注意以下几点：

  1. 请务必保证迁入，迁出合约及帐户都是已激活状态

  2. 此操作不会改变底层架构的部署，改变的只是计费逻辑也就是计费主体由 A 变成 B

  3. 此操作只限定在帐户层面，不支持订阅层面

  4. 支持多个帐户的迁移

若您有跨合约迁移的需求，可以通过 Azure Portal 在线提交工单 获得客户支持。

en.html:
Account-level migration between different contracts can be supported in enterprise agreements. Simply put, it is possible to migrate account C under contract A to contract B. To achieve this operation, please note the following points:

1．Please ensure that the transfer-in and transfer-out contracts, as well as the account, are all in active state

2．This operation will not change the underlying architecture deployment. Only the billing logic will be modified, meaning the billing entity will change from A to B.

3．This operation is only limited to the account level and does not support the subscription level

4．Support the migration of multiple accounts

If you have a need for cross-contract migration, you can submit a ticket online through the Azure Portal to obtain customer support.

en.raw:
Account-level migration between different contracts can be supported in enterprise agreements. Simply put, it is possible to migrate account C under contract A to contract B. To achieve this operation, please note the following points:

1．Please ensure that the transfer-in and transfer-out contracts, as well as the account, are all in active state

2．This operation will not change the underlying architecture deployment. Only the billing logic will be modified, meaning the billing entity will change from **A** to **B**.

3．This operation is only limited to the account level and does not support the subscription level

4．Support the migration of multiple accounts

If you have a need for cross-contract migration, you can [submit a ticket online](https://support.azure.cn/en-us/support/support-azure/) through the Azure Portal to obtain customer support.
