How can enterprise agreement users download usage reports

Enterprise agreement users can log in to the enterprise portal to view historical usage and current remaining balance information in their contracts. There is a maximum delay of five days for usage data in the system. You can view the specific

expiration date by downloading the usage details. The enterprise portal provides customers with three viewing methods: monthly report download, advanced report download, and API access key. In the monthly report and advanced report, it provides daily service content consumption, service usage, and corresponding billing amounts for each department, account, and subscription up to the date of the report.

Users can refer to the following operation method to download the report:

  1. Log in to the Enterprise Portal and select "Reports" in the left view.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_16.png

 

  1. Click on "Download Usage" in the report view

Option 1: Monthly report download

Report Name content
Balance and fees Available amount and fees in the monthly contract
Detailed usage information Detailed service usage information for the current month
Price list The prices corresponding to all services for the current month

 

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_17.png

 

Option 2: Download advanced report

The advanced report download feature provides you with options to filter by date and account.

a. Select the date range you wish to view

b. Select the account to view

c. Click to request usage data

d. A download link will be generated on the right side of the page

e. Click to download

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_18.png

 

Option 3: API Access Key

Customers can access usage and billing information through REST or JSON APIs. Enterprise administrators need to generate a key from the enterprise portal to enable access to the API. Anyone who obtains a contract number and key can access the API.

For specific operations, you can refer to the help documentation for the reporting API in the enterprise portal for more information.

查看使用量报告

了解使用量报告中名称的含义，可以帮助您更好的了解和分析您的使用情况。以下以每月使用量报告为例为您展示关键名称的定义。

▧
keyword-definition图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_20.png

  • 帐户所有者 Live Id (AccountOwnerId) ：创建订阅的管理员账号

  • 帐户名称 (Account Name)：您在企业门户中为帐户所有者自定义的名称

  • 订阅 Guid (SubscriptionGuid)：计费所属的订阅

  • 订阅名称 (Subscription Name):订阅的名称

  • 日期 (Date)：计费对应的日期

▧
keyword-definition-2图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_21.png

 

  • 产品 (Product)：计费的产品名称

  • 服务类型 (Meter Sub-Category)：提供有关服务的第二级详细信息。

  • 服务区域 (Meter Region)：该服务所使用的数据中心位置

  • 已消耗资源数量 (Consumed Quantity)：产品在该日期产生的用量

  • 资源费率 (ResourceRate)：实际有效费率，总费用除以总用量

  • 扩展的成本 (ExtendedCost)：费用

▧
keyword-definition-3图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_22.png

 

  • 服务子区域 (Resource Location)：该服务所使用的数据中心位置

  • 服务信息 (Consumed Service)：所部署服务的相关信息

  • 组件 (Instance ID)：该服务所部署的相关信息

  • 部门名称(Department Name)：显示帐户所属的部门

  • 成本中心(Cost Center): 显示帐户所属的成本中心

  • 度量单位 (Unit of Measure) ：该服务的计费单元，例如，GB，小时，10,000秒

  • 资源组(Resource Group)：显示资源所有的 Group

 

💡注意

资源费率是总费用除以总用量的参考值，不等同于单价。当您的企业协议中有赠送免费量时，资源费率会低于单价。 例如您使用了 3 GB Log Data Ingestion 服务，根据企业协议为您提供了 5GB 的赠送用量。此时资源费率会显示为 0。

en.html:
View usage report

Understanding the meanings of the names in the usage report can help you better understand and analyze your usage. Taking the monthly usage report as an example, the definitions of key names are presented below.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_20.png

 

  • Account Owner Live Id (AccountOwnerId): The administrator account used to create the subscription

  • Account Name: The name you customize for the account owner in the enterprise portal

  • Subscription Guid (SubscriptionGuid): The subscription to which the billing belongs

  • Subscription Name: The name of the subscription

  • Date: The date corresponding to the billing

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_21.png

 

  • Product: The name of the billed product

  • Service Type (Meter Sub-Category): Provides detailed information about the service at the second level.

  • Service Region (Meter Region): The location of the data center utilized by this service

  • Consumed Quantity: The amount of the resource consumed by the product on that date

  • Resource Rate: Actual effective rate, calculated by dividing the total cost by the total usage

  • Extended Cost (ExtendedCost): Expense

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_22.png

 

  • Service Sub-Region (Resource Location): The location of the data center utilized by this service

  • Service Information (Consumed Service): Information related to the deployed service

  • Component (Instance ID): Relevant information about the deployment of this service

  • Department Name: Displays the department to which the account belongs

  • Cost Center: Displays the cost center to which the account belongs

  • Unit of Measure: The billing unit of the service, such as GB, hour, or 10,000 seconds

  • Resource Group: Displays all the Groups of resources

💡Attention

The resource rate is a reference value obtained by dividing the total cost by the total usage, which is not equivalent to the unit price. When your enterprise agreement includes complimentary free usage, the resource rate will be lower than the unit price.

For instance, if you have utilized 3 GB of Log Data Ingestion service and your enterprise agreement provides you with 5 GB of complimentary usage, the resource rate will be displayed as 0.

The resource rate is a reference value obtained by dividing the total cost by the total usage, which is not equivalent to the unit price. When your enterprise agreement includes complimentary free usage, the resource rate will be lower than the unit price.

For instance, if you have utilized 3 GB of Log Data Ingestion service and your enterprise agreement provides you with 5 GB of complimentary usage, the resource rate will be displayed as 0.

部门开销配额

EA 客户可以为合约下的每个部门设置或更改开销配额。开销配额量针对当前套餐期限设置。在当前套餐期限结束时，系统会将现有开销配额延伸到下一个套餐期限，除非该值已更新。

部门管理员可以查看开销配额，但只有企业管理员可以更新配额量。企业管理员和部门管理员将在配额达到 50%、75%、90% 和 100% 时收到通知。

企业管理员若要设置该配额，请执行以下操作：

  • 打开企业门户

  • 单击左侧导航中的“管理”

  • 单击“部门”选项卡

  • 单击所需的“部门”

  • 单击“部门详细信息”部分的铅笔图标，或者单击“ +添加部门”按钮添加开销配额以及新部门

  • 在“部门详细信息”下的“开销配额”框中以合约的货币为单位输入开销配额量（必须大于 0）

  • 也可以在此时编辑“部门名称”和“成本中心”

  • 单击“保存”

  • 此时会在“部门”选项卡下的“部门列表”视图中显示“部门开销配额”。

在当前套餐期限结束时，企业门户将为下一个套餐期限保留开销配额。 比如，当合约第一年结束时，企业门户将为合约第二年保留开销配额。

💡注意

部门配额量与当前的货币套餐无关，并且配额量和警报仅应用于监测用户的的使用情况。“部门开销配额”仅供参考，不会强制实施开销限制。

部门管理员查看配额：

  • 打开企业门户

  • 单击左侧导航中的“管理”

  • 单击“部门”选项卡，然后查看带开销配额的“部门列表”视图

en.html:
Departmental expenditure quota

EA customers can set or change the spending quota for each department under the contract. The amount of spending quota is set for the current package period. At the end of the current package period, the system will extend the existing spending quota to the next package period, unless the value has been updated.

Department administrators can view spending quotas, but only enterprise administrators can update the quota amounts. Both enterprise administrators and department administrators will receive notifications when the quota reaches 50%, 75%, 90%, and 100%.

If the enterprise administrator wants to set this quota, please follow the steps below:

  • Open the enterprise portal

  • Click "Manage" in the left navigation

  • Click on the "Departments" tab

  • Click on the desired "Department"

  • Click the pencil icon in the "Department Details" section, or click the "+ Add Department" button to add expense quotas and new departments

  • Input the expense quota amount (must be greater than 0) in the "Expense Quota" box under "Department Details" using the currency of the contract

  • You can also edit the "Department Name" and "Cost Center" at this time

  • Click "Save"

  • At this time, the "Department Expense Quota" will be displayed in the "Department List" view under the "Department" tab.

At the end of the current subscription period, the enterprise portal will reserve a spending quota for the next subscription period. For example, when the first year of the contract ends, the enterprise portal will reserve a spending quota for the second

year of the contract.

💡Attention

The department quota is unrelated to the current currency package, and the quota and alerts are solely used to monitor user usage. The "department spending quota" is for reference only and does not impose spending restrictions.

Department administrator checks quota:

  • Open the enterprise portal

  • Click "Manage" in the left navigation

  • Click the "Departments" tab, and then view the "Department List" view with expense quotas

CPP 服务的购买和使用情况可以在 EA portal 进行查看。

查看生效 CPP

CPP 购买内容取决于每月某类型虚拟机的台数。因此已购买 CPP 会按照每月预购数量显示，而不会显示购买金额。如果你已订购了 CPP, 每月预购数量，可以通过价格；列表中 ‘免费量’列查看。

查看示例： 客户购买了 5 个 A4 VM CPP service，显示免费量为 37.2*100小时 （744小时*5）

▧
pricing-items图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_28.png

 

使用和计费

  1. 在 CPP 生效月份，创建同类型虚拟机优先消耗 CPP 预购量

收费示例：客户当月使用了 35.998 单位 A4 VM，未超出预购量，不会产生费用。

▧
pricing-demo1图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_29.png

 

  1. 当您每月购买的“免费量”使用完后，相对应的虚拟机将会根据 EA 常规价目表中的费率开始计费。

收费示例：客户当月使用了 49.5982 单位 A4 VM，超出预购量 12.3982 单位按照议定费率计费。

▧
pricing-demo2图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_30.png

 

💡注意

CPP 和 A-HUB（Azure Hybrid Use Benefit）不能重叠共享提示：如果您的虚拟机包含多项优惠，您仅能享受单项优惠，优惠不能叠加享受。如您购买了 CPP，为避免造成损失，创建 CPP 虚拟机时，请不要勾选 A-HUB。

View effective CPP

企业管理员能够查看关联到 Azure 服务的合约的价目表。

要查看价目表，请执行以下操作：

  • 在企业门户中，单击“报告-价目表”

  • 查看价目表或单击“下载”

查看价目表：

  1. 可以在价目表查看到服务名称，度量单位，免费量，商品编号，单位价格。

  2. 企业客户享受价格保护。所以查看价目表时，鼠标放在右侧蓝色叹号位置，可以看到 2 个价格，即基准费率和当前费率。基准费率为您签合同购买时该服务价格；当前费率为当前该服务的价格，如果该服务后期涨价，您将会享受您签合同时降低价格即基准费率。如下图，基准费率为签合同时价格 21.6, 后期涨价后当前费率为 33.24, 根据价格保护，客户将享受较低价格即基准费率。

▧

en.html:
Enterprise administrators can view the price list of contracts associated with Azure services.

To view the price list, please follow the steps below:

  • In the enterprise portal, click "Report - Price List"

  • View the price list or click "Download"

View price list:

  1. You can view the service name, measurement unit, free quantity, product number, and unit price in the price list.

  2. Enterprise customers enjoy price protection. When viewing the price list, hovering the mouse over the blue exclamation mark on the right side will reveal two prices: the baseline rate and the current rate. The baseline rate represents the price of the service when you signed the contract for purchase; the current rate is the current price of the service. If the service price increases later, you will enjoy the lower price, which is the baseline rate, as you signed the contract. As shown below, the baseline rate was 21.00 when the contract was signed, and the current rate after a price increase is 33.24. According to price protection, the customer will enjoy the lower price, which is the baseline rate.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_32.png

 

  1. The unit price on the EA portal is exclusive of tax.

Price protection:

The customer guarantees that they will receive a price no higher than the one listed in their Customer Price Sheet (CPS) or the price in effect on the effective date of their Azure purchase. This price serves as a benchmark for reference. For services

launched after this purchase, the price is the one in effect when the service was first launched. This price protection applies during the subscription period (which may be 1 or 3 years, depending on the enterprise contract cycle).

可以使用订阅为组织内的团队提供访问开发环境（即测试、生产、开发、临时部署等）和项目的权限。针对每个应用程序环境创建不同的订阅，并为每个订阅分配不同的服务管理员帐户，这是保护每个环境安全的一个好方法。订阅可以与任意数目的服务相关联，而帐户所有者则能在其帐户中创建订阅，并能为每个订阅分配服务管理员帐户。

步骤一： 登录到帐户

在企业门户中选择“管理员”选项卡，然后导航到顶部功能区中的“订阅”

  • 确保你是以此帐户的帐户所有者身份登录的

  • 单击“+添加订阅”

  • 单击“购买”。首次向帐户添加订阅时，你需要提供联系人信息。添加后续订阅时，系统会为你填充联系人信息。

▧
add-subscription图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_32.png

 

▧
register-subscription图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_33.png

 

步骤二： 更新订阅名称

将使用默认的 “Azure Enterprise” 订阅名称来添加所有新的订阅。因此，必须更新订阅名称，以便将其与企业合约中的其他订阅区分开来，并确保它可以在企业级别的报告中识别。

  • 依次单击“订阅”、所创建的订阅以及“编辑订阅详细信息”。

  • 更新订阅名称和服务管理员，然后单击复选标记。订阅名称将显示在报告上，并将在开发门户中成为与订阅关联的项目的名称。

  • 新订阅可能需要长达 24 小时才能传播到订阅列表中。创建完订阅以后，你可以：

  • 单击此处以编辑订阅详细信息。

  • 单击此处以管理订阅服务。

💡注意

只有帐户所有者才能查看和管理订阅。

en.html:
Subscriptions can be utilized to grant teams within an organization access to development environments (such as testing, production, development, temporary deployment, etc.) and projects. Creating a separate subscription for each application environment and assigning unique service administrator accounts to each subscription is an effective method of securing each environment. Subscriptions can be linked to any number of services, and account owners have the ability to create subscriptions within their accounts and assign service administrator accounts to each subscription.

Step 1: Log in to the account

Select the "Manage" tab in the enterprise portal, and then navigate to "Subscription" in the top functional area.

  • Ensure that you are logged in as the account owner of this account.

  • Click "+ Add Subscription".

  • Click "Purchase". When adding a subscription to your account for the first time, you will need to provide contact information. When adding subsequent subscriptions, the system will automatically fill in your contact information for you.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_33.png

 

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_34.png

 

Step 2: Update the subscription name

All new subscriptions will be added using the default subscription name "Azure Enterprise". Therefore, it is necessary to update the subscription name to distinguish it from other subscriptions in the enterprise contract and ensure that it can be

identified in enterprise-level reports.

  • Click "Subscription", click the created subscription, and then click "Edit Subscription Details".

  • Update the subscription name and service administrator, and then click the check mark. The subscription name will be displayed on the report and will serve as the name of the project associated with the subscription in the development portal.

  • It may take up to 24 hours for a new subscription to be propagated to the subscription list. After the subscription is created, you can:

  • Click here to edit subscription details.

  • Click here to manage subscription services.

💡attention

Only the account owner can view and manage subscriptions.

zh.html:
企业协议用户可以按照以下四个级别查看协议中的费用情况：协议>部门>帐户>订阅。客户可以在企业门户中不同的帐户间转移订阅，更改订阅计费帐户。例如将帐户 A 下的所有订阅，转让给帐户 B，转让完成后所有订阅计费将在帐户 B 中显示。客户可以选择‘更改帐户所有者’转让帐户中所有订阅，或选择 ‘转移订阅’转让其中一个或多个订阅。此转让只是计费关系的更改，不会影响客户的部署。

以下以转移订阅 为例为您展示操作步骤

更改帐户管理员操作步骤

  1. 以企业管理员身份登录企业门户。

  2. 在管理>帐户页面选中需要转移的订阅的帐户所有者

▧
subscription-owner图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_39.png

 

  1. 单击“转移订阅”。

▧
transfer-subscription图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_40.png

 

  1. 选中目标订阅，单击下一步。

▧
transfer-subscription-next-step图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_41.png

 

  1. 选择目标帐户，单击下一步。

▧
transfer-subscription-next-step-2图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_42.png

 

  1. 确认转移信息，无误后单击提交。

▧
transfer-subscription-submit图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_43.png

 

  1. 转移大概有五分钟延迟，完成后回到管理>订阅界面刷新订阅即可。

 

订阅常见问题 (FAQ)

  1. 如何查看订阅的帐户所有者权限？

帐户所有者是注册或购买 Azure 订阅的人员。他们有权访问帐户中心并执行各种管理任务，例如创建订阅、取消订阅、更改订阅的计费信息。如果不确定谁是订阅的帐户所有者，可使用以下步骤查明。

*   请访问 企业门户。

*   查看管理>订阅界面，选择要检查的订阅，查看对应帐户名称。

*   在管理>帐户界面，搜索帐户名称，查看对应的帐户。
  1. 所有内容都会转让吗？ 包括资源组、VM、磁盘和其他正在运行的服务吗？

是的，所有资源（如 VM、磁盘和网站）都会转让给新的所有者。但是，不会在不同目录之间传递所设置的任何管理员角色和基于角色的访问控制 (RBAC) 权限。

  1. 订阅转让会造成任何服务停机吗？

不会影响服务。

  1. 如何通过此过程更改订阅的目录？

Azure 订阅在帐户所有者所属的目录中创建。更改目录时，将订阅转让给目标目录中的用户帐户即可。当该用户完成接受转让的步骤后，订阅就会自动移至目标目录。

  1. 如果在计费周期中途转让订阅，接收方需要支付整个计费周期的费用吗？

发送方负责支付转让完成之前所报告的任何使用费。接收方负责支付转让后所报告的使用费。可能有些使用费是在转让之前发生的，但在转让之后才报告。这些使用费包含在接收方的帐单中。

  1. 接收方是否有权访问使用情况和帐单历史记录？

提供给接收方的信息只有最新帐单的金额。其余的使用与帐单历史记录不会随着订阅一起转移

  1. 如何将 Azure 订阅的数据和服务迁移到新的订阅？

如果无法转让订阅所有权，可以手动迁移资源。请参阅将资源移到新资源组或订阅中。

Enterprise agreement users can view the expenses in the agreement at four levels: agreement > department > account >subscription. Customers can transfer subscriptions between different accounts in the enterprise portal and change the

billing account of subscription. For example, if all subscriptions under account A are transferred to account B, all subscription billing will be displayed in account B after the transfer is completed. Customers can choose to transfer all subscriptions in the

account by selecting 'Change Account Owner', or choose to transfer one or more subscriptions by selecting 'Transfer Subscription'. This transfer only changes the billing relationship and does not affect the customer's deployment.

The following will demonstrate the operation steps using the example of transferring subscriptions

Operation steps for changing account owner

  1. Log in to the Enterprise Portal as an enterprise administrator.

  2. On the "Manage" > "Accounts" page, select the account owner of the subscription that needs to be transferred

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_40.png

 

  1. Click "Transfer Subscription".

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_41.png

 

  1. Select the target subscription and click "Next".

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_42.png

 

  1. Select the target account and click "Next".

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_43.png

 

  1. Confirm the transfer information and click "Submit" after verifying it is correct.

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_44.png

 

  1. There may be a delay of about five minutes for the transfer. After it is completed, return to the "Manage" >Subscriptions" interface and refresh your subscriptions."

Frequently Asked Questions about Subscriptions (FAQ)

  1. How to view the account owner permissions of a subscription?

The account owner is the person who registers or purchases the Azure subscription. They have access to the account portal and can perform various administrative tasks, such as creating subscriptions, cancelling subscriptions, changing subscription billing information. If you are unsure who the account owner of your subscription is, you can use the following steps to find out.

  • Please login the enterprise portal.

  • Navigate to the "Manage" > "Subscriptions" interface, select the subscription you wish to check, and view the corresponding account name.

  • In the "Manage" > "Accounts" interface, search for the account name to view the corresponding account.

  1. Will all contents be transferred, including resource groups, VMs, disks, and other running services?

Yes, all resources (such as VMs, disks, and websites) will be transferred to the new owner. However, any administrator roles and role-based access control (RBAC) permissions that have been set will not be passed between different directories.

  1. Will subscription transfer cause any service downtime?

It will not affect the service.

  1. How can I change the directory of my subscription through this process?

An Azure subscription is created in the directory to which the account owner belongs. When changing directories, simply transfer the subscription to a user account in the target directory. Once the user completes the steps to accept the transfer, the subscription will automatically be moved to the target directory.

  1. If the subscription is transferred midway through the billing cycle, does the recipient need to pay for the entire billing cycle?

The sender is responsible for paying any usage fees reported before the transfer is completed. The receiver is responsible for paying the usage fees reported after the transfer. Some usage fees may have occurred before the transfer but were reported only after the transfer. These usage fees are included in the receiver's bill.

  1. Does the recipient have access to usage and billing history?

The information provided to the recipient is only the amount of the latest bill. Other usage and billing history will not be transferred along with the subscription

  1. How to migrate data and services from an Azure subscription to a new one?

If you are unable to transfer subscription ownership, you can manually migrate resources. Please refer to Move resources to a new resource group or subscription.

zh.html:
订阅是 Azure 客户创建服务的资源池，在部署服务前您需要创建订阅，使用中可以编辑订阅属性信息，包括订阅名称，服务管理员及协同管理员。也可以根据您的业务需求随时选择取消订阅，取消后您将无法访问该订阅中之前部署的服务和资源，系统会即时结束该订阅的计费。

本文档为您介绍了取消订阅的操作步骤及操作中需注意的问题。

用户需要使用帐户所有者账号登陆 Azure 门户进行设置。

取消订阅前准备工作

  • 备份数据。例如，如果有存储在 Azure 或 SQL 的数据，请下载副本保证数据不会丢失。如果有虚拟机服务，请在本地保存该虚拟机的映像。

  • 关闭服务。前往 Azure 门户，停止所有正在运行的虚拟机、应用程序或其他服务。

  • 数据迁移。迁移中有任何问题可联系世纪互联完成迁移。

使用 Azure 门户取消订阅

  1. 在 Azure 门户中的“订阅”页面中打开订阅。

  2. 选择要取消的订阅，然后单击“取消订阅”。

▧
cancel-subscription图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-CN_image_44.png

  1. 按照提示进行操作并完成取消。

取消订阅后有什么影响

订阅取消后，计费将立即停止。

订阅取消后，服务被禁用。同时意味着虚拟机解除分配，临时IP地址被释放，存储仅可支持只读状态。

订阅取消后，除了存储帐户中的数据外，其它的资源服务（包括临时存储中的数据，IP 地址，VPN 网关，应用程序网关等）将被立即释放且无法恢复，存储帐户中的数据将被保留 90 天。在这期间用户可随时访问数据。若要了解详细信息，请参阅微软信任中心 -隐私与管控。

en.html:
A subscription is a resource pool created by Azure customers for service creation. Before deploying a service, you need to create a subscription. During use, you can edit subscription property information, including subscription name, service

administrator, and co-administrator. You can also choose to cancel the subscription at any time according to your business needs. After cancellation, you will no longer be able to access the previously deployed services and resources in the subscription, and the system will immediately end the billing for the subscription.

This document introduces the steps for cancelling a subscription and the issues to be aware of during the process.

Users need to log in to the Azure portal using the account of the account owner to make settings.

Preparations before canceling the subscription

  • Back up your data. For instance, if you have data stored on Azure or SQL, please download a copy to ensure that the data will not be lost. If you have virtual machine services, please save the image of the virtual machine locally.

  • Shut down services. Login Azure portal and stop all running virtual machines, applications, or other services.

  • Data migration. If you encounter any issues during the migration process, please contact 21Vianet for assistance in completing the migration.

Cancel subscription in Azure portal

  1. Open the subscription on the "Subscription" in the Azure portal.

  2. Select the subscription you want to cancel, and then click "Unsubscribe".

▧
文档插图图片未随 SQL 提供 · 保留原始引用images%5COSPA-C-EN_image_45.png

 

  1. Follow the prompts and complete the cancellation.

What are the implications of canceling the subscription

After the subscription is canceled, billing will be stopped immediately.

After the subscription is canceled, the service is disabled. This also means that the virtual machine is deallocated, the temporary IP address is released, and the storage can only support a read-only state.

After the subscription is canceled, all resource services (including data in temporary storage, IP addresses, VPN gateways, application gateways, etc.) will be immediately released and cannot be restored, except for the data in the storage account, which will be retained for 90 days. During this period, users can access the data at any time. For more information, please refer to the Microsoft Trust Center - Privacy and Control.

A subscription is a resource pool created by Azure customers for service creation. Before deploying a service, you need to create a subscription. During use, you can edit subscription property information, including subscription name, service

administrator, and co-administrator. You can also choose to cancel the subscription at any time according to your business needs. After cancellation, you will no longer be able to access the previously deployed services and resources in the subscription, and the system will immediately end the billing for the subscription.

This document introduces the steps for cancelling a subscription and the issues to be aware of during the process.

Users need to log in to the [Azure portal](https://portal.azure.cn/) using the account of the account owner to make settings.

**Preparations before canceling the subscription**

*   Back up your data. For instance, if you have data stored on Azure or SQL, please download a copy to ensure that the data will not be lost. If you have virtual machine services, please save the image of the virtual machine locally.

*   Shut down services. Login Azure portal and stop all running virtual machines, applications, or other services.

*   Data migration. If you encounter any issues during the migration process, please [contact 21Vianet](https://support.azure.cn/en-us/support/contact/) for assistance in completing the migration.

**Cancel subscription in Azure portal**

1. Open the subscription on the ["Subscription"](https://portal.azure.cn/#view/Microsoft_Azure_Billing/SubscriptionsBladeV2) in the Azure portal.

2. Select the subscription you want to cancel, and then click "Unsubscribe".

![](images\OSPA-C-EN_image_45.png)

 

3. Follow the prompts and complete the cancellation.

**What are the implications of canceling the subscription**

After the subscription is canceled, billing will be stopped immediately.

After the subscription is canceled, the service is disabled. This also means that the virtual machine is deallocated, the temporary IP address is released, and the storage can only support a read-only state.

After the subscription is canceled, all resource services (including data in temporary storage, IP addresses, VPN gateways, application gateways, etc.) will be immediately released and cannot be restored, except for the data in the storage account, which will be retained for 90 days. During this period, users can access the data at any time. For more information, please refer to the [Microsoft Trust Center - Privacy and Control](https://www.trustcenter.cn/en-us/privacy/you-are-in-control-of-your-data.html).

订阅是企业协议用户部署 Azure 服务的资源池，您所有的服务及资源均与某一订阅相关联。如发生订阅禁用，会导致订阅中已部署的资源服务被暂停，临时存储中资源将被释放。您仍然可以登陆门户网站查看资源，但无法进行编辑操作。禁用之日起 90 天内，您可以联系世纪互联客户支持帮您重启订阅。超出 90 天后，您的订阅将无法重启。

企业协议用户会有以下两种情况导致订阅被禁用。

  • 未按时支付超额账单/年度订单合约被停

  • 订阅被帐户所有者取消

超额/年度订单未支付

如您在合约产生超额后，未及时响应支付超额会影响您的合约及订阅使用。如因超额未支付被暂停，可以直接联系您的客户经理，沟通选择以下两种方式完成超额支付。支付完成后，商务团队将帮您手动重启合约及订阅。

  • 直接支付

  • 通过年度订单或追加订单抵扣超额部分

订阅被帐户所有者意外取消

如果帐户所有者在帐户门户中意外取消了订阅，您无法自己完成重启操作，可联系世纪互联支持人员帮您手动重启。

en.html:
A subscription is a resource pool for enterprise agreement users to deploy Azure services. All your services and resources are associated with a specific subscription. If a subscription is disabled, the deployed resource services within the subscription will be suspended, and resources in temporary storage will be released. You can still log in to the portal to view resources, but you will not be able to perform editing operations. Within 90 days from the date of disablement, you can contact 21Vianet customer support to help you restart your subscription. After 90 days, your subscription cannot be restarted.

There are two situations that may lead to the subscription being disabled for enterprise agreement users.

  • Failure to pay the excess bill on time / annual order contract suspended

  • The subscription has been canceled by the account owner

Excessive/annual orders not paid

If you fail to respond promptly to the payment of excess charges after they are incurred under your contract, it will affect your contract and subscription usage. If your service is suspended due to unpaid excess charges, you can directly contact your account manager and choose from the following two methods to complete the payment of excess charges. After the payment is completed, the business team will manually restart your contract and subscription.

  • direct payment

  • Deduct the excess portion through annual orders or additional orders

The subscription was unexpectedly canceled by the account owner

If the account owner accidentally cancels the subscription in the account portal and you are unable to complete the restart operation yourself, you can contact the support personnel at 21Vianet to assist you with a manual restart.

zh.html:
自 2027 年 2 月 1 日起，Azure 将取消节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例的交换功能。预留实例仍将是面向稳定、可预测工作负载的成本节省选项；而对于需要在产品、服务和区域之间获得更广泛覆盖的动态或演进型工作负载客户而言，节省计划仍是其首选的灵活路径。在 2027 年 2 月 1 日之前购买的有效预留实例，在该日期之后仍可使用最后一次交换机会。虚拟机实例大小灵活性、预留实例取消政策、以及预留实例换购节省计划均不受此次变更影响。

 

1. 有什么变化？

自2027年2月1日起，客户将无法再对节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例进行交换。在2027年2月1日之前购买的每个在影响范围内的有效预留实例，将保留最后一次交换的权利。

 

2. 涉及哪些服务？

本次公告发布时，适用范围包括以下服务的预留实例：

  • 计算服务：Azure虚拟机、Azure专用主机和Azure应用服务。
  • 数据库服务：Azure Database for PostgreSQL、Azure Database for MySQL、Azure DocumentDB、Azure Cosmos DB、Azure SQL数据库和Azure SQL托管实例。

注： 随着节省计划覆盖范围的扩大，这些服务的预留实例将遵循此政策不支持更换。

 

3. 这对现有预留有何影响？

在2027年2月1日前购买的每个受影响服务的有效预留，将在该日期后保留一次最终交换权。客户使用该交换权后（交换按取消并新购处理），新购买的预留将遵循新条款且无法再次交换。对于部分交换，原始预留的剩余数量仍保留其一次交换权。

 

4. 这会影响实例大小的灵活性吗？

不会。

  • 虚拟机的实例大小灵活性不受此次交换政策变更的影响。
  • 改变的是跨服务或区域间的交换——而非改变在同一实例大小灵活性组内跨尺寸自动应用的折扣。

 

5. 预留交换节省计划是否还可行?

是的。

  • 客户可以在预留期限内的任何时间点将预留交换为等值或更高价值的节省计划。
  • 对于需要跨服务和跨区域灵活性的客户，更推荐将预留交换为节省计划。

 

6. 客户仍然可以购买预留吗？

是的。

  • 对于配置明确、稳定且可预测的工作负载，预留仍然可供购买。
  • 本次变更取消了部分服务预留的交换资格，但并不影响购买或续订预留。

 

7. 哪些内容保持不变？

本次调整仅移除受影响服务预留的可交换权益，既不会作废现有预留，也不会减少客户所持预留的当前价值。具体而言：

  • 对于稳定、可预测的工作负载，预留仍可供购买和续订。
  • 虚拟机的实例大小灵活性继续有效——同一实例大小灵活性组内的虚拟机大小自动应用折扣保持不变。
  • 在预留期限内的任何时间点仍然可以与节省计划交换，可置换为等值或更高价值的节省计划。
  • 保留最后一次交换权利——每个在2027年2月1日前购买的有效预留，在该日期后仍保留一次额外交换权。
  • 预留退订（取消）在现有政策和流程下仍然可用。

 

8. 对客户有什么影响？

  • 2027 年 2 月 1 日起，客户将无法再对节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例进行交换。
  • 此前通过交换功能来调整工作负载形态的客户，如果计划于 2027 年 2 月 1 日之后使用其最后一次交换机会，应评估节省计划是否在今后更为合适，并审慎规划。

 

9. 客户应选择哪条迁移路径？

  • 动态、不断发展的工作负载：迁移至节省计划，或将现有预留交换为同等或更高价值的节省计划。
  • 稳定、可预测的工作负载：继续购买或续订预留——虚拟机的实例大小灵活性依然适用。
  • 规划最后一次交换：决定每个有效预留实例的最终交换方式与时点，本次交换完成后，将无法再次发起交换。

 

10. 在 2027 年 2 月 1 日之前，客户有哪些选项？

  • 像往常一样使用预留实例交换。
  • 将现有预留实例交换为节省计划。
  • 为稳定工作负载购买或续订预留实例。
  • 规划如何使用其最后一次交换机会。

 

11. 在 2027 年 2 月 1 日之后，客户有哪些选项？

  • 在适用的情况下，使用每个有效预留实例所的最后一次交换机会。
  • 在预留有效期内的任何时点，将预留实例交换为节省计划。
  • 为稳定工作负载购买新的预留实例，仍可依赖虚拟机的实例大小灵活性。
  • 将灵活性工作负载迁移至节省计划。

 

12. 有哪些相关资料可供客户参考？

Azure 预留的自助交换和退款 - Microsoft Cost Management

在节省计划与预留实例之间做出选择

Azure 预留交换策略的变化 - Microsoft Cost Management

 

13. 交换功能下线后，客户是否仍可取消或退订预留实例？

可以。 预留实例退订不受此次变更影响。客户可继续依据现行政策与流程退订符合条件的预留实例。

 

14. Azure 为何做出此次变更？

取消预留实例交换旨在简化预留实例承诺模型，并鼓励需要灵活性的客户转向节省计划，节省计划专为符合条件的服务与使用模式提供自动化灵活性而设计，而预留实例则继续为稳定场景提供显著的成本节省。通过将"灵活性"集中至节省计划，Azure 可为客户提供更清晰、更一致的成本优化策略。

 

15. Azure 是否在取消预留实例这一承诺模型？

否。 预留实例仍可为稳定工作负载购买与续订。本次变更仅取消了节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例的交换功能，并非使预留实例本身失效。实例大小灵活性与 RI 交换节省计划均继续保留。
zh.text: 自 2027 年 2 月 1 日起，Azure 将取消节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例的交换功能。预留实例仍将是面向稳定、可预测工作负载的成本节省选项；而对于需要在产品、服务和区域之间获得更广泛覆盖的动态或演进型工作负载客户而言，节省计划仍是其首选的灵活路径。在 2027 年 2 月 1 日之前购买的有效预留实例，在该日期之后仍可使用最后一次交换机会。虚拟机实例大小灵活性、预留实例取消政策、以及预留实例换购节省计划均不受此次变更影响。 1. 有什么变化？ 自2027年2月1日起，客户将无法再对节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例进行交换。在2027年2月1日之前购买的每个在影响范围内的有效预留实例，将保留最后一次交换的权利。 2. 涉及哪些服务？ 本次公告发布时，适用范围包括以下服务的预留实例： 计算服务 ：Azure虚拟机、Azure专用主机和Azure应用服务。 数据库服务 ：Azure Database for PostgreSQL、Azure Database for MySQL、Azure DocumentDB、Azure Cosmos DB、Azure SQL数据库和Azure SQL托管实例。 注： 随着节省计划覆盖范围的扩大，这些服务的预留实例将遵循此政策不支持更换。 3. 这对现有预留有何影响？ 在2027年2月1日前购买的每个受影响服务的有效预留，将在该日期后保留一次最终交换权。客户使用该交换权后（交换按取消并新购处理），新购买的预留将遵循新条款且无法再次交换。对于部分交换，原始预留的剩余数量仍保留其一次交换权。 4. 这会影响实例大小的灵活性吗？ 不会。 虚拟机的 实例大小灵活性 不受此次交换政策变更的影响。 改变的是跨服务或区域间的交换——而非改变在同一实例大小灵活性组内跨尺寸自动应用的折扣。 5. 预留交换节省计划是否还可行? 是的。 客户可以在预留期限内的任何时间点将 预留交换为等值或更高价值的节省计划 。 对于需要跨服务和跨区域灵活性的客户，更推荐将预留交换为节省计划。 6. 客户仍然可以购买预留吗？ 是的。 对于配置明确、稳定且可预测的工作负载，预留仍然可供购买。 本次变更取消了部分服务预留的交换资格，但并不影响购买或续订预留。 7. 哪些内容保持不变？ 本次调整仅移除受影响服务预留的可交换权益，既不会作废现有预留，也不会减少客户所持预留的当前价值。具体而言： 对于稳定、可预测的工作负载，预留仍可供购买和续订。 虚拟机的实例大小灵活性继续有效——同一实例大小灵活性组内的虚拟机大小自动应用折扣保持不变。 在预留期限内的任何时间点仍然可以与节省计划交换，可置换为等值或更高价值的节省计划。 保留最后一次交换权利——每个在2027年2月1日前购买的有效预留，在该日期后仍保留一次额外交换权。 预留退订（取消）在现有政策和流程下仍然可用。 8. 对客户有什么影响？ 2027 年 2 月 1 日起，客户将无法再对节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例进行交换。 此前通过交换功能来调整工作负载形态的客户，如果计划于 2027 年 2 月 1 日之后使用其最后一次交换机会，应评估节省计划是否在今后更为合适，并审慎规划。 9. 客户应选择哪条迁移路径？ 动态、不断发展的工作负载 ：迁移至节省计划，或将现有预留交换为同等或更高价值的节省计划。 稳定、可预测的工作负载 ：继续购买或续订预留——虚拟机的实例大小灵活性依然适用。 规划最后一次交换 ：决定每个有效预留实例的最终交换方式与时点，本次交换完成后，将无法再次发起交换。 10. 在 2027 年 2 月 1 日之前，客户有哪些选项？ 像往常一样使用预留实例交换。 将现有预留实例交换为节省计划。 为稳定工作负载购买或续订预留实例。 规划如何使用其最后一次交换机会。 11. 在 2027 年 2 月 1 日之后，客户有哪些选项？ 在适用的情况下，使用每个有效预留实例所的最后一次交换机会。 在预留有效期内的任何时点，将预留实例交换为节省计划。 为稳定工作负载购买新的预留实例，仍可依赖虚拟机的实例大小灵活性。 将灵活性工作负载迁移至节省计划。 12. 有哪些相关资料可供客户参考？ Azure 预留的自助交换和退款 - Microsoft Cost Management 在节省计划与预留实例之间做出选择 Azure 预留交换策略的变化 - Microsoft Cost Management 13. 交换功能下线后，客户是否仍可取消或退订预留实例？ 可以。 预留实例退订不受此次变更影响。客户可继续依据现行政策与流程退订符合条件的预留实例。 14. Azure 为何做出此次变更？ 取消预留实例交换旨在简化预留实例承诺模型，并鼓励需要灵活性的客户转向节省计划，节省计划专为符合条件的服务与使用模式提供自动化灵活性而设计，而预留实例则继续为稳定场景提供显著的成本节省。通过将"灵活性"集中至节省计划，Azure 可为客户提供更清晰、更一致的成本优化策略。 15. Azure 是否在取消预留实例这一承诺模型？ 否。 预留实例仍可为稳定工作负载购买与续订。本次变更仅取消了节省计划所涵盖服务的预留实例的交换功能，并非使预留实例本身失效。实例大小灵活性与 RI 交换节省计划均继续保留。

en.html:
Azure is removing reservation exchanges for savings plan-eligible services starting February 1, 2027. Reservations will continue to be a cost-saving option for stable, predictable workloads, while savings plans remain the flexible path for customers who need broader coverage across products, services, and regions for dynamic or evolving workloads. Active reservations purchased before February 1, 2027, will retain one final exchange after that date. Instance size flexibility for VMs, the reservation cancellation policy, and RI-to-savings-plan trade-ins are not impacted by this change.

 

1. What is changing?

Starting February 1, 2027, customers will no longer be able to exchange Azure reservations for services covered by savings plans. Each active reservation for impacted services purchased before February 1, 2027, will retain the right to one final exchange after that date.

 

2. Which services are in scope?

At the time of announcement, the scope includes reservations for the following services:

  • Compute services: Azure Virtual Machine,Azure Dedicated Host, and Azure App Service. 
  • Database services: Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Database for MySQL, Azure DocumentDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Database, and Azure SQL Managed Instance. 

Note: As savings plans coverage expands, reservations for those services will follow this policy and will not support exchanges.

 

3. How does this affect existing reservations?

Each active reservation for impacted services purchased before February 1, 2027, will retain the right to one final exchange after that date. Once a customer uses that exchange (which is processed as a cancellation and a new purchase), the resulting reservation operates under the new terms and cannot be exchanged again. For partial exchanges, the remaining quantity on the original reservation keeps its one-time exchange right.

 

4.Does this remove instance size flexibility?

No.

  • Instance size flexibility for VMs is not impacted by this change in exchange policy.
  • What changes is the ability to exchange across services or regions—not the automatic discount applied across sizes within the same instance size flexibility group.

 

5. Is RI-to-savings-plan trade-in still available?

Yes.

  • Customers can trade in reservations for a savings plan of equal or greater value at any point in the reservation term.
  • Trade-in is the recommended path for customers who need flexibility across services and regions.

 

6.Can customers still purchase reservations?

Yes.

  • Reservations remain available to purchase for stable, predictable workloads where the specific configuration is known.
  • The change removes reservation exchangeability for certain services, not the ability to buy or renew reservations.

 

7. What stays the same?

This change removes exchangeability for impacted reservations — it does not retire reservations or reduce the existing value of reservations customers already hold. Specifically:

  • Reservations remain available to purchase and renew for stable, predictable workloads.
  • Instance size flexibility for VMs continues — the automatic discount across sizes within the same instance size flexibility group is unchanged.
  • RI-to-savings-plan trade-in remains available at any point in the reservation term, for a savings plan of equal or greater value.
  • One final exchange is preserved — each active reservation purchased before February 1, 2027 retains the right to one more exchange after that date.
  • Reservation returns (cancellations) remain available under existing policies and processes.

 

8.What is the customer impact?

  • Customers will no longer be able to exchange reservations for savings plan-eligible services starting February 1, 2027.
  • Customers who previously used exchanges to adjust workload shape over time should review whether Savings plans are a better fit going forward and plan carefully if they intend to use their one remaining exchange after February 1, 2027.

 

9. What transition path should a customer choose?

  • Dynamic, evolving workload: migrate to a Savings plan, or trade in existing reservations for a Savings plan of equal or greater value.
  • Stable, predictable workload: continue purchasing or renewing reservations — instance size flexibility for VMs still applies.
  • Plan one final exchange: decide how and when to use the one final exchange on each active reservation, since it can't be exchanged again afterward.

 

10. What options do customers have before February 1, 2027?

  • Use reservation exchange as they do today.
  • Trade in existing reservations for a savings plan.
  • Purchase or renew reservations for stable workloads.
  • Plan how and when to use their one final exchange.

 

11. What options do customers have after February 1, 2027?

  • Use one remaining exchange per active reservation, where applicable.
  • Trade in reservations for a savings plan at any point in term.
  • Purchase new reservations for stable workloads (without exchangeability), relying on instance size flexibility for VMs.
  • Transition flexible workloads to savings plans.

 

12. What resources are available for customers to refer to?

Self-service exchanges and refunds for Azure Reservations - Microsoft Cost Management

Decide between a savings plan and a reservation - Microsoft Cost Management

Changes to the Azure reservation exchange policy - Microsoft Cost Management

 

13. Can customers still cancel or return a reservation after Reservation Exchange is retired?

Yes. Reservation returns remain available and are not impacted by this change. Customers can continue to return eligible reservations according to existing policies and processes.

 

14.Why is Azure making this change?

Reservation exchanges are being retired to simplify the reservation commitment model and encourage customers who require flexibility to use Savings plans, which are designed to provide automated flexibility across eligible services and usage patterns, while reservations continue to offer significant cost savings for stable scenarios. By consolidating flexibility into savings plans, Azure can provide a clearer and more consistent cost optimization strategy for customers.

 

15. Is Azure eliminating reservations as a commitment model?

No. Reservations remain available to purchase and renew for stable workloads. The change removes the exchange feature for savings-plan-eligible reservations; it does not retire reservations themselves. Instance size flexibility and RI-to-savings-plan trade-in both continue.

en.raw:
Azure is removing reservation exchanges for savings plan-eligible services starting February 1, 2027. Reservations will continue to be a cost-saving option for stable, predictable workloads, while savings plans remain the flexible path for customers who need broader coverage across products, services, and regions for dynamic or evolving workloads. Active reservations purchased before February 1, 2027, will retain one final exchange after that date. Instance size flexibility for VMs, the reservation cancellation policy, and RI-to-savings-plan trade-ins are not impacted by this change.

 
#### 1. What is changing?

**Starting February 1, 2027**, customers will no longer be able to exchange Azure reservations for services covered by savings plans. Each active reservation for impacted services purchased before February 1, 2027, will retain the right to one final exchange after that date.

 
#### 2. Which services are in scope?

At the time of announcement, the scope includes reservations for the following services: 

*   **Compute services**: Azure Virtual Machine,Azure Dedicated Host, and Azure App Service. 
*   **Database services:** Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Database for MySQL, Azure DocumentDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Database, and Azure SQL Managed Instance. 

**Note**: As savings plans coverage expands, reservations for those services will follow this policy and will not support exchanges. 

 
#### 3. How does this affect existing reservations?

Each active reservation for impacted services purchased before February 1, 2027, will retain the right to one final exchange after that date. Once a customer uses that exchange (which is processed as a cancellation and a new purchase), the resulting reservation operates under the new terms and cannot be exchanged again. For partial exchanges, the remaining quantity on the original reservation keeps its one-time exchange right.

 
#### 4.Does this remove instance size flexibility?

**No.** 

*   [Instance size flexibility](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/reserved-vm-instance-size-flexibility) for VMs is not impacted by this change in exchange policy. 
*   What changes is the ability to exchange across services or regions—not the automatic discount applied across sizes within the same instance size flexibility group.

 
#### 5. Is RI-to-savings-plan trade-in still available?

**Yes.**

*   Customers can [trade in reservations for a savings plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cost-management-billing/savings-plan/reservation-trade-in) of equal or greater value at any point in the reservation term. 
*   Trade-in is the recommended path for customers who need flexibility across services and regions.

 
#### 6.Can customers still purchase reservations?

**Yes.** 

*   Reservations remain available to purchase for stable, predictable workloads where the specific configuration is known. 
*   The change removes reservation exchangeability for certain services, not the ability to buy or renew reservations.

 
#### 7. What stays the same?

This change removes exchangeability for impacted reservations — it does not retire reservations or reduce the existing value of reservations customers already hold. Specifically:

*   Reservations remain available to purchase and renew for stable, predictable workloads.
*   Instance size flexibility for VMs continues — the automatic discount across sizes within the same instance size flexibility group is unchanged.
*   RI-to-savings-plan trade-in remains available at any point in the reservation term, for a savings plan of equal or greater value.
*   One final exchange is preserved — each active reservation purchased before February 1, 2027 retains the right to one more exchange after that date.
*   Reservation returns (cancellations) remain available under existing policies and processes.

 
#### 8.What is the customer impact?

*   Customers will **no longer be able to exchange reservations** for savings plan-eligible services starting **February 1, 2027.**
*   Customers who previously used exchanges to adjust workload shape over time should **review whether Savings plans** are a better fit going forward and plan carefully if they intend to use their one remaining exchange after February 1, 2027. 

 
#### 9. What transition path should a customer choose?

*   **Dynamic, evolving workload:** migrate to a Savings plan, or trade in existing reservations for a Savings plan of equal or greater value.
*   **Stable, predictable workload:** continue purchasing or renewing reservations — instance size flexibility for VMs still applies.
*   **Plan one final exchange:** decide how and when to use the one final exchange on each active reservation, since it can't be exchanged again afterward.

 
#### 10. What options do customers have before February 1, 2027?

*   Use reservation exchange as they do today.
*   Trade in existing reservations for a savings plan.
*   Purchase or renew reservations for stable workloads.
*   Plan how and when to use their one final exchange.

 
#### 11. What options do customers have after February 1, 2027?

*   Use one remaining exchange per active reservation, where applicable.
*   Trade in reservations for a savings plan at any point in term.
*   Purchase new reservations for stable workloads (without exchangeability), relying on instance size flexibility for VMs.
*   Transition flexible workloads to savings plans.

 
#### 12. What resources are available for customers to refer to?

[Self-service exchanges and refunds for Azure Reservations - Microsoft Cost Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-au/azure/cost-management-billing/reservations/exchange-and-refund-azure-reservations)

[Decide between a savings plan and a reservation - Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/en-us/cost-management-billing/savings-plan/decide-between-savings-plan-reservation)

[Changes to the Azure reservation exchange policy - Microsoft Cost Management](https://docs.azure.cn/en-us/cost-management-billing/reservations/reservation-exchange-policy-changes)

 
#### 13. Can customers still cancel or return a reservation after Reservation Exchange is retired?

**Yes**. Reservation returns remain available and are not impacted by this change. Customers can continue to return eligible reservations according to existing policies and processes. 

 
#### 14.Why is Azure making this change?

Reservation exchanges are being retired to simplify the reservation commitment model and encourage customers who require flexibility to use Savings plans, which are designed to provide automated flexibility across eligible services and usage patterns, while reservations continue to offer significant cost savings for stable scenarios. By consolidating flexibility into savings plans, Azure can provide a clearer and more consistent cost optimization strategy for customers.

 
#### 15. Is Azure eliminating reservations as a commitment model?

**No**. Reservations remain available to purchase and renew for stable workloads. The change removes the exchange feature for savings-plan-eligible reservations; it does not retire reservations themselves. Instance size flexibility and RI-to-savings-plan trade-in both continue.
